questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第七條，香港特別行政區的土地和自然資源收入：__________
questions.questionEn: According to Article 7 of the Basic Law, the revenue from land and natural resources of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region:

options.labelEn: needs to be turned over to the central government
part of the income needs to be turned over to the central government

options.labelZh: 不需上繳中央，除非是售賣土地的收益
options.labelEn: does not need to be turned over to the central government, unless it is the proceeds from the sale of land
does not need to be turned over to the central government

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 D。《基本法》第 7 條訂明，土地同自然資源所得收入全歸香港特區政府支配，即係唔需要上繳中央。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第十條，香港特別行政區的區旗是由以下哪些特徵組成？
questions.questionEn: According to Article 10 of the Basic Law, which of the following characteristics does the regional flag of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region consist of?

options.labelZh: 五星花蕊的洋金菊花紅色旗
options.labelEn: Red flag with five-star chamomile flower

options.labelZh: 五星花蕊的紫荊花紅色旗
options.labelEn: Red flag with five-star bauhinia flower

options.labelZh: 五星花蕊的紫荊花藍色旗
options.labelEn: Blue flag with five-star bauhinia flower

options.labelZh: 五金星花蕊的紫荊花橙色旗
options.labelEn: Orange flag with five-star bauhinia flower

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 B。《基本法》第 10 條訂明，香港特區區旗係「五星花蕊的紫荊花紅旗」；花種同顏色都要同條文完全一致。

questions.questionZh: 下列哪條並不是列於《基本法》第十八條及附件三之全國性法律？
questions.questionEn: Which of the following is not a national law listed in Article 18 and Annex 3 of the Basic Law?

options.labelEn: "Flag Law of the People's Republic of China"

options.labelZh: 《全國人民代表大會議事規則》
options.labelEn: "Rules of Procedure of the National People's Congress"

options.labelZh: 《關於中華人民共和國國慶日的決議》
options.labelEn: "Resolution on the National Day of the People's Republic of China"

options.labelZh: 《中華人民共和國專屬經濟區和大陸架法》
options.labelEn: "Law of the People's Republic of China on the Exclusive Economic Zone and Continental Shelf"

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 B。《全國人民代表大會議事規則》唔喺《基本法》附件三嘅全國性法律名單內；A、C、D 都屬名單內法律，所以 B 先係題目問嘅「並不是」嗰項。
questions.trapZh: 題目問排除項；要揀出唔屬於附件三現行全國性法律名單嘅「《全國人民代表大會議事規則》」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第二十三條，以下哪一項不是香港特別行政區應自行立法禁止之行為？
questions.questionEn: According to Article 23 of the Basic Law, which of the following is not an act that the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region should enact its own legislation to prohibit?

options.labelEn: Subversion of the Central People's Government

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 C。依據《基本法》第 23 條，「危及國家安全」唔屬於條文列明嘅犯罪或禁止行為；其餘選項先係條文涵蓋嘅內容。
questions.trapZh: 題目問排除項；要揀出唔屬於條文列明嘅犯罪或禁止行為嘅「危及國家安全」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第三十五條，下列哪項並不是香港居民可以享有的權利？
questions.questionEn: According to Article 35 of the Basic Law, which of the following is not a right enjoyed by Hong Kong residents?

options.labelZh: 選擇律師及時保護自己的違法行為
options.labelEn: Choose a lawyer to protect your illegal behavior in a timely manner

options.labelZh: 有權對政府「行政部門」和「行政人員」的行為向法院提起訴訟
options.labelEn: Have the right to file a lawsuit in court against the actions of government "executive departments" and "administrators"

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 C。依據《基本法》第 35 條，「選擇律師及時保護自己的違法行為」唔屬於條文保障嘅權利或自由；其餘選項先係條文涵蓋嘅內容。
questions.trapZh: 題目問排除項；要揀出唔屬於條文保障嘅權利或自由嘅「選擇律師及時保護自己的違法行為」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第四十條，根據下列哪一項獲得新界原居民的權益會根據香港特別行政區的__________保護？
questions.questionEn: According to Article 40 of the Basic Law, according to which of the following, the rights and interests of the indigenous residents of the New Territories will be protected under the __________ of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region?

options.labelEn: Laws and Regulations of the Qing Dynasty

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 D。《基本法》第 40 條明確訂明：「“新界”原居民的合法傳統權益受香港特別行政區的保護」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第四十五條，香港特別行政區的「行政長官」是由誰任命？
questions.questionEn: According to Article 45 of the Basic Law, who appoints the “Chief Executive” of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region?

options.labelEn: President of the People's Republic of China

options.labelZh: 中華人民共和國國務院總理
options.labelEn: Premier of the State Council of the People's Republic of China

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 B。《基本法》第 45 條明確訂明：「香港特別行政區行政長官在當地通過選舉或協商產生，由中央人民政府任命」。
questions.trapZh: 唔好交換權力主體；條文指定嘅係「中央人民政府」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第四十八條，以下哪項並不是行政長官所行使的職權？
questions.questionEn: According to Article 48 of the Basic Law, which of the following is not a function and power exercised by the Chief Executive?

options.labelZh: 決定政府政策和發佈行政命令
options.labelEn: Determine government policies and issue executive orders

options.labelZh: 批准向立法會提出有關財政收入或支出的動議
options.labelEn: Approval of motions to the Legislative Council regarding fiscal revenue or expenditure

options.labelZh: 赦免或減輕刑事罪犯的刑罰
options.labelEn: Pardon or reduce the sentences of criminal offenders

options.labelZh: 委任三分之一的立法會議員
options.labelEn: Appoint one-third of the Legislative Council members

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 D。依據《基本法》第 48 條，「委任三分之一的立法會議員」唔屬於條文列明嘅職權；其餘選項先係條文涵蓋嘅內容。
questions.trapZh: 題目問排除項；要揀出唔屬於條文列明嘅職權嘅「委任三分之一的立法會議員」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第四十九條，香港特別行政區行政長官如認為立法會通過的法案不符合香港特別行政區的__________，可在三個月內將法案發回立法會重議？
questions.questionEn: According to Article 49 of the Basic Law, if the Chief Executive of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region believes that a bill passed by the Legislative Council is not in compliance with the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, he can send the bill back to the Legislative Council for reconsideration within three months?
questions.explanationZh: 答案係 B。《基本法》第 49 條明確訂明：「香港特別行政區行政長官如認為立法會通過的法案不符合香港特別行政區的整體利益，可在三個月內將法案發回立法會重議，立法會如以不少於全體議員三分之二多數再次通過原案，行政長官必須在一個月內簽署公布或按本法第五十條的規定處理」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第六十三條，以下哪位是負責主管香港特別行政區之刑事檢察工作，不受任何干涉？
questions.questionEn: According to Article 63 of the Basic Law, which of the following persons is in charge of the criminal prosecution work of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region without any interference?
questions.explanationZh: 答案係 C。《基本法》第 63 條明確訂明：「香港特別行政區律政司主管刑事檢察工作，不受任何干涉」。
questions.trapZh: 唔好交換權力主體；條文指定嘅係「律政司」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第七十五條，香港特別行政區立法會舉行會議的法定人數為不少於__________的二分之一？
questions.questionEn: According to Article 75 of the Basic Law, the quorum for meetings of the Legislative Council of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region shall be no less than one-half of ?

options.labelZh: 功能團體選舉產生的議員

options.labelEn: Members directly elected by geographical districts

options.labelZh: 當天出席立法會會議的議員
options.labelEn: Members attending the Legislative Council meeting that day

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 C。《基本法》第 75 條明確訂明：「香港特別行政區立法會舉行會議的法定人數為不少於全體議員的二分之一」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第一百零一條，香港特別行政區政府可任用原香港公務人員中的或持有香港特別行政區永久性居民身份證的英籍和其他外籍人士擔任政府部門的各級公務人員，但下列哪位官員並不須由在外國無居留權的香港特別行政區永久性居民中的中國公民擔任？
questions.questionEn: According to Article 101 of the Basic Law, the Government of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region may appoint British and other foreigners who are former Hong Kong civil servants or hold Hong Kong Special Administrative Region permanent resident identity cards to serve as civil servants at all levels in government departments. However, which of the following officials does not need to be held by Chinese citizens who are permanent residents of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region without the right of abode in foreign countries?
questions.explanationZh: 答案係 D。依據《基本法》第 101 條，「申訴專員」唔屬於必須符合有關國籍及居留資格限制嘅職位；其餘選項先係條文涵蓋嘅內容。
questions.trapZh: 題目問排除項；要揀出唔屬於必須符合有關國籍及居留資格限制嘅職位嘅「申訴專員」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第一百二十五條，香港特別行政區經中央人民政府授權繼續進行船舶登記，並根據香港特別行政區的法律以__________ 的名義頒發有關證件。
questions.questionEn: In accordance with Article 125 of the Basic Law, the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region shall continue to register ships with the authorization of the Central People's Government and issue relevant certificates in the name of __________ in accordance with the laws of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.
questions.explanationZh: 答案係 D。《基本法》第 125 條明確訂明：「香港特別行政區經中央人民政府授權繼續進行船舶登記，並根據香港特別行政區的法律以" 中國香港" 的名義頒發有關證件」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第一百五十一條，香港特別行政區不可以在下列領域中，以「中國香港」的名義，單獨地同世界各國、各地區及有關國際組織保持和發展關係，簽訂和履行有關協議。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 151 of the Basic Law, the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region cannot independently maintain and develop relations, sign and perform relevant agreements with other countries, regions and relevant international organizations in the following areas in the name of "Hong Kong, China".
questions.explanationZh: 答案係 D。依據《基本法》第 151 條，「環保」唔屬於題目所問嘅法定範圍；其餘選項先係條文涵蓋嘅內容。
questions.trapZh: 題目問排除項；要揀出唔屬於題目所問嘅法定範圍嘅「環保」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第一百五十三條，中華人民共和國締結的國際協議，中央人民政府可根據香港特別行政區的情況和需要，在徵詢__________的意見後，決定是否適用於香港特別行政區。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 153 of the Basic Law, international agreements concluded by the People's Republic of China, the Central People's Government may decide whether to apply to the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region based on the circumstances and needs of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region and after consulting __________.

options.labelZh: 香港特別行政區行政長官
options.labelEn: Chief Executive of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region
Government of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 B。《基本法》第 153 條明確訂明：「中華人民共和國締結的國際協議，中央人民政府可根據香港特別行政區的情況和需要，在徵詢香港特別行政區政府的意見後，決定是否適用於香港特別行政區」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第七條，香港特別行政區境內的土地和自然資源屬於國家所有，由香港特別行政區政府負責管理、使用、開發、出租或批給__________使用或開發，其收入全歸香港特別行政區政府支配。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 7 of the Basic Law, the land and natural resources within the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region are owned by the state and are managed, used, developed, leased or granted for use or development by the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region Government, and all income therefrom is at the disposal of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region Government.

options.labelEn: Private person, legal person or group

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 C。《基本法》第 7 條明確訂明：「香港特別行政區境內的土地和自然資源屬於國家所有，由香港特別行政區政府負責管理、使用、開發、出租或批給個人、法人或團體使用或開發，其收入全歸香港特別行政區政府支配」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第八條，香港原有法律， 即法、法、 和 __________，除同本法相抵觸或經香港特別行政區的立法機關作出修改者外，予以保留。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 8 of the Basic Law, the original laws of Hong Kong, namely the Act, the Law, the Law and the Law, shall be retained unless they conflict with this Law or have been amended by the legislative body of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

options.labelZh: 普通法、衡平法、條例、附屬立法和習慣法
options.labelEn: Common law, equity, regulations, subsidiary legislation and customary law

options.labelZh: 普通法、平衡法、條例、附屬立法和習慣法
options.labelEn: Common law, equity, regulations, subsidiary legislation and customary law

options.labelZh: 普通法、衡平法、附例、附屬立法和習慣法
options.labelEn: Common law, equity, by-laws, subsidiary legislation and customary law

options.labelZh: 普通法、條例、衡平法、附屬立法和習慣法
options.labelEn: Common law, regulations, equity, subsidiary legislation and customary law

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 A。《基本法》第 8 條明確訂明：「香港原有法律，即普通法、衡平法、條例、附屬立法和習慣法，除同本法相抵觸或經香港特別行政區的立法機關作出修改者外，予以保留」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第一百四十八條，香港特別行政區的教育、 科學、技術、文化、藝術、體育、專業、醫療衛生、勞工、 社會福利、社會工作等方面的民間團體和宗教組織同內地相應的團體和組織的關係，應以__________的原則為基礎。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 148 of the Basic Law, the relationship between civil society groups and religious organizations in education, science, technology, culture, arts, sports, professions, health care, labor, social welfare, social work, etc. in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region and their corresponding groups and organizations in the Mainland should be based on the principle of __________.

options.labelZh: 互不干涉、互不隸屬和互相尊重
options.labelEn: Mutual non-interference, mutual non-subordination and mutual respect

options.labelZh: 互不隸屬、互不干涉和互相尊重
options.labelEn: Mutual non-subordination, mutual non-interference and mutual respect

options.labelZh: 互相尊重、互不干涉和互不隸屬
options.labelEn: Mutual respect, mutual non-interference and mutual non-subordination

options.labelZh: 互相尊重、互不隸屬和互不干涉
options.labelEn: Mutual respect, mutual non-subordination and mutual non-interference

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 B。《基本法》第 148 條明確訂明：「香港特別行政區的教育、科學、技術、文化、藝術、體育、專業、醫療衞生、勞工、社會福利、社會工作等方面的民間團體和宗教組織同內地相應的團體和組織的關係，應以互不隸屬、互不干涉和互相尊重的原則為基礎」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第十四條，中央人民政府負責管理香港特別行政區的防務。香港特別行政區政府負責維持香港特別行政區的社會治安。中央人民政府派駐香港特別行政區負責防務的軍隊不干預香港特別行政區的地方事務。香港特別行政區政府在必要時，可向中央人民政府請求駐軍協助維持社會治安和救助災害。駐軍人員須遵守__________。駐軍費用由中央人民政府負擔。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 14 of the Basic Law, the Central People's Government is responsible for managing the defense of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region. The Government of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region is responsible for maintaining public order in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region. The troops stationed by the Central People's Government in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region to take charge of defense will not interfere in the local affairs of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region. When necessary, the Government of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region may request the Central People's Government for garrison assistance in maintaining public order and providing disaster relief. Garrison personnel must comply with __________. The cost of garrisoning the troops shall be borne by the Central People's Government.

options.labelZh: 香港特別行政區的法律
options.labelEn: Laws of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

options.labelZh: 全國性的法律及香港特別行政區的法律
options.labelEn: National laws and laws of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

options.labelZh: 香港特別行政區的法律及全國性的法律
options.labelEn: Laws of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region and national laws

questions.explanationZh: 此題停用。《基本法》第 14 條訂明駐軍人員須同時遵守全國性法律同香港特區法律，但 C、D 只係調轉次序，法律意思相同，無法構成唯一答案。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第二十二條，中央人民政府所屬各部門、 各省、自治區、直轄市均不得干預香港特別行政區根據本法自行管理的事務。中央各部門、各省、自治區、直轄市如需在香港特別行政區設立機構，須徵得__________ •中央各部門、各省、自治區、直轄市在香港特別行政區設立的一切機構及其人員均須遵守香港特別行政區的法律。中國其他地區的人進入香港特別行政區須辦理批准手續，其中進入香港特別行政區定居的人數由中央人民政府主管部門徵求香港特別行政區政府的意見後確定。香港特別行政區可在北京設立辦事機構。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 22 of the Basic Law, no department under the Central People's Government, any province, autonomous region or municipality directly under the Central Government shall interfere with the affairs managed by the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region itself in accordance with this Law. If the departments of the central government, provinces, autonomous regions and municipalities directly under the Central Government need to set up institutions in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, they must obtain the approval. All institutions and their personnel established in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region by the departments of the central government, provinces, autonomous regions and municipalities must abide by the laws of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region. People from other parts of China must go through approval procedures to enter the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region. The number of people who enter the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region to settle is determined by the competent authorities of the Central People's Government after soliciting the opinions of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region government. The Hong Kong Special Administrative Region can set up offices in Beijing.

options.labelZh: 香港特別行政區政府同意
options.labelEn: Approved by the Government of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region
Approved by the Central People's Government

options.labelZh: 中央人民政府批准並經香港特別行政區政府同意
options.labelEn: Approved by the Central People's Government and approved by the Government of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

options.labelZh: 香港特別行政區政府同意並經中央人民政府批准
options.labelEn: Approved by the Government of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region and approved by the Central People's Government

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 D。《基本法》第 22 條明確訂明：「中央各部門、各省、自治區、直轄市如需在香港特別行政區設立機構，須徵得香港特別行政區政府同意並經中央人民政府批准」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第二十六條，香港特別行政區永久性居民依法享有__________
questions.questionEn: According to Article 26 of the Basic Law, permanent residents of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region shall enjoy in accordance with the law__________

options.labelEn: The right to elect and the right to be elected
The right to nominate and the right to be nominated

options.labelZh: 選舉權、被選舉權、提名權和被提名權
options.labelEn: The right to vote, the right to be elected, the right to nominate and the right to be nominated

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 B。《基本法》第 26 條明確訂明：「香港特別行政區永久性居民依法享有選舉權和被選舉權」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第四十一條，在香港特別行政區境內的香港居民以外的其他人，依法享有本章規定的香港居民的__________
questions.questionEn: According to Article 41 of the Basic Law, persons other than Hong Kong residents in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region shall, in accordance with the law, enjoy the
questions.explanationZh: 答案係 C。《基本法》第 41 條明確訂明：「在香港特別行政區境內的香港居民以外的其他人，依法享有本章規定的香港居民的權利和自由」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第四十三條，香港特別行政區行政長官是__________的首長，代表__________。 香港特別行政區行政長官依照本法的規定對中央人民政府和香港特別行政區負責。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 43 of the Basic Law, the Chief Executive of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region is the head and representative of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region. The Chief Executive of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region shall be responsible to the Central People's Government and the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region in accordance with the provisions of this Law.

options.labelZh: 香港特別行政區、香港特別行政區
options.labelEn: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

options.labelZh: 香港特別行政區政府、香港特別行政區
options.labelEn: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region Government, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

options.labelZh: 香港特別行政區、香港特別行政區政府
options.labelEn: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region Government

options.labelZh: 香港特別行政區政府、香港特別行政區政府
options.labelEn: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region Government, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region Government

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 A。《基本法》第 43 條訂明，行政長官係香港特區嘅首長，亦代表香港特區；兩個空格都係「香港特別行政區」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第一百零三條，公務人員應根據其本人的__________予以任用和提升，香港原有關於公務人員的招聘、僱用、考核、紀律、培訓和管理的制度，包括負責公務人員的任用、薪金、服務條件的專門機構，除有關給予外籍人員特權待遇的規定外，予以保留。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 103 of the Basic Law, public servants shall be appointed and promoted on the basis of their merits. Hong Kong’s original system for the recruitment, employment, assessment, discipline, training and management of public servants, including the specialized agencies responsible for the appointment, salaries and conditions of service of public servants, shall be retained except for the provisions regarding privileged treatment for foreigners.
questions.explanationZh: 答案係 B。《基本法》第 103 條明確訂明：「公務人員應根據其本人的資格、經驗和才能予以任用和提升，香港原有關於公務人員的招聘、僱用、考核、紀律、培訓和管理的制度，包括負責公務人員的任用、薪金、服務條件的專門機構，除有關給予外籍人員特權待遇的規定外，予以保留」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第一百零五條，香港特別行政區依法保護__________財產的取得、使用、處置和繼承的權利，以及依法徵用私人和法人財產時被徵用財產的所有人得到補償的權利。徵用財產的補償應相當於該財產當時的實際價值，可自由兑換，不得無故遲延支付。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 105 of the Basic Law, the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region protects the rights to acquire, use, dispose of and inherit property in accordance with the law, as well as the right to compensation for the owners of the expropriated property when private and legal person property is expropriated in accordance with the law. Compensation for expropriated property shall be equivalent to the actual value of the property at that time, shall be freely convertible, and shall not be paid without unreasonable delay.

options.labelEn: Private persons, legal persons and bodies

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 B。《基本法》第 105 條明確訂明：「香港特別行政區依法保護私人和法人財產的取得、使用、處置和繼承的權利，以及依法徵用私人和法人財產時被徵用財產的所有人得到補償的權利」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第一百三十四條，中央人民政府授權香港特別行政區政府： （一）同其他當局商談並簽訂有關執行本法第一百三十三條所指民用航空運輸協定和臨時協議的各項安排； （二）對在 __________並以香港為主要營業地的航空公司簽發執照； （三）依照本法第一百三十三條所指民用航空運輸協定和臨時協議指定航空公司； （四）對外國航空公司除往返、經停中國內地的航班以外的其他航班簽發許可證。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 134 of the Basic Law, the Central People's Government authorizes the Government of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region to: (1) negotiate with other authorities and sign various arrangements for the implementation of civil air transport agreements and interim agreements referred to in Article 133 of this Law; (2) issue licenses to airlines operating in __________ with Hong Kong as their main place of business; (3) designate airlines in accordance with the civil air transport agreements and interim agreements referred to in Article 133 of this Law; (4) Issuance of licenses to foreign airlines for flights other than flights to, from, and stopping in mainland China.

options.labelEn: With Hong Kong as the principal place of business
Registered in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

options.labelZh: 以香港為主要營業地並在香港特別行政區註冊
options.labelEn: With Hong Kong as the principal place of business and registered in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 C。《基本法》第 134 條明確訂明：「對在香港特別行政區註冊並以香港為主要營業地的航空公司簽發執照」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第一百三十七條，各類院校均可保留其 __________，可繼續從香港特別行政區以外招聘教職員和選用教材。宗教組織所辦的學校可繼續提供宗教教育，包括開設宗教課程。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 137 of the Basic Law, all types of institutions can retain their __________ and continue to recruit teaching staff and select teaching materials from outside the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region. Schools run by religious organizations may continue to provide religious education, including offering religious courses.

options.labelZh: 獨立性並享有學術自由
學術自由並享有獨立性
自主性並享有學術自由
學術自由並享有自主性

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 C。《基本法》第 137 條明確訂明：「各類院校均可保留其自主性並享有學術自由，可繼續從香港特別行政區以外招聘教職員和選用教材」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第十三條，中央人民政府負責管理與香港特別行政區有關的外交事務。 __________在香港設立機構處理外交事務。中央人民政府授權香港特別行政區依照本法自行處理有關的對外事務。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 13 of the Basic Law, the Central People's Government is responsible for the management of foreign affairs related to the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region. Establish an agency in Hong Kong to handle foreign affairs. The Central People's Government authorizes the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region to handle relevant external affairs on its own in accordance with this Law.

options.labelZh: 中華人民共和國外交部
options.labelEn: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the People's Republic of China

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 B。《基本法》第 13 條明確訂明：「中華人民共和國外交部在香港設立機構處理外交事務」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第一百五十七條，外國在香港特別行政區設立領事機構或其他官方、半官方機構，須經 __________批准。 已同中華人民共和國建立正式外交關係的國家在香港設立的領事機構和其他官方機構，可予保留。尚未同中華人民共和國建立正式外交關係的國家在香港設立的領事機構和其他官方機構，可根據情況允許保留或改為半官方機構。 尚未為中華人民共和國承認的國家，只能在香港特別行政區設立民間機構。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 157 of the Basic Law, the establishment of consular agencies or other official or semi-official agencies in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region by foreign countries must be approved by __________. Consular missions and other official agencies established in Hong Kong by countries that have established formal diplomatic relations with the People's Republic of China may be retained. Consular missions and other official missions established in Hong Kong by countries that have not yet established formal diplomatic relations with the People's Republic of China may be retained or converted into semi-official missions according to circumstances. Countries not yet recognized by the People's Republic of China can only establish private institutions in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

options.labelZh: 中華人民共和國外交部
options.labelEn: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the People's Republic of China
Government of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 B。《基本法》第 157 條明確訂明：「外國在香港特別行政區設立領事機構或其他官方、半官方機構，須經中央人民政府批准」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》附件二第七項： 政府提出的法案，如獲得出席會議的全體議員的過半數票，即為通過。立法會議員個人提出的議案、法案和對政府法案的修正案均須分別經選舉委員會選舉產生的議員和功能團體選舉、分區直接選舉產生的議員兩部分出席會議議員__________通過。
questions.questionEn: According to Item 7 of Annex 2 of the Basic Law: A bill proposed by the government shall
questions.explanationZh: 呢題已停用。題目採用已被修改的舊版《基本法》附件二分組點票安排，唔適合作為現行法例題目。為免學生背咗過時或含糊答案，課堂、題庫同模擬試都唔會再抽取呢題。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第五條，香港特別行政區不實行社會主義制度和政策，保持原有的__________，五十年不變。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 5 of the Basic Law, the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region will not implement socialist systems and policies and will maintain the original system and policies unchanged for 50 years.

options.labelZh: 資本主義制度和生活方式

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 D。《基本法》第 5 條明確訂明：「香港特別行政區不實行社會主義制度和政策，保持原有的資本主義制度和生活方式，五十年不變」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第八十五條，香港特別行政區法院獨立進行審判，不受任何干涉，司法人員 __________不受法律追究。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 85 of the Basic Law, the courts of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region conduct trials independently without any interference, and judicial officers are not subject to legal accountability.
questions.explanationZh: 答案係 C。《基本法》第 85 條明確訂明：「香港特別行政區法院獨立進行審判，不受任何干涉，司法人員履行審判職責的行為不受法律追究」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第八十七條，香港特別行政區的__________ 一中保留原在香港適用的原則和當事人享有的權利。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 87 of the Basic Law, the First Central Court of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region retains the principles originally applicable in Hong Kong and the rights enjoyed by the parties involved.

options.labelZh: 刑事訴訟、民事訴訟和行政訴訟
options.labelEn: Criminal Litigation, Civil Litigation and Administrative Litigation

options.labelZh: 刑事訴訟、行政訴訟和民事訴訟
options.labelEn: Criminal Litigation, Administrative Litigation and Civil Litigation

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 B。《基本法》第 87 條明確訂明：「香港特別行政區的刑事訴訟和民事訴訟中保留原在香港適用的原則和當事人享有的權利」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第一百一十八條，香港特別行政區政府__________，鼓勵各項投資、技術進步並開發新興產業。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 118 of the Basic Law, the Government of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region __________ encourages various investments, technological progress and the development of emerging industries.
questions.explanationZh: 答案係 A。《基本法》第 118 條明確訂明：「香港特別行政區政府提供經濟和法律環境，鼓勵各項投資、技術進步並開發新興產業」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第一百二十條，香港特別行政區成立以前已批出、決定、或續期的超越一九九七年六月三十日年期的所有土地契約和與土地契約有關的一切權利，均按香港特別行政區的法律繼續__________。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 120 of the Basic Law, all land contracts with a term beyond June 30, 1997 that have been granted, decided or renewed before the establishment of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region and all rights related to the land contracts shall continue in accordance with the laws of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.
questions.explanationZh: 答案係 D。《基本法》第 120 條明確訂明：「香港特別行政區成立以前已批出、決定、或續期的超越一九九七年六月三十日年期的所有土地契約和與土地契約有關的一切權利，均按香港特別行政區的法律繼續予以承認和保護」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第一百三十四條，中央人民政府授權香港特別行政區政府： 同其他當局商談並簽訂有關執行本法第一百三十三條所指民用航空運輸協定和臨時協議的各項安排；對在香港特別行政區註冊並以香港為主要營業地的航空公司簽發執照； 依照本法第一百三十三條所指民用航空運輸協定和臨時協議指定航空公司；對外國航空公司除__________的航班以外的其他航班簽發許可證。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 134 of the Basic Law, the Central People's Government authorizes the Government of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region to: negotiate with other authorities and sign various arrangements for the implementation of civil air transport agreements and interim agreements referred to in Article 133 of this Law; issue licenses to airlines registered in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region and with Hong Kong as their principal place of business; designate airlines in accordance with the civil air transport agreements and interim agreements referred to in Article 133 of this Law; and Permits are issued for other flights.

options.labelZh: 往返中國內地主要城市
options.labelEn: To and from major cities in Mainland China
To and from and via Mainland China

options.labelZh: 往返、經停中國內地主要城市
options.labelEn: To and from and via major cities in Mainland China

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 C。《基本法》第 134 條明確訂明：「對外國航空公司除往返、經停中國內地的航班以外的其他航班簽發許可證」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第八條，香港原有法律，即普通法、衡平法、條例、附屬立法和習慣法，除同__________，予以保留。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 8 of the Basic Law, the original laws of Hong Kong, namely common law, equity, ordinances, subsidiary legislation and customary law, shall be retained except for the same.

options.labelEn: Except as inconsistent with this law

options.labelZh: 本法相抵觸或經香港特別行政區的立法機關作出修改者外
options.labelEn: Except where this Act is inconsistent with this Act or has been amended by the legislative body of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

options.labelZh: 本法相抵觸或經全國人民代表大會常務委員會作出解釋者外
options.labelEn: Except where it conflicts with this Law or has been interpreted by the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress

options.labelZh: 本法相抵觸、或經香港特別行政區的立法機關作出修改者或經全國人民代表大會常務委員會作出解釋者外
options.labelEn: Except where this Act is in conflict with this Act or has been amended by the legislative body of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region or interpreted by the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress.

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 B。《基本法》第 8 條明確訂明：「香港原有法律，即普通法、衡平法、條例、附屬立法和習慣法，除同本法相抵觸或經香港特別行政區的立法機關作出修改者外，予以保留」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第 15 條，中央人民政府依照本法第四章的規定任命香港特別行政區__________。
questions.questionEn: According to Basic Law Article 15, The Central People's Government appoints the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region in accordance with the provisions of Chapter 4 of this Law.

options.labelZh: 行政長官、行政機關的主要官員和終審法院首席法官
options.labelEn: The Chief Executive, principal officials of the Executive and the Chief Justice of the Court of Final Appeal

options.labelZh: 行政長官、行政機關的主要官員和行政會議的成員
options.labelEn: The Chief Executive, principal officials of the Executive and members of the Executive Council

options.labelZh: 行政長官和行政機關的主要官員
options.labelEn: The Chief Executive and principal officials of the Executive

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 D。《基本法》第 15 條明確訂明：「中央人民政府依照本法第四章的規定任命香港特別行政區行政長官和行政機關的主要官員」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第二十條，香港特別行政區可享有__________授予的其他權力。
questions.questionEn: Under Article 20 of the Basic Law, the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region may enjoy other powers conferred on it.

options.labelZh: 全國人民代表大會和全國人民代表大會常務委員會
options.labelEn: National People's Congress and the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress

options.labelZh: 全國人民代表大會和全國人民代表大會常務委員會及中央人民政府
options.labelEn: National People's Congress and the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress and the Central People's Government

options.labelZh: 全國人民代表大會和中央人民政府
options.labelEn: National People's Congress and the Central People's Government

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 C。《基本法》第 20 條明確訂明：「香港特別行政區可享有全國人民代表大會和全國人民代表大會常務委員會及中央人民政府授予的其他權力」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第二十六條，香港特別行政區__________ 依法享有選舉權和被選舉權。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 26 of the Basic Law, the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region enjoys the right to vote and the right to stand for election in accordance with the law.

options.labelZh: 永久性居民和非永久性居民

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 B。《基本法》第 26 條明確訂明：「香港特別行政區永久性居民依法享有選舉權和被選舉權」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第四十四條，香港特別行政區行政長官由年滿__________ 周歲，在香港通常居住連續滿並在外國無居留權的香港特別行政區永久性居民中的中國公民擔任。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 44 of the Basic Law, the Chief Executive of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region shall be a Chinese citizen who is aged __________ or above and has been a permanent resident of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region who has ordinarily resided in Hong Kong for consecutive years and has no right of abode in a foreign country.
questions.explanationZh: 答案係 B。《基本法》第 44 條要求行政長官年滿四十周歲，並喺香港通常居住連續滿二十年；兩個數字分別係四十同二十。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第七十六條，香港特別行政區立法會通過的法案，須經 __________簽署、公佈，方能生效。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 76 of the Basic Law, bills passed by the Legislative Council of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region must be signed and promulgated by __________ before they can take effect.

options.labelEn: Chief Justice of the Court of Final Appeal

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 D。《基本法》第 76 條明確訂明：「香港特別行政區立法會通過的法案，須經行政長官簽署、公布，方能生效」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第七十九條，香港特別行政區立法會議員如有下列情況之一，由立法會主席宣告其喪失立法會議員的資格__________：
questions.questionEn: According to Article 79 of the Basic Law, a member of the Legislative Council of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region shall be declared disqualified from being a member of the Legislative Council by the President of the Legislative Council if he/she falls under any of the following circumstances:

options.labelZh: 因嚴重疾病或其他情況無力履行職務
options.labelEn: Inability to perform duties due to serious illness or other circumstances

options.labelZh: 未得到立法會主席的同意，連續二個月不出席會議
options.labelEn: Failure to attend meetings for two consecutive months without the consent of the President of the Legislative Council

options.labelZh: 在香港特別行政區區內或區外被判犯有刑事罪行， 判處監禁一個月以上
options.labelEn: Convicted of a criminal offense within or outside the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region and sentenced to imprisonment for more than one month

options.labelZh: 行為不檢或違反誓言而經立法會出席會議的議員二分之一通過譴責
options.labelEn: Misbehavior or breach of oath and has been reprimanded by one-half of the members attending the meeting of the Legislative Council

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 A。《基本法》第 79 條明確訂明：「香港特別行政區立法會議員如有下列情況之一，由立法會主席宣告其喪失立法會議員的資格： • 因嚴重疾病或其他情況無力履行職務」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第一百五十三條，中華人民共和國締結的國際協議，中央人民政府可根據香港特別行政區的情況和需要，在徵詢__________的意見後，決定是否適用於香港特別行政區。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 153 of the Basic Law, international agreements concluded by the People's Republic of China, the Central People's Government may decide whether to apply to the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region based on the circumstances and needs of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region and after consulting __________.

options.labelZh: 香港特別行政區行政長官
options.labelEn: Chief Executive of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region
Government of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

options.labelZh: 香港特別行政區行政長官和行政會議
options.labelEn: Chief Executive and the Executive Council of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 B。《基本法》第 153 條明確訂明：「中華人民共和國締結的國際協議，中央人民政府可根據香港特別行政區的情況和需要，在徵詢香港特別行政區政府的意見後，決定是否適用於香港特別行政區」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第一百五十八條，香港特別行政區法院在審理案件時對本法的其他條款也可解釋。但如香港特別行政區法院在審理案件時需要對本法關於中央人民政府管理的事務或中央和香港特別行政區關係的條款進行解釋，而該條款的解釋又影響到案件的判決，在對該案件作出不可上訴的終局判決前，應由香港特別行政區終審法院請全國人民代表大會常務委員會對有關條款作出解釋。如全國人民代表大會常務委員會作出解釋，香港特別行政區法院在引用該條款時，應以全國人民代表大會常務委員會的解釋為準。但在此以前作出的判決__________。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 158 of the Basic Law, the courts of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region may also interpret other provisions of this Law when hearing cases. However, if the courts of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region need to interpret the provisions of this Law regarding matters managed by the Central People's Government or the relationship between the Central People's Government and the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region when hearing a case, and the interpretation of such provisions affects the judgment of the case, before making a final and non-appealable judgment on the case, the Court of Final Appeal of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region shall request the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress to interpret the relevant provisions. If the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress provides an interpretation, the courts of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region shall refer to the interpretation of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress when citing this provision. But the judgment was made before that.

options.labelZh: 應以全國人民代表大會常務委員會的解釋作出修改
options.labelEn: Should be modified in accordance with the interpretation of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress

options.labelZh: 須經香港特別行政區終審法院作出修改
options.labelEn: Subject to modification by the Court of Final Appeal of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

options.labelZh: 須經香港特別行政區終審法院理解全國人民代表大會常務委員會的解釋後再作決定
options.labelEn: The Court of Final Appeal of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region must understand the interpretation of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress before making a decision

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 A。《基本法》第 158 條明確訂明：「但在此以前作出的判決不受影響」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第八條，香港原有法律，即__________法、衡平法、條例、附屬立法和習慣法，除同本法相抵觸或經香港特別行政區的立法機關作出修改者外，予以保留。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 8 of the Basic Law, the original laws of Hong Kong, namely laws, equity, ordinances, subsidiary legislation and customary laws, shall be retained unless they conflict with this law or have been amended by the legislative body of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.
questions.explanationZh: 答案係 B。《基本法》第 8 條明確訂明：「香港原有法律，即普通法、衡平法、條例、附屬立法和習慣法，除同本法相抵觸或經香港特別行政區的立法機關作出修改者外，予以保留」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第十條，香港特別行政區除懸掛中華人民共和國國旗和國徽外，還可使用香港特別行政區區旗和區徽。香港特別行政區的區旗是五星花蕊的紫荊花紅旗。香港特別行政區的區徽，中間是__________ o
questions.questionEn: According to Article 10 of the Basic Law, in addition to flying the national flag and national emblem of the People's Republic of China, the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region may also use the regional flag and regional emblem of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region. The regional flag of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region is the bauhinia red flag with five-star stamens. The regional emblem of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, with an o in the center

options.labelZh: 五星花蕊的洋金菊花，周圍寫有「中華人民共和國香港特別行政區」和英文「香港」
options.labelEn: A golden chrysanthemum with five-star stamens, surrounded by the words "People's Republic of China, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region" and "Hong Kong" in English

options.labelZh: 五星花蕊的薰衣草花，周圍寫有「中華人民共和國香港特別行政區」和英文「香港」
options.labelEn: A lavender flower with five-star stamens, surrounded by the words "People's Republic of China, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region" and "Hong Kong" in English

options.labelZh: 五星花蕊的紫荊花，周圍寫有「中華人民共和國香港特別行政區」和英文「香港」
options.labelEn: A redbud flower with five-star stamens, surrounded by the words "People's Republic of China" "Hong Kong Special Administrative Region" and "Hong Kong" in English

options.labelZh: 五星花蕊的紫丁花，周圍寫有「中華人民共和國香港特別行政區」和英文「香港」
options.labelEn: A lilac flower with five-star stamens, surrounded by the words "Hong Kong Special Administrative Region of the People's Republic of China" and "Hong Kong" in English

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 C。《基本法》第 10 條訂明，區徽中央係五星花蕊嘅紫荊花，外圍寫有「中華人民共和國香港特別行政區」同英文「香港」；只有 C 完整保留呢個式樣。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第十七條，全國人民代表大會常務委員會在徵詢其所屬的香港特別行政區基本法委員會後，如認為香港特別行政區立法機關制定的任何法律不符合本法關於中央管理的事務及中央和香港特別行政區的關係的條款， 可將有關法律__________，但不作修改。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 17 of the Basic Law, if the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress, after consulting the Basic Law Committee of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region to which it is affiliated, considers that any law enacted by the Legislature of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region is inconsistent with the provisions of this Law on matters managed by the central government and the relationship between the central government and the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, the relevant law may be amended without modification.
questions.explanationZh: 答案係 B。《基本法》第 17 條明確訂明：「全國人民代表大會常務委員會在徵詢其所屬的香港特別行政區基本法委員會後，如認為香港特別行政區立法機關制定的任何法律不符合本法關於中央管理的事務及中央和香港特別行政區的關係的條款，可將有關法律發回，但不作修改」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第十九條，香港特別行政區法院除繼續保持香港原有法律制度和原則對法院審判權所作的限制外， 對香港特別行政區所有的案件均有審判權。香港特別行政區法院對__________無管轄權。 香港特別行政區法院在審理案件中遇有涉及國防、外交等國家行為的事實問題，應取得行政長官就該等問題發出的證明文件，上述文件對法院有約束力。行政長官在發出證明文件前，須取得中央人民政府的證明書。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 19 of the Basic Law, the courts of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region have jurisdiction over all cases in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, except that they continue to maintain the restrictions on the court’s judicial power imposed by Hong Kong’s original legal system and principles. The courts of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region have no jurisdiction over . When the courts of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region encounter factual issues involving national defense, diplomacy and other state actions in hearing cases, they should obtain certification documents issued by the Chief Executive on these issues. The above documents are binding on the court. The Chief Executive must obtain a certificate from the Central People's Government before issuing certification documents.

options.labelEn: Cases between China and Hong Kong
Cases committed on the high seas
National defense, diplomacy and other state actions

options.labelZh: 上訴至國際法庭之案件
options.labelEn: Cases appealed to the International Court of Justice

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 C。《基本法》第 19 條明確訂明：「香港特別行政區法院在審理案件中遇有涉及國防、外交等國家行為的事實問題，應取得行政長官就該等問題發出的證明文件，上述文件對法院有約束力」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第二十四條，香港特別行政區居民，簡稱香港居民，包括永久性居民和非永久性居民。 香港特別行政區非永久性居民為：有資格依照香港特別行政區法律取得香港居民身分證，但沒有__________的人。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 24 of the Basic Law, residents of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, referred to as Hong Kong residents, include permanent residents and non-permanent residents. A non-permanent resident of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region is a person who is eligible to obtain a Hong Kong identity card in accordance with the laws of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, but does not have one.

options.labelZh: 資格領取房屋福利的人
資格領取綜援福利的人
options.labelEn: Persons eligible for Comprehensive Social Security Assistance
Persons with the right of abode

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 D。《基本法》第 24 條明確訂明：「香港特別行政區非永久性居民為：有資格依照香港特別行政區法律取得香港居民身份證，但沒有居留權的人」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第二十六條，香港特別行政區永久性居民依法享有__________ 權。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 26 of the Basic Law, permanent residents of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region enjoy __________ rights in accordance with the law.

options.labelEn: The right to freedom of speech
The right to vote and be elected
The right to freedom of entry and exit

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 C。《基本法》第 26 條明確訂明：「香港特別行政區永久性居民依法享有選舉權和被選舉權」。

questions.questionZh: 根據基本法第四十八條，下列哪一項不是行政長官行使的職權：
questions.questionEn: According to Article 48 of the Basic Law, which of the following is not a function exercised by the Chief Executive:

options.labelZh: 負責執行本法和依照本法適用於香港特別行政區的其他法律
options.labelEn: Responsible for the enforcement of this Law and other laws applicable to the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region in accordance with this Law
Appointment and removal of judges of courts at all levels

options.labelZh: 代表香港特別行政區政府處理中央授權的對外事務和其他事務
options.labelEn: Represent the Government of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region in handling external affairs and other matters authorized by the central government

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 A。依據《基本法》第 48 條，「聘任主要官員」唔屬於條文列明嘅職權；其餘選項先係條文涵蓋嘅內容。
questions.trapZh: 題目問排除項；要揀出唔屬於條文列明嘅職權嘅「聘任主要官員」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第四十九條，香港特別行政區行政長官如認為立法會通過的法案不符合香港特別行政區的整體利益，可在三個月內將法案發回__________重議，立法會如以不少於全體議員三分之二多數再次通過原案，行政長官必須在一個月內簽署公佈或按本法第五十條的規定處理。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 49 of the Basic Law, if the Chief Executive of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region believes that a bill passed by the Legislative Council is not in the overall interest of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, he may send the bill back for reconsideration within three months. If the Legislative Council passes the original bill again by a majority of not less than two-thirds of all members, the Chief Executive must sign and promulgate it within one month or handle it in accordance with the provisions of Article 50 of this Law.
questions.explanationZh: 答案係 B。《基本法》第 49 條明確訂明：「香港特別行政區行政長官如認為立法會通過的法案不符合香港特別行政區的整體利益，可在三個月內將法案發回立法會重議，立法會如以不少於全體議員三分之二多數再次通過原案，行政長官必須在一個月內簽署公布或按本法第五十條的規定處理」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第 60 條，香港特別行政區政府的首長是香港特別行政區行政長官。 而下列哪一位並不是香港特別行政區政府所設之職務？
questions.questionEn: According to Basic Law Article 60, The head of the government of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region is the Chief Executive of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region. Which of the following is not a position established by the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region Government?
questions.explanationZh: 答案係 D。依據《基本法》第 60 條，「布政司」唔屬於條文指定嘅職位或資格範圍；其餘選項先係條文涵蓋嘅內容。
questions.trapZh: 題目問排除項；要揀出唔屬於條文指定嘅職位或資格範圍嘅「布政司」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第七十二條，下列哪項不是香港特別行政區立法會主席所行使之職權？
questions.questionEn: According to Article 72 of the Basic Law, which of the following is not a function and power exercised by the President of the Legislative Council of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region?

options.labelEn: Decide the time of the meeting

options.labelZh: 在休會期間可召開特別會議
options.labelEn: Special meetings can be held during recess

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 C。依據《基本法》第 72 條，「審核財政預算」唔屬於條文列明嘅職權；其餘選項先係條文涵蓋嘅內容。
questions.trapZh: 題目問排除項；要揀出唔屬於條文列明嘅職權嘅「審核財政預算」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第八十九條，香港特別行政區法院的法官只有在__________或行為不檢的情況下，行政長官才可根據終審法院首席法官任命的不少於三名當地法官組成的審議庭的建議，予以免職。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 89 of the Basic Law, a judge of the courts of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region may be removed by the Chief Executive on the recommendation of a deliberative panel consisting of not less than three local judges appointed by the Chief Justice of the Court of Final Appeal only in the case of misconduct.

options.labelEn: Inappropriate remarks during the judgment of the case

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 A。《基本法》第 89 條明確訂明：「香港特別行政區法院的法官只有在無力履行職責或行為不檢的情況下，行政長官才可根據終審法院首席法官任命的不少於三名當地法官組成的審議庭的建議，予以免職」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第一百一十三條，香港特別行政區的外匯基金，由__________管理和支配，主要用於調節港元匯價。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 113 of the Basic Law, the Exchange Fund of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region is managed and controlled by the Government and is mainly used to adjust the exchange rate of the Hong Kong dollar.

options.labelEn: Government of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 C。《基本法》第 113 條明確訂明：「香港特別行政區的外匯基金，由香港特別行政區政府管理和支配，主要用於調節港元匯價」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第一百一十六條，香港特別行政區為單獨的關税地區。香港特別行政區可以__________「.」的名義參加《關稅和貿易總協定》、關於國際紡織品貿易安排等有關國際組織和國際貿易協定，包括優惠貿易安排。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 116 of the Basic Law, the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region is a separate customs territory. The Hong Kong Special Administrative Region can participate in the General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade, the International Textile Trade Arrangement and other relevant international organizations and international trade agreements, including preferential trade arrangements, in the name of "."

options.labelZh: 中華人民共和國暨香港特別行政區政府
options.labelEn: Government of the People's Republic of China and the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region
Government of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 D。《基本法》第 116 條明確訂明：「香港特別行政區可以 "中國香港" 的名義參加《關稅和貿易總協定》、關於國際紡織品貿易安排等有關國際組織和國際貿易協定，包括優惠貿易安排」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第一百五十條，香港特別行政區政府的代表，可作為中華人民共和國政府代表團的成員，參加由中央人民政府進行的同香港特別行政區直接有關的__________。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 150 of the Basic Law, representatives of the Government of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region may, as members of the delegation of the Government of the People's Republic of China, participate in meetings conducted by the Central People's Government that are directly related to the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.
questions.explanationZh: 答案係 B。《基本法》第 150 條明確訂明：「香港特別行政區政府的代表，可作為中華人民共和國政府代表團的成員，參加由中央人民政府進行的同香港特別行政區直接有關的外交談判」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第一百五十九條，基本法的修改權屬於全國人民代表大會。基本法的任何修改，均不得同 __________相扺觸。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 159 of the Basic Law, the power to amend the Basic Law belongs to the National People's Congress. No amendment to the Basic Law shall conflict with the Constitution.

options.labelEn: Constitution of the People's Republic of China

options.labelZh: 香港特別行政區普通法
options.labelEn: Common Law of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

options.labelZh: 中華人民共和國對香港既定的基本方針政策
options.labelEn: Basic principles and policies established by the People's Republic of China towards Hong Kong

options.labelZh: 香港特別行政區實施的全國性法律
options.labelEn: National laws implemented in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 C。《基本法》第 159 條明確訂明：「本法的任何修改，均不得同中華人民共和國對香港既定的基本方針政策相抵觸」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》序言第三段，根據中華人民共和國憲法， 全國人民代表大會特制定__________」，規定香港特別行政區實行的制度。
questions.questionEn: According to the third paragraph of the preamble to the Basic Law and in accordance with the Constitution of the People's Republic of China, the National People's Congress "Specially Promulgates" stipulates the system to be implemented in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

options.labelEn: Constitution of the People's Republic of China

options.labelZh: 中華人民共和國香港特別行政區基本法
options.labelEn: Basic Law of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region of the People's Republic of China

options.labelZh: 香港特別行政區回歸法
options.labelEn: Law of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region on the Return of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 B。《基本法》序言明確訂明：「根據中華人民共和國憲法，全國人民代表大會特制定中華人民共和國香港特別行政區基本法，規定香港特別行政區實行的制度，以保障國家對香港的基本方針政策的實施」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第十四條，香港特別行政區政府負責維持香港特別行政區的社會治安。 中央人民政府派駐香港特別行政區負責防務的軍隊不干預香港特別行政區的地方事務。香港特別行政區政府在必要時，可向中央人民政府請求駐軍協助__________」 °
questions.questionEn: According to Article 14 of the Basic Law, the Government of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region is responsible for maintaining public order in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region. The military forces stationed by the Central People's Government in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region to be responsible for the defense of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region shall not interfere in the local affairs of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region. The Hong Kong Special Administrative Region Government may, when necessary, request garrison assistance from the Central People's Government" °

options.labelEn: Handling one country, two systems affairs

options.labelZh: 恢復香港特別行政區秩序
options.labelEn: Restoring order in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

options.labelZh: 維持社會治安和救助災害
options.labelEn: Maintaining social order and providing disaster relief

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 D。《基本法》第 14 條明確訂明：「香港特別行政區政府在必要時，可向中央人民政府請求駐軍協助維持社會治安和救助災害」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第二十二條，中國其他地區的人進入香港特別行政區須辦理批准手續，其中進入香港特別行政區定居的人數是由__________。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 22 of the Basic Law, people from other parts of China must go through approval procedures to enter the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region. The number of people who enter the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region to settle is __________.

options.labelZh: 香港特別行政區政府決定
options.labelEn: Decision of the Government of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

options.labelZh: 全國人民代表大會常務委員會
options.labelEn: Standing Committee of the National People's Congress

options.labelZh: 中央人民政府主管部門徵求香港特別行政區政府的意見後確定
options.labelEn: Determined by the competent departments of the Central People's Government after soliciting the opinions of the Government of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 D。《基本法》第 22 條明確訂明：「中國其他地區的人進入香港特別行政區須辦理批准手續，其中進入香港特別行政區定居的人數由中央人民政府主管部門徵求香港特別行政區政府的意見後確定」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第二十三條，香港特別行政區應自行立法禁止任何叛國、分裂國家、煽動叛亂、顛覆中央人民政府及__________行為，禁止外國的政治性組織或團體在香港特別行政區進行政治活動，禁止香港特別行政區的政治性組織或團體與外國的政治性組織或團體建立聯繫。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 23 of the Basic Law, the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region shall legislate on its own to prohibit any treason, secession, sedition, subversion of the Central People's Government and acts, prohibit foreign political organizations or groups from conducting political activities in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, and prohibit political organizations or groups in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region from establishing ties with foreign political organizations or groups.
questions.explanationZh: 答案係 C。《基本法》第 23 條明確訂明：「香港特別行政區應自行立法禁止任何叛國、分裂國家、煽動叛亂、顛覆中央人民政府及竊取國家機密的行為，禁止外國的政治性組織或團體在香港特別行政區進行政治活動，禁止香港特別行政區的政治性組織或團體與外國的政治性組織或團體建立聯繫」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第三十五條，香港居民有權得到秘密法律諮詢、向法院提起訴訟、 __________或在法庭上為其代理和獲得司法補救。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 35 of the Basic Law, Hong Kong residents have the right to receive confidential legal advice, bring proceedings in court or be represented in court and obtain judicial remedies.

options.labelZh: 選擇律師及時保護自己的違法行為
options.labelEn: Choose a lawyer to protect your illegal activities in a timely manner

options.labelZh: 選擇律師及時保護自己的合法權益
options.labelEn: Choose a lawyer to protect your legitimate rights and interests in a timely manner

options.labelZh: 選擇律師提供高效率及專業法律服務
options.labelEn: Choose a lawyer to provide efficient and professional legal services

options.labelZh: 選擇律師處理民事訴訟及刑事訴訟
options.labelEn: Choose a lawyer to handle civil litigation and criminal litigation

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 B。《基本法》第 35 條明確訂明：「香港居民有權得到秘密法律諮詢、向法院提起訴訟、選擇律師及時保護自己的合法權益或在法庭上為其代理和獲得司法補救」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第 37 條，香港居民邊一項自由同權利受法律保護？
questions.questionEn: According to Basic Law Article 37, which freedom and right of Hong Kong residents are protected by law?

options.labelZh: 實行計劃生育是國家的基本國策
options.labelEn: The implementation of family planning is the basic national policy of the country

options.labelZh: 控制人口增長不至過速，鼓勵一孩政策
options.labelEn: Control the population growth from excessive speed and encourage the one-child policy

options.labelZh: 婚姻自由和自願生育的權利
options.labelEn: Freedom of marriage and the right to raise a family freely

options.labelZh: 婚姻締結是為了生育合法的兒女
options.labelEn: Marriage is concluded for the purpose of giving birth to legal children

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 C。《基本法》第 37 條明確訂明：「香港居民的婚姻自由和自願生育的權利受法律保護」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第四十四條，香港特別行政區行政長官由年滿四十周歲，在香港通常居住連續滿二十年並在 __________的香港特別行政區永久性居民中的中國公民擔任。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 44 of the Basic Law, the Chief Executive of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region shall be a Chinese citizen who is over 40 years old, has ordinarily resided in Hong Kong for not less than 20 consecutive years, and is a permanent resident of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

options.labelEn: No right of abode in foreign countries
Under the instructions of the Central People’s Government

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 C。《基本法》第 44 條明確訂明：「香港特別行政區行政長官由年滿四十周歲，在香港通常居住連續滿二十年並在外國無居留權的香港特別行政區永久性居民中的中國公民擔任」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第四十八條，下列哪一項並不是基本法規定賦予香港特別行政區行政長官所行使之職權？
questions.questionEn: According to Article 48 of the Basic Law, which of the following is not a function vested in the Chief Executive of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region under the Basic Law?

options.labelZh: 簽署立法會通過的法案，公佈法律
options.labelEn: Sign bills passed by the Legislative Council and promulgate laws

options.labelZh: 任命特別行政區之主要官員
options.labelEn: Appoint key officials of the Special Administrative Region

options.labelZh: 領導香港特別行政區政府 9. 根據《基本法》第五十三條，香港特別行政區行政長官短期不能履行職務時，由政務司長，財政司長、律政司長依次臨時代理其職務。
options.labelEn: Lead the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region Government 9. According to Article 53 of the Basic Law, when the Chief Executive of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region is unable to perform his duties for a short period of time, the Chief Secretary for Administration, the Financial Secretary, and the Secretary for Justice shall temporarily act on his behalf.

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 B。依據《基本法》第 48 條，「處理請願、申訴事項」唔屬於條文列明嘅職權；其餘選項先係條文涵蓋嘅內容。
questions.trapZh: 題目問排除項；要揀出唔屬於條文列明嘅職權嘅「處理請願、申訴事項」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第五十三條，行政長官缺位時，應在幾多個月內依照第四十五條產生新任行政長官？
questions.questionEn: Under Basic Law Article 53, within how many months must a new Chief Executive be selected in accordance with Article 45 when the office becomes vacant?
questions.explanationZh: 答案係 C。《基本法》第 53 條訂明，行政長官缺位時要喺六個月內依照第 45 條產生新任行政長官。原答案「七個月」同現行條文不符，所以改正為 C。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第七十三條，下列哪項並不是基本法規定賦予香港特別行政區立法會所行使之職權：
questions.questionEn: According to Article 73 of the Basic Law, which of the following is not a function vested in the Legislative Council of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region by the Basic Law:

options.labelZh: 根據本法規定並依照法定程序制定、修改和廢除法律
options.labelEn: Enact, amend and repeal laws in accordance with the provisions of this Law and in accordance with legal procedures

options.labelZh: 根據政府的提案，審核、通過財政預算
options.labelEn: Review and adopt the financial budget based on the government's proposals
Approval of taxation and public expenditure

options.labelZh: 向行政長官建議免除終審法院法官和高等法院首席法官的任免
options.labelEn: Recommend to the Chief Executive the removal of the judges of the Court of Final Appeal and the Chief Justice of the High Court.

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 D。依據《基本法》第 73 條，「向行政長官建議免除終審法院法官和高等法院首席法官的任免」唔屬於條文列明嘅職權；其餘選項先係條文涵蓋嘅內容。
questions.trapZh: 題目問排除項；要揀出唔屬於條文列明嘅職權嘅「向行政長官建議免除終審法院法官和高等法院首席法官的任免」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第八十六條，香港原有的陪審制度的原則__________。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 86 of the Basic Law, the original jury system in Hong Kong is based on the principles.
questions.explanationZh: 答案係 C。《基本法》第 86 條明確訂明：「原在香港實行的陪審制度的原則予以保留」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第一百零五條，香港特別行政區依法保護私人和法人財產的取得、使用、處置和繼承的權利，以及依法徵用私人和法人財產時被徵用財產的所有人得到補償的權利。 徵用財產的補償應相當於該財產當時的__________，可自由兌換，不得無故遲延支付。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 105 of the Basic Law, the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region shall protect in accordance with the law the rights of private persons and legal persons to acquire, use, dispose of and inherit property, as well as the right of owners of the expropriated property to receive compensation when private and legal persons’ property is expropriated in accordance with the law. Compensation for expropriated property shall be equivalent to the current value of the property, shall be freely convertible, and shall not be paid without unreasonable delay.

options.labelZh: 土地使用價值後才作出徵用補償
options.labelEn: Compensation for expropriation is made after the land use value

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 D。《基本法》第 105 條明確訂明：「徵用財產的補償應相當於該財產當時的實際價值，可自由兌換，不得無故遲延支付」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第一百一十九條，香港特別行政區政府制定適當政策，促進和協調製造業、商業、旅遊業、房地產業、運輸業、公用事業、服務性行業、漁農業等各行業的發展，並注意__________
questions.questionEn: In accordance with Article 119 of the Basic Law, the Government of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region formulates appropriate policies to promote and coordinate the development of manufacturing, commerce, tourism, real estate, transportation, public utilities, service industries, fisheries and agriculture and other industries, and pay attention to
questions.explanationZh: 答案係 A。《基本法》第 119 條明確訂明：「香港特別行政區政府制定適當政策，促進和協調製造業、商業、旅遊業、房地產業、運輸業、公用事業、服務性行業、漁農業等各行業的發展，並注意環境保護」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第一百五十七條，下列哪一項陳述並不正確？ 外國在香港特別行政區設立領事機構或其他官方、半官方機構，須經中央人民政府批准。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 157 of the Basic Law, which of the following statements is incorrect? The establishment of consular missions or other official or semi-official missions by foreign countries in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region must be approved by the Central People's Government.

options.labelZh: 已同中華人民共和國建立正式外交關係的國家在香港設立的領事機構和其他官方機構，可予保留
options.labelEn: Consular missions and other official agencies established in Hong Kong by countries that have established formal diplomatic relations with the People's Republic of China may be retained

options.labelZh: 尚未同中華人民共和國建立正式外交關係的國家在香港設立的領事機構和其他官方機構，可根據情況允許保留或改為半官方機構
options.labelEn: Consular missions and other official agencies established in Hong Kong by countries that have not yet established formal diplomatic relations with the People's Republic of China may be allowed to retain or be changed to semi-official agencies according to the circumstances

options.labelZh: 尚未為中華人民共和國承認的國家，只能在香港特別行政區設立民間機構
options.labelEn: Countries that have not been recognized by the People's Republic of China can only establish private institutions in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

options.labelZh: 尚未為中華人民共和國承認的國家，只能在香港特別行政區設立民間組織或團體
options.labelEn: Countries that have not been recognized by the People's Republic of China can only set up private institutions in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region Establish non-governmental organizations or groups in different administrative regions

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 D。依據《基本法》第 157 條，「尚未為中華人民共和國承認的國家，只能在香港特別行政區設立民間組織或團體」唔屬於符合條文原意嘅陳述；其餘選項先係條文涵蓋嘅內容。
questions.trapZh: 題目問排除項；要揀出唔屬於符合條文原意嘅陳述嘅「尚未為中華人民共和國承認的國家，只能在香港特別行政區設立民間組織或團體」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第一百五十八條，《基本法》的解釋權屬於全國人民代表大會常務委員會。 如全國人民代表大會常務委員會對《基本法》作出解釋， 香港特別行政區法院在引用該條款時，應以全國人民代表大會常務委員會的解釋為準。但在此以前作出的判決__________。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 158 of the Basic Law, the power to interpret the Basic Law belongs to the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress. If the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress interprets the Basic Law, the courts of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region shall refer to the interpretation of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress when citing this provision. But the judgment was made before that.

options.labelZh: 應以全國人民代表大會常務委員會的解釋作出修改
options.labelEn: Should be modified in accordance with the interpretation of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress

options.labelZh: 須經香港特別行政區終審法院作出修改
options.labelEn: Subject to modification by the Court of Final Appeal of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

options.labelZh: 須經香港特別行政區立法會根據全國人民代表大會常務委員會的解釋後再作決定
options.labelEn: Subject to the Legislative Council of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region making a decision based on the interpretation of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 A。《基本法》第 158 條明確訂明：「但在此以前作出的判決不受影響」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第四十一條，香港特別行政區依法保障 __________的權利和自由。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 41 of the Basic Law, the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region protects the rights and freedoms of people in accordance with the law.

options.labelZh: 香港特別行政區境內的市民和其他人
options.labelEn: Citizens and other persons within the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

options.labelZh: 香港特別行政區境內的居民和遊客
options.labelEn: Residents and visitors within the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

options.labelZh: 香港特別行政區境內的居民以外的其他人
options.labelEn: Persons other than residents within the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

options.labelZh: 香港特別行政區境內的永久性居民和其他人
options.labelEn: Permanent residents and other persons within the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 C。《基本法》第 41 條保障身處香港境內、但並非香港居民嘅其他人，依法享有本章所列嘅權利同自由。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第十七條，全國人民代表大會常務委員會在徵詢其所屬的香港特別行政區基本法委員會後，如認為香港特別行政區立法機關制定的任何法律不符合本法關於中央管理的事務及中央和香港特別行政區的關係的條款， 可將有關法律 __________，但不作修改。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 17 of the Basic Law, if the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress, after consulting the Basic Law Committee of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region to which it is affiliated, considers that any law enacted by the Legislature of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region is inconsistent with the provisions of this Law on matters managed by the central government and the relationship between the central government and the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, it may amend the relevant law without making any changes.
questions.explanationZh: 答案係 C。《基本法》第 17 條明確訂明：「全國人民代表大會常務委員會在徵詢其所屬的香港特別行政區基本法委員會後，如認為香港特別行政區立法機關制定的任何法律不符合本法關於中央管理的事務及中央和香港特別行政區的關係的條款，可將有關法律發回，但不作修改」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第十八條，如香港決定宣布戰爭狀態或因香港特別行政區內發生不能控制的危及國家統一或安全的動亂而決定香港特別行政區進入緊急狀態，下列哪一個機構可發布命令將有關全國性法律在香港特別行政區實施？
questions.questionEn: According to Article 18 of the Basic Law, if Hong Kong decides to declare a state of war or enter a state of emergency due to uncontrollable unrest in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region that threatens national unity or security, which of the following agencies can issue an order to implement relevant national laws in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region?

options.labelZh: 外交部駐港特派員公署
options.labelEn: Office of the Commissioner of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs in Hong Kong

options.labelZh: 全國人民代表大會常務委員會
options.labelEn: Standing Committee of the National People's Congress

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 B。《基本法》第 18 條明確訂明：「全國人民代表大會常務委員會決定宣布戰爭狀態或因香港特別行政區內發生香港特別行政區政府不能控制的危及國家統一或安全的動亂而決定香港特別行政區進入緊急狀態，中央人民政府可發布命令將有關全國性法律在香港特別行政區實施」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第二十三條，香港特別行政區應自行立法禁止任何叛國、分裂國家、煽動叛亂、顛覆中央人民政府及竊取國家機密的行為，禁止外國的政治性組織或團體在香港特別行政區進行政治活動，禁止__________ 建立聯繫。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 23 of the Basic Law, the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region shall legislate on its own to prohibit any act of treason, secession, sedition, subversion of the Central People's Government and theft of state secrets, prohibit foreign political organizations or groups from conducting political activities in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, and prohibit the establishment of contacts.

options.labelZh: 香港特別行政區的商業性組織或團體與外國的政治性組織或團體建立聯繫
options.labelEn: Commercial organizations or groups in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region establish ties with foreign political organizations or groups

options.labelZh: 香港特別行政區的政治性組織或團體與外國的政治性組織或團體建立聯繫
options.labelEn: Political organizations or groups in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region establish ties with foreign political organizations or groups

options.labelZh: 香港特別行政區的政治性組織或團體與外國的教育性組織或團體建立聯繫
options.labelEn: Political organizations or groups in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region establish ties with foreign educational organizations or groups

options.labelZh: 香港特別行政區的地區性組織或團體與外國的政治性組織或團體建立聯繫
options.labelEn: Regional organizations or groups in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region establish ties with foreign political organizations or groups

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 B。《基本法》第 23 條明確訂明：「香港特別行政區應自行立法禁止任何叛國、分裂國家、煽動叛亂、顛覆中央人民政府及竊取國家機密的行為，禁止外國的政治性組織或團體在香港特別行政區進行政治活動，禁止香港特別行政區的政治性組織或團體與外國的政治性組織或團體建立聯繫」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第二十四條，香港特別行政區居民，簡稱香港居民，包括__________：
questions.questionEn: According to Article 24 of the Basic Law, residents of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, referred to as Hong Kong residents, include:

options.labelZh: 永久性居民和非永久性居民
按指定計劃安排獲准來港的人士
options.labelEn: Persons admitted to Hong Kong under designated arrangements

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 C。《基本法》第 24 條明確訂明：「香港特別行政區居民，簡稱香港居民，包括永久性居民和非永久性居民」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第三十條，下列哪項不是香港居民的基本權利和自由？
questions.questionEn: According to Article 30 of the Basic Law, which of the following is not a basic right and freedom of Hong Kong residents?
questions.explanationZh: 答案係 A。依據《基本法》第 30 條，「退休保障計劃」唔屬於條文保障嘅權利或自由；其餘選項先係條文涵蓋嘅內容。
questions.trapZh: 題目問排除項；要揀出唔屬於條文保障嘅權利或自由嘅「退休保障計劃」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第四十五條，香港特別行政區行政長官在當地通過選舉或協商產生，由中央人民政府任命。行政長官的產生辦法根據香港特別行政區的實際情況和循序漸進的原則而規定，最終達至由一個有廣泛代表性的提名委員會按 __________程序提名後普選產生的目標。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 45 of the Basic Law, the Chief Executive of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region is elected locally through election or consultation and appointed by the Central People's Government. The method for selecting the Chief Executive is stipulated based on the actual situation of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region and the principle of gradualism, and ultimately achieves the goal of being elected by universal suffrage after nomination by a broadly representative nomination committee in accordance with the procedures.
questions.explanationZh: 答案係 C。《基本法》第 45 條明確訂明：「行政長官的產生辦法根據香港特別行政區的實際情況和循序漸進的原則而規定，最終達至由一個有廣泛代表性的提名委員會按民主程序提名後普選產生的目標」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第五十六條，行政長官在作下列哪項決策時，須徵詢行政會議的意見？
questions.questionEn: According to Article 56 of the Basic Law, the Chief Executive must consult the Executive Council when making which of the following decisions?

options.labelZh: 緊急情況下採取的措施
options.labelEn: Measures to be taken in emergency situations

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 D。《基本法》第 56 條明確訂明：「行政長官在作出重要決策、向立法會提交法案、制定附屬法規和解散立法會前，須徵詢行政會議的意見，但人事任免、紀律制裁和緊急情況下採取的措施除外」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第八十九條，香港特別行政區終審法院的首席法官，只有在下列哪個情況下，行政長官才可以予以免職？
questions.questionEn: According to Article 89 of the Basic Law, the Chief Justice of the Court of Final Appeal of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region can be removed by the Chief Executive only under which of the following circumstances?

options.labelZh: 行政長官可以任命不少於五名當地法官組成的審議庭進行審議，並可根據其建議，予以免職。
options.labelEn: The Chief Executive may appoint a review tribunal consisting of no less than five local judges to review the case and may remove the judge based on its recommendation.

options.labelZh: 行政長官在徵得立法會同意後，並報全國人民代表大會常務委員會備案，可予以免職。
options.labelEn: The Chief Executive may be removed from office after obtaining the consent of the Legislative Council and reporting to the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress for the record.

options.labelZh: 無力履行職責或行為不檢
options.labelEn: Inability to perform duties or misconduct

options.labelZh: 行政長官可以根據行政程序，予以免職。
options.labelEn: The Chief Executive may be removed from office in accordance with administrative procedures.

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 C。《基本法》第 89 條只容許喺終審法院首席法官無力履行職責或行為不檢時啟動免職程序。行政長官唔可以單靠一般行政程序將首席法官免職。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第九十七條，下列哪一項並不是香港特別行政區內「非政權性的區域組織」，接受香港特別行政區政府就有關地區管理和其他事務的諮詢，所負責提供的__________服務？
questions.questionEn: According to Article 97 of the Basic Law, which of the following is not a service provided by a "non-governmental regional organization" within the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region that receives consultation from the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region government on relevant regional management and other matters?
questions.explanationZh: 答案係 D。依據《基本法》第 97 條，「勞工運輸」唔屬於題目所問嘅法定範圍；其餘選項先係條文涵蓋嘅內容。
questions.trapZh: 題目問排除項；要揀出唔屬於題目所問嘅法定範圍嘅「勞工運輸」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第一百一十三條，香港特別行政區的外匯基金，由香港特別行政區政府管理和支配，主要用於__________：
questions.questionEn: According to Article 113 of the Basic Law, the Exchange Fund of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region is managed and controlled by the Government of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region. It is mainly used for:

options.labelZh: 操控境外資產的規範運作
options.labelEn: Control the standardized operation of overseas assets
Strategic investment in the futures market
Purchase treasury bonds of other countries
Adjust the exchange rate of the Hong Kong dollar

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 D。《基本法》第 113 條明確訂明：「香港特別行政區的外匯基金，由香港特別行政區政府管理和支配，主要用於調節港元匯價」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第一百二十六條，除__________進入香港特別行政區須經中央人民政府特別許可外，其他船舶可根據香港特別行政區法律進出其港口。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 126 of the Basic Law, except that entry into the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region requires special permission from the Central People's Government, other ships may enter or leave its ports in accordance with the laws of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.
questions.explanationZh: 答案係 D。《基本法》第 126 條明確訂明：「除外國軍用船隻進入香港特別行政區須經中央人民政府特別許可外，其他船舶可根據香港特別行政區法律進出其港口」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第一百五十八條，香港特別行政區法院在審理案件時對基本法關於香港特別行政區自治範圍內的條款可以自行解釋，原因是：
questions.questionEn: According to Article 158 of the Basic Law, the courts of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region can interpret the provisions of the Basic Law within the scope of autonomy of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region on their own when hearing cases for the following reasons:

options.labelZh: 香港特別行政區法院享有獨立的司法管轄權
options.labelEn: The courts of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region enjoy independent jurisdiction

options.labelZh: 實現一個國家，兩種制度的方針
options.labelEn: Realize the policy of one country, two systems
Demonstrate a high degree of autonomy

options.labelZh: 獲得全國人民代表大會常務委員會之授權
options.labelEn: Obtain the authorization from the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 D。《基本法》第 158 條明確寫明，全國人大常委會授權香港法院喺審理案件時自行解釋自治範圍內嘅條款；權力來源係全國人大常委會嘅授權。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第一百五十七條，外國在香港特別行政區設立領事機構或其他官方，半官方機構，須經__________批准。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 157 of the Basic Law, the establishment of consular agencies or other official or semi-official agencies in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region by foreign countries must obtain approval.

options.labelEn: Government of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

options.labelZh: 外交部駐香港特別行政區特派員公署
options.labelEn: Office of the Commissioner of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 C。《基本法》第 157 條明確訂明：「外國在香港特別行政區設立領事機構或其他官方、半官方機構，須經中央人民政府批准」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第一百四十九條，下列哪一項，香港特別行政區是不可以自行參與？
questions.questionEn: According to Article 149 of the Basic Law, in which of the following items can the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region not participate on its own initiative?
questions.explanationZh: 答案係 C。依據《基本法》第 149 條，「環保項目」唔屬於題目所問嘅法定範圍；其餘選項先係條文涵蓋嘅內容。
questions.trapZh: 題目問排除項；要揀出唔屬於題目所問嘅法定範圍嘅「環保項目」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》序言第三段，全國人民代表大會制定__________，規定香港特別行政區實行的制度，以保障國家對香港的基本方針政策的實施。
questions.questionEn: According to the third paragraph of the preamble to the Basic Law, the National People's Congress formulated and stipulated the system to be implemented in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region to ensure the implementation of the country's basic principles and policies for Hong Kong.

options.labelEn: Laws of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

options.labelZh: 中華人民共和國香港特別行政區基本法
options.labelEn: Basic Law of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region of the People's Republic of China

options.labelZh: 中華人民共和國香港特別行政區憲法
options.labelEn: Constitution of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region of the People's Republic of China

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 C。《基本法》序言明確訂明：「根據中華人民共和國憲法，全國人民代表大會特制定中華人民共和國香港特別行政區基本法，規定香港特別行政區實行的制度，以保障國家對香港的基本方針政策的實施」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第三條，香港特別行政區的行政機關和立法機關是由__________ 照本法有關規定組成。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 3 of the Basic Law, the administrative organs and legislative organs of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region are composed of __________ in accordance with the relevant provisions of this Law.

options.labelZh: 香港永久性居民和非永久性居民
options.labelEn: Hong Kong permanent residents and non-permanent residents

options.labelZh: 香港永久性居民和非永久性公民
options.labelEn: Hong Kong permanent residents and non-permanent citizens

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 C。《基本法》第 3 條明確訂明：「香港特別行政區的行政機關和立法機關由香港永久性居民依照本法有關規定組成」。

questions.questionZh: 列於《基本法》附件三之法律，根據《基本法》第十八條，全國人民代表大會常務委員會徵詢其所屬的後， 可對列於《基本法》附件三的法律作出增減？
questions.questionEn: Regarding the laws listed in Annex III of the Basic Law, according to Article 18 of the Basic Law, the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress may make additions or deletions to the laws listed in Annex III of the Basic Law after consulting its affiliated organizations.

options.labelZh: 香港特別行政區政府的意見
options.labelEn: Opinions of the Government of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

options.labelZh: 香港特別行政區立法會的意見
options.labelEn: Opinions of the Legislative Council of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

options.labelZh: 香港特別行政區行政會議的意見
options.labelEn: Opinions of the Executive Council of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

options.labelZh: 香港特別行政區基本法委員會和香港特別行政區政府的意見
options.labelEn: Opinions of the Basic Law Committee of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region and the Government of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 D。《基本法》附件三喺呢個位置採用嘅內容係「香港特別行政區基本法委員會和香港特別行政區政府的意見」；放返入題幹後，法律關係先完整同準確。其他選項會改變指定嘅權力主體。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第二十四條，香港特別行政區居民，簡稱香港居民，包括__________：
questions.questionEn: According to Article 24 of the Basic Law, residents of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, referred to as Hong Kong residents, include:

options.labelZh: 永久性居民和非永久性居民
按指定計劃安排獲准來港的人士
options.labelEn: Persons admitted to Hong Kong under designated arrangements

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 C。《基本法》第 24 條明確訂明：「香港特別行政區居民，簡稱香港居民，包括永久性居民和非永久性居民」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第三十一條，下列哪項並不是香港居民有在香港特別行政區境內所享有的自由？
questions.questionEn: According to Article 31 of the Basic Law, which of the following is not a freedom that Hong Kong residents enjoy within the territory of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region?

options.labelZh: 移居其他國家和地區的自由
options.labelEn: Freedom of movement to other countries and regions
Freedom of travel and entry and exit

options.labelZh: 在香港特別行政區境內遷徙的自由
options.labelEn: Freedom of movement within the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

options.labelZh: 離開香港特別行政區，需要獲得批准
options.labelEn: Approval required to leave the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 D。依據《基本法》第 31 條，「離開香港特別行政區，需要獲得批准」唔屬於條文保障嘅權利或自由；其餘選項先係條文涵蓋嘅內容。
questions.trapZh: 題目問排除項；要揀出唔屬於條文保障嘅權利或自由嘅「離開香港特別行政區，需要獲得批准」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第四十八條，香港特別行政區行政長官不可以行使下列哪項職權？
questions.questionEn: According to Article 48 of the Basic Law, the Chief Executive of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region may not exercise which of the following powers?

options.labelZh: 批准向立法會提出有關財政收入或支出的動議
options.labelEn: Approving motions to the Legislative Council regarding revenue or expenditure

options.labelZh: 根據安全和重大公共利益的考慮，決定政府官員或其他負責政府公務的人員是否向立法會或其屬下的委員會作證和提供證據
options.labelEn: Deciding whether government officials or other persons responsible for government duties shall testify and provide evidence to the Legislative Council or its committees based on considerations of security and major public interests

options.labelZh: 赦免或減輕刑事罪犯的刑罰
options.labelEn: Pardon or reduce the sentences of criminal offenders

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 D。依據《基本法》第 48 條，「處理防務及外交事務」唔屬於條文列明嘅職權；其餘選項先係條文涵蓋嘅內容。
questions.trapZh: 題目問排除項；要揀出唔屬於條文列明嘅職權嘅「處理防務及外交事務」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第六十四條，下列哪項並不是香港特別行政區政府必須遵守的法律？
questions.questionEn: According to Article 64 of the Basic Law, which of the following is not a law that the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region Government must abide by?

options.labelZh: 執行立法會通過並已生效的法律
options.labelEn: Implement laws passed by the Legislative Council and have taken effect

options.labelZh: 定期向立法會作施政報告
options.labelEn: Make policy addresses to the Legislative Council on a regular basis

options.labelZh: 答覆立法會議員的質詢
options.labelEn: Respond to questions from Legislative Council members

options.labelZh: 徵税和公共開支須無需經立法會批准 8.1
options.labelEn: Taxation and public expenditure are not subject to the approval of the Legislative Council 8.1

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 D。依據《基本法》第 64 條，「徵税和公共開支須無需經立法會批准 8.1」唔屬於題目所問嘅法定範圍；其餘選項先係條文涵蓋嘅內容。
questions.trapZh: 題目問排除項；要揀出唔屬於題目所問嘅法定範圍嘅「徵税和公共開支須無需經立法會批准 8.1」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第六十七條，香港特別行政區立法會由在外國無居留權的香港特別行政區永久性居民中的中國公民組成。但非中國籍的香港特別行政區永久性居民和在外國有居留權的香港特別行政區永久性居民也可以當選為香港特別行政區立法會議員，其所估比例不得超過立法會全體議員的__________。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 67 of the Basic Law, the Legislative Council of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region is composed of Chinese citizens who are permanent residents of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region with no right of abode in foreign countries. However, permanent residents of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region who are not of Chinese nationality and permanent residents of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region who have the right of abode in foreign countries may also be elected as members of the Legislative Council of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, and their estimated proportion shall not exceed that of all members of the Legislative Council.
questions.explanationZh: 答案係 B。《基本法》第 67 條明確訂明：「但非中國籍的香港特別行政區永久性居民和在外國有居留權的香港特別行政區永久性居民也可以當選為香港特別行政區立法會議員，其所佔比例不得超過立法會全體議員的百分之二十」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第七十二條，下列哪項並不是香港特別行政區立法會主席所行使之職權？
questions.questionEn: According to Article 72 of the Basic Law, which of the following is not a function and power exercised by the President of the Legislative Council of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region?

options.labelZh: 在休會期間可召開特別會議
options.labelEn: Special meetings may be held during adjournments

options.labelZh: 應行政長官的要求召開緊急會議
options.labelEn: Convene emergency meetings at the request of the Chief Executive

options.labelZh: 制定政府政策及發出行政命令
