options.labelEn: Formulate government policies and issue administrative orders

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 D。依據《基本法》第 72 條，「制定政府政策及發出行政命令」唔屬於條文列明嘅職權；其餘選項先係條文涵蓋嘅內容。
questions.trapZh: 題目問排除項；要揀出唔屬於條文列明嘅職權嘅「制定政府政策及發出行政命令」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第八十九條，香港特別行政區法院的法官只有在下列哪項情況，才予以免職？
questions.questionEn: According to Article 89 of the Basic Law, judges of the courts of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region can only be removed from office under which of the following circumstances?

options.labelZh: 放棄永久性居民的身份

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 C。《基本法》第 89 條明確訂明：「香港特別行政區法院的法官只有在無力履行職責或行為不檢的情況下，行政長官才可根據終審法院首席法官任命的不少於三名當地法官組成的審議庭的建議，予以免職」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第一百零五條，下列哪項是香港特別行政區依法徵用私人和法人財產時被徵用財產的所有人應得到補償的權利？
questions.questionEn: According to Article 105 of the Basic Law, which of the following is the right of the owner of the expropriated property to be compensated when the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region expropriates private and legal person property in accordance with the law?

options.labelZh: 徵用財產的補償應相當於該財產當時的潛在價值
options.labelEn: Compensation for requisitioned property shall be equivalent to the potential value of the property at that time

options.labelZh: 徵用財產的補償不得無故遲延支付
options.labelEn: Compensation for requisitioned property shall not be paid with unreasonable delay

options.labelZh: 徵用財產的補償，需要繳付1%的税項與香港特別行政區政府
options.labelEn: Compensation for requisitioned property shall be subject to a 1% tax with the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region Government

options.labelZh: 徵用財產的補償，不得自由兑換
options.labelEn: Compensation for requisitioned property shall not be freely convertible

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 B。《基本法》第 105 條訂明，徵用財產嘅補償要按實際價值計算、可以自由兌換，而且不得無故遲延支付；B 直接符合最後一項保障。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第一百五十一條，下列哪一項，香港特別行政區並不可以單獨地同世界各國、各地區及有關國際組織保持和發展關係，簽訂和履行有關協議？
questions.questionEn: According to Article 151 of the Basic Law, in which of the following items, the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region cannot independently maintain and develop relations, sign and perform relevant agreements with countries, regions and relevant international organizations around the world?
questions.explanationZh: 答案係 C。依據《基本法》第 151 條，「民生」唔屬於題目所問嘅法定範圍；其餘選項先係條文涵蓋嘅內容。
questions.trapZh: 題目問排除項；要揀出唔屬於題目所問嘅法定範圍嘅「民生」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第一百五十三條，中華人民共和國締結的國際協議，中央人民政府可根據香港特別行政區的情況和需要，在徵詢. __________的意見後，決定是否適用於香港特別行政區。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 153 of the Basic Law, international agreements concluded by the People's Republic of China, the Central People's Government may decide whether to apply to the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region based on the circumstances and needs of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region and after consulting the .__________

options.labelZh: 香港特別行政區行政長官
options.labelEn: Chief Executive of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region
Government of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 B。《基本法》第 153 條明確訂明：「中華人民共和國締結的國際協議，中央人民政府可根據香港特別行政區的情況和需要，在徵詢香港特別行政區政府的意見後，決定是否適用於香港特別行政區」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第一百五十八條，全國人民代表大會常務委員會授權香港特別行政區法院在審理案件時對本法關於香港特別行政區自治範圍內的條款自行解釋。但如香港特別行政區法院在審理案件時需要對本法關於中央人民政府管理的事務或中央和香港特別行政區關係的條款進行解釋，而該條款的解釋又影響到案件的判決，在對該案件作出不可上訴的終局判決前，應由香港特別行政區終審法院請全國人民代表大會常務委員會對有關條款作出解釋。如全國人民代表大會常務委員會作出解釋，香港特別行政區法院在引用該條款時，應以全國人民代表大會常務委員會的解釋為準。但在此以前作出的判決__________？
questions.questionEn: According to Article 158 of the Basic Law, the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress authorizes the courts of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region to interpret the provisions of this Law within the scope of autonomy of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region on their own when hearing cases. However, if the courts of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region need to interpret the provisions of this Law regarding matters managed by the Central People's Government or the relationship between the Central People's Government and the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region when hearing a case, and the interpretation of such provisions affects the judgment of the case, before making a final and non-appealable judgment on the case, the Court of Final Appeal of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region shall request the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress to interpret the relevant provisions. If the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress provides an interpretation, the courts of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region shall refer to the interpretation of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress when citing this provision. But the verdict passed before that?

options.labelZh: 應以全國人民代表大會常務委員會的解釋作出修改
options.labelEn: Should be modified in accordance with the interpretation of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress

options.labelZh: 須經香港特別行政區終審法院作出修改
options.labelEn: Subject to modification by the Court of Final Appeal of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

options.labelZh: 須經香港特別行政區終審法院理解全國人民代表大會常務委員會的解釋後再作決定
options.labelEn: The Court of Final Appeal of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region must understand the interpretation of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress before making a decision

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 A。《基本法》第 158 條明確訂明：「但在此以前作出的判決不受影響」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》附件一，香港特別行政區行政長官的產生辦法是由一個具有廣泛代表性的選舉委員會根據本法選出，由中央人民政府任命。選舉委員會委員共1500人，由工商、金融界、專業界、勞工、宗教等界，立法會議員、 地區組織代表，以及 __________人士所組成？
questions.questionEn: According to Annex 1 of the Basic Law, the Chief Executive of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region is selected by a broadly representative Election Committee in accordance with this Law and appointed by the Central People's Government. The Election Committee has a total of 1,500 members, composed of industrial and commercial, financial, professional, labor, religious and other sectors, members of the Legislative Council, representatives of regional organizations, and __________ people?

options.labelZh: 香港地區政黨的組織代表
options.labelEn: Organizational representatives of political parties in Hong Kong

options.labelZh: 新界鄉村土地原居民的組織代表
options.labelEn: Organizational representatives of aboriginal residents of rural lands in the New Territories

options.labelZh: 香港區議會的組織代表
options.labelEn: Organizational representatives of Hong Kong District Councils

options.labelZh: 香港特別行政區全國人大代表、香港特別行政區全國政協委員和有關全國性團體香港成員的代表界
options.labelEn: Representative circles of representatives to the National People’s Congress of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, members of the National Committee of the Chinese People’s Political Consultative Conference of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region and Hong Kong members of relevant national organizations

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 D。《基本法》附件一明確訂明：「第五界別是香港特別行政區全國人大代表、香港特別行政區全國政協委員和有關全國性團體香港成員的代表界」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第七條，香港特別行政區的土地和自然資源收入？
questions.questionEn: According to Article 7 of the Basic Law, revenue from land and natural resources of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region?

options.labelEn: Need to be turned over to the central government

options.labelZh: 部份收益需要上繳中央
options.labelEn: Part of the income needs to be turned over to the central government

options.labelZh: 不需要上繳中央，除非是售賣土地的收益
options.labelEn: There is no need to turn over to the central government, unless it is the income from the sale of land
There is no need to turn over to the central government

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 D。《基本法》第 7 條訂明，土地同自然資源所得收入全歸香港特區政府支配，並冇售地收益要上繳中央嘅例外。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第十條，香港特別行政區的區旗是__________？
questions.questionEn: According to Article 10 of the Basic Law, what is the regional flag of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region?

options.labelZh: 五星花蕊的紫荊花紅旗
options.labelEn: The red flag of Bauhinia flower with five-star stamens

options.labelZh: 六星花蕊的紫荊花紅旗
options.labelEn: The red flag of Bauhinia flower with six-star stamens

options.labelZh: 五金星型花蕊的紫荊花紅旗
options.labelEn: The red flag of Bauhinia flower with five-star-shaped stamens

options.labelZh: 六金星型花蕊的紫荊花紅旗
options.labelEn: The red flag of Bauhinia flower with six-gold star-shaped stamens

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 A。《基本法》第 10 條明確訂明：「香港特別行政區的區旗是五星花蕊的紫荊花紅旗」。

questions.questionZh: 下列哪一條列於《基本法》附件三之全國性法律，並不會在香港特別行政區實施？
questions.questionEn: Which of the following is a national law listed in Annex 3 of the Basic Law and will not be implemented in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region?

options.labelEn: "Flag Law of the People's Republic of China"
"National Constitution of the People's Republic of China"

options.labelZh: 《關於中華人民共和國國慶日的決議》
options.labelEn: "Resolution on the National Day of the People's Republic of China"

options.labelZh: 《中華人民共和國專屬經濟區和大陸架法》
options.labelEn: "Law of the People's Republic of China on the Exclusive Economic Zone and Continental Shelf"

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 B。依據《基本法》附件三，「《中華人民共和國國家憲法》」唔屬於附件三現行全國性法律名單；其餘選項先係條文涵蓋嘅內容。
questions.trapZh: 題目問排除項；要揀出唔屬於附件三現行全國性法律名單嘅「《中華人民共和國國家憲法》」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第二十三條，以下哪一條不是香港特別行政區應自行立法禁止：
questions.questionEn: According to Article 23 of the Basic Law, which of the following is not prohibited by the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region by its own legislation:

options.labelEn: Subversion of the Central People's Government

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 C。依據《基本法》第 23 條，「危及國家安全」唔屬於題目所問嘅法定範圍；其餘選項先係條文涵蓋嘅內容。
questions.trapZh: 題目問排除項；要揀出唔屬於題目所問嘅法定範圍嘅「危及國家安全」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第三十五條，下列哪項並不是香港居民可以享有的權利？
questions.questionEn: According to Article 35 of the Basic Law, which of the following is not a right enjoyed by Hong Kong residents?

options.labelZh: 選擇律師保護自己的違法行為
options.labelEn: Choose a lawyer to protect your illegal behavior

options.labelZh: 有權對政府行政部門和行政人員的行為向法院提起訴訟
options.labelEn: The right to file a lawsuit in court against the actions of government administrative departments and administrative personnel

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 C。依據《基本法》第 35 條，「選擇律師保護自己的違法行為」唔屬於條文保障嘅權利或自由；其餘選項先係條文涵蓋嘅內容。
questions.trapZh: 題目問排除項；要揀出唔屬於條文保障嘅權利或自由嘅「選擇律師保護自己的違法行為」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第四十條，新界原居民的__________權益會受香港特別行政區的哪些條例保護？
questions.questionEn: According to Article 40 of the Basic Law, what regulations of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region will protect the rights and interests of the indigenous residents of the New Territories?

options.labelEn: According to the laws of the Qing Dynasty

options.labelZh: 根據中華人民共和國憲法
options.labelEn: According to the Constitution of the People's Republic of China
According to legitimate traditional rights and interests

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 D。《基本法》第 40 條保障嘅係新界原居民嘅「合法傳統權益」；題目並唔係問由邊一條其他法例提供保障。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第四十五條，香港特別行政區的行政長官是由誰任命？
questions.questionEn: According to Article 45 of the Basic Law, who appoints the Chief Executive of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region?
questions.explanationZh: 答案係 B。《基本法》第 45 條明確訂明：「香港特別行政區行政長官在當地通過選舉或協商產生，由中央人民政府任命」。
questions.trapZh: 唔好交換權力主體；條文指定嘅係「中央人民政府」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第四十八條，下列哪項並不是香港特別行政區行政長官所行使的職權？
questions.questionEn: According to Article 48 of the Basic Law, which of the following is not a function and power exercised by the Chief Executive of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region?

options.labelZh: 簽署立法會通過的財政預算案，將財政預算、決算報中央人民政府備案
options.labelEn: Sign the budget bill passed by the Legislative Council and submit the budget and final accounts to the Central People's Government for record

options.labelZh: 決定政府政策和發佈行政命令
options.labelEn: Decide on government policies and issue administrative orders

options.labelZh: 依照法定程序任免各級法院法官
options.labelEn: Appoint and remove judges of courts at all levels in accordance with legal procedures

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 D。依據《基本法》第 48 條，「聘請主要官員」唔屬於條文列明嘅職權；其餘選項先係條文涵蓋嘅內容。
questions.trapZh: 題目問排除項；要揀出唔屬於條文列明嘅職權嘅「聘請主要官員」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第四十九條，香港特別行政區行政長官如認為立法會通過的 __________不符合香港特別行政區的整體利益，可在三個月內將法案發回立法會重議？
questions.questionEn: According to Article 49 of the Basic Law, if the Chief Executive of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region believes that a bill passed by the Legislative Council is not in the overall interests of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, he can send the bill back to the Legislative Council within three months for reconsideration?

options.labelZh: 條例 10. 香港特別行政區的主要官員由在香港通常居住連續滿十五年並在外國無居留權的香港特別行政區永久性居民中的中國公民擔任。
options.labelEn: Regulations 10. The principal officials of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region shall be Chinese citizens who are permanent residents of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region who have ordinarily resided in Hong Kong for fifteen consecutive years and have no right of abode in any foreign country.

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 C。《基本法》第 49 條明確訂明：「香港特別行政區行政長官如認為立法會通過的法案不符合香港特別行政區的整體利益，可在三個月內將法案發回立法會重議，立法會如以不少於全體議員三分之二多數再次通過原案，行政長官必須在一個月內簽署公布或按本法第五十條的規定處理」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第一百零一條，下列哪位官員，並不需要在外國無居留權的永久性居民中的中國公民擔任？
questions.questionEn: According to Article 101 of the Basic Law, which of the following officials is not required to be a Chinese citizen who is a permanent resident without the right of abode in a foreign country?
questions.explanationZh: 答案係 D。依據《基本法》第 101 條，「申訴專員」唔屬於必須符合有關國籍及居留資格限制嘅職位；其餘選項先係條文涵蓋嘅內容。
questions.trapZh: 題目問排除項；要揀出唔屬於必須符合有關國籍及居留資格限制嘅職位嘅「申訴專員」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第六十三條，下列哪一項是負責主管香港特別行政區之刑事檢察工作，不受任何干涉？
questions.questionEn: According to Article 63 of the Basic Law, which of the following is responsible for the criminal prosecution of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region without any interference?
questions.explanationZh: 答案係 A。《基本法》第 63 條明確訂明：「香港特別行政區律政司主管刑事檢察工作，不受任何干涉」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第七十五條，香港特別行政區立法會舉行會議的法定人數為不少於__________的二分之一。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 75 of the Basic Law, the quorum for meetings of the Legislative Council of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region shall be no less than one-half.

options.labelZh: 功能團體選舉產生的議員
選舉委員會選舉產生的議員
options.labelEn: Councilors elected by the Election Committee

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 D。《基本法》第 75 條明確訂明：「香港特別行政區立法會舉行會議的法定人數為不少於全體議員的二分之一」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第一百二十五條，香港特別行政區經中央人民政府授權繼續進行船舶登記，並根據香港特別行政區的法律以__________的名義頒發有關證件。
questions.questionEn: In accordance with Article 125 of the Basic Law, the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region shall continue to register ships with the authorization of the Central People's Government and issue relevant certificates in the name of in accordance with the laws of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.
questions.explanationZh: 答案係 D。《基本法》第 125 條明確訂明：「香港特別行政區經中央人民政府授權繼續進行船舶登記，並根據香港特別行政區的法律以" 中國香港" 的名義頒發有關證件」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第一百五十一條，香港特別行政區不可以在下列領域中，以「中國香港」的名義，單獨地同世界各國、各地區及有關國際組織保持和發展關係，簽訂和履行有關協議。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 151 of the Basic Law, the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region cannot independently maintain and develop relations, sign and perform relevant agreements with other countries, regions and relevant international organizations in the following areas in the name of "Hong Kong, China".
questions.explanationZh: 答案係 D。依據《基本法》第 151 條，「環保」唔屬於題目所問嘅法定範圍；其餘選項先係條文涵蓋嘅內容。
questions.trapZh: 題目問排除項；要揀出唔屬於題目所問嘅法定範圍嘅「環保」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》附件三，下列有哪些全國性法律，是自一九九七年七月一日起由香港特別行政區在當地公佈或立法實施？
questions.questionEn: According to Annex 3 of the Basic Law, which of the following national laws have been promulgated or enacted locally by the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region since July 1, 1997?

options.labelZh: 關於中華人民共和國國徽的決議、關於中華人民共和國國慶日的決議、中華人民共和國國籍法、中華人民共和國國旗法
options.labelEn: Resolution on the National Emblem of the People's Republic of China, Resolution on the National Day of the People's Republic of China, Nationality Law of the People's Republic of China, Flag Law of the People's Republic of China

options.labelZh: 中華人民共和國政府關於領海的聲明、中華人民共和國外交特權與豁免條例、中華人民共和國領事特權與豁免條例、中華人民共和國國徽法
options.labelEn: Statement of the Government of the People's Republic of China on the Territorial Sea, Regulations on Diplomatic Privileges and Immunities of the People's Republic of China, Regulations on Consular Privileges and Immunities of the People's Republic of China, National Emblem Law of the People's Republic of China

options.labelZh: 中華人民共和國領海和毗連區法、中華人民共和國海洋法、中華人民共和國香港特別行政區駐軍法、 中華人民共和國專屬經濟區和大陸架法
options.labelEn: Law of the People's Republic of China on the Territorial Sea and Contiguous Zone, Law of the People's Republic of China Law of the Sea, Law of the People's Republic of China on the Garrison of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Law of the People's Republic of China on the Exclusive Economic Zone and Continental Shelf

options.labelZh: 關於中華人民共和國國慶日的決議、中華人民共和國國徽法、中華人民共和國海洋法、中華人民共和國領海和毗連區法
options.labelEn: Resolution on the National Day of the People's Republic of China, Law of the People's Republic of China on the National Emblem, Law of the Sea of the People's Republic of China, Law of the People's Republic of China on the Territorial Sea and Contiguous Zone

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 B。題目列出嘅四項——領海聲明、外交特權與豁免條例、領事特權與豁免條例同國徽法——都載於《基本法》附件三嘅全國性法律名單；其他組合混入名單以外法律。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第十條，香港特別行政區的區徽中間為：__________
questions.questionEn: According to Article 10 of the Basic Law, the center of the regional emblem of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region is:

options.labelZh: 五金星型花蕊的紫荊花
options.labelEn: Bauhinia flower with five-gold star-shaped stamens

options.labelZh: 六金星型花蕊的紫荊花
options.labelEn: Bauhinia flower with six-gold star-shaped stamens

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 A。《基本法》第 10 條明確訂明：「香港特別行政區的區徽，中間是五星花蕊的紫荊花，周圍寫有“中華人民共和國香港特別行政區”和英文“香港”」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第八條，下列哪項並不是香港原有法律， 經香港特別行政區的立法機關作出修改者外，予以保留？
questions.questionEn: According to Article 8 of the Basic Law, which of the following is not an original law of Hong Kong and will be retained unless amended by the legislative body of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region?
questions.explanationZh: 答案係 D。依據《基本法》第 8 條，「英國國會法」唔屬於題目所問嘅法定範圍；其餘選項先係條文涵蓋嘅內容。
questions.trapZh: 題目問排除項；要揀出唔屬於題目所問嘅法定範圍嘅「英國國會法」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第十七條，全國人民代表大會常務委員會在徵詢其所屬的香港特別行政區基本法委員會後，如認為香港特別行政區立法機關制定的任何法律__________及中央和香港特別行政區的關係的條款，可將有關法律發回，但不作修改。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 17 of the Basic Law, the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress, after consulting the Basic Law Committee of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region to which it belongs, may send back the relevant law without modification if it considers that any law enacted by the Legislature of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region and the terms of the relationship between the central government and the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

options.labelZh: 不符合本法關於國務院管理的事務
options.labelEn: Incompatible with this Law on matters managed by the State Council

options.labelZh: 不符合本法關於中央管理的事務
options.labelEn: Incompatible with this Law on matters managed by the Central Government

options.labelZh: 不符合本法關於人民政府管理的事務
options.labelEn: Incompatible with this Law on matters managed by the People's Government

options.labelZh: 不符合本法關於全國人民代表大會管理的事務
options.labelEn: Incompatible with this Law on matters managed by the National People's Congress

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 B。《基本法》第 17 條明確訂明：「全國人民代表大會常務委員會在徵詢其所屬的香港特別行政區基本法委員會後，如認為香港特別行政區立法機關制定的任何法律不符合本法關於中央管理的事務及中央和香港特別行政區的關係的條款，可將有關法律發回，但不作修改」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第十九條，香港特別行政區法院對下列哪一項沒有管轄權？
questions.questionEn: According to Article 19 of the Basic Law, the courts of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region have no jurisdiction over which of the following?

options.labelZh: 中央人民政府之對外事項
options.labelEn: External affairs of the Central People's Government
National defense, diplomacy and other state actions

options.labelZh: 中央人民政府之行政事項
options.labelEn: Administrative matters of the Central People's Government

options.labelZh: 香港特別行政區對外之事務
options.labelEn: External affairs of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 B。依據《基本法》第 19 條，「國防、外交等國家行為」唔屬於香港法院依法享有管轄權嘅案件範圍；其餘選項先係條文涵蓋嘅內容。
questions.trapZh: 題目問排除項；要揀出唔屬於香港法院依法享有管轄權嘅案件範圍嘅「國防、外交等國家行為」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第二十六條，香港特別行政區永久性居民依法享有__________。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 26 of the Basic Law, permanent residents of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region enjoy the rights in accordance with the law.

options.labelEn: The right to freedom of speech
The right to vote and the right to be elected
The right to freedom of entry and exit

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 B。《基本法》第 26 條明確訂明：「香港特別行政區永久性居民依法享有選舉權和被選舉權」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第二十八條，對香港居民的人身自由不受侵犯，規定：__________
questions.questionEn: According to Article 28 of the Basic Law, the personal freedom of Hong Kong residents shall be inviolable and stipulates:

options.labelZh: 禁止任意或非法搜查居民的身體
options.labelEn: Prohibition on arbitrary or illegal body searches of residents

options.labelZh: 剝奪或限制居民的人身自由
options.labelEn: Deprivation or restriction of residents' personal freedom

options.labelZh: 任意或非法剝奪居民的生命
options.labelEn: Arbitrary or unlawful deprivation of residents' lives

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 D。《基本法》第 28 條明確訂明：「禁止對居民施行酷刑、任意或非法剝奪居民的生命」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第四十八條，香港特別行政區行政長官不可以行使下列哪項職權？
questions.questionEn: According to Article 48 of the Basic Law, the Chief Executive of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region may not exercise which of the following powers?

options.labelZh: 依照法定程序任免各級法院法官
options.labelEn: Appoint and remove judges of courts at all levels in accordance with legal procedures

options.labelZh: 領導香港特別行政區政府
options.labelEn: Lead the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region Government

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 B。依據《基本法》第 48 條，「聘任主要官員」唔屬於條文列明嘅職權；其餘選項先係條文涵蓋嘅內容。
questions.trapZh: 題目問排除項；要揀出唔屬於條文列明嘅職權嘅「聘任主要官員」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第六十條，下列哪個職位並不是香港特別行政區政府設立？
questions.questionEn: According to Article 60 of the Basic Law, which of the following positions is not established by the Government of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region?
questions.explanationZh: 答案係 D。依據《基本法》第 60 條，「民政司」唔屬於題目所問嘅法定範圍；其餘選項先係條文涵蓋嘅內容。
questions.trapZh: 題目問排除項；要揀出唔屬於題目所問嘅法定範圍嘅「民政司」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第七十二條，下列哪項並不是香港特別行政區立法會主席所行使之職權？
questions.questionEn: According to Article 72 of the Basic Law, which of the following is not a function and power exercised by the President of the Legislative Council of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region?

options.labelZh: 決定立法會議的薪酬及福利
options.labelEn: Decide on the salary and benefits of the Legislative Council

options.labelZh: 決定議程，政府提出的議案須優先列入議程
options.labelEn: Decide on the agenda, bills proposed by the government must be prioritized on the agenda

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 B。依據《基本法》第 72 條，「決定立法會議的薪酬及福利」唔屬於條文列明嘅職權；其餘選項先係條文涵蓋嘅內容。
questions.trapZh: 題目問排除項；要揀出唔屬於條文列明嘅職權嘅「決定立法會議的薪酬及福利」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第八十九條，香港特別行政區法院的法官只有在下列哪種情況，才可予以免職？
questions.questionEn: According to Article 89 of the Basic Law, judges of the courts of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region may be removed from office only in which of the following circumstances?

options.labelZh: 干犯刑事罪及坐監超過一個月
options.labelEn: Commitment of a criminal offense and imprisonment for more than one month

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 D。《基本法》第 89 條明確訂明：「香港特別行政區法院的法官只有在無力履行職責或行為不檢的情況下，行政長官才可根據終審法院首席法官任命的不少於三名當地法官組成的審議庭的建議，予以免職」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第一百零四條，香港特別行政區行政長官在就職時，必須依法宣誓擁護：__________
questions.questionEn: According to Article 104 of the Basic Law, when taking office, the Chief Executive of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region must legally swear to uphold:

options.labelEn: "Constitution of the People's Republic of China"

options.labelZh: 《中華人民共和國香港特別行政區基本法》
options.labelEn: "Basic Law of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region of the People's Republic of China"

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 D。《基本法》第 104 條明確訂明：「#香港特別行政區行政長官、主要官員、行政會議成員、立法會議員、各級法院法官和其他司法人員在就職時必須依法宣誓擁護中華人民共和國香港特別行政區基本法，效忠中華人民共和國香港特別行政區」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第一百一十三條，香港特別行政區的外匯基金，由__________ 管理和支配，主要用於調節港元匯價。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 113 of the Basic Law, the Exchange Fund of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region is managed and controlled by __________ and is mainly used to adjust the exchange rate of the Hong Kong dollar.

options.labelEn: Government of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 D。《基本法》第 113 條明確訂明：「香港特別行政區的外匯基金，由香港特別行政區政府管理和支配，主要用於調節港元匯價」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第一百一十六條，香港特別行政區可以用下列哪一項的名義參加《關税和貿易總協定》、關於國際紡織品貿易安排等有關國際組織和國際貿易協定，包括優惠貿易安排？
questions.questionEn: According to Article 116 of the Basic Law, in the name of which of the following can the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region participate in the General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade, the International Textile Trade Arrangement and other relevant international organizations and international trade agreements, including preferential trade arrangements?

options.labelEn: Hong Kong Economic and Trade Office

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 D。《基本法》第 116 條明確訂明：「香港特別行政區可以 "中國香港" 的名義參加《關稅和貿易總協定》、關於國際紡織品貿易安排等有關國際組織和國際貿易協定，包括優惠貿易安排」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第一百五十條，香港特別行政區政府的代表，可作為中華人民共和國政府代表團的__________，參加由中央人民政府進行的同香港特別行政區直接有關的外交談判。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 150 of the Basic Law, representatives of the Government of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region may, as a delegation of the Government of the People's Republic of China, participate in diplomatic negotiations directly related to the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region conducted by the Central People's Government.
questions.explanationZh: 答案係 B。《基本法》第 150 條明確訂明：「香港特別行政區政府的代表，可作為中華人民共和國政府代表團的成員，參加由中央人民政府進行的同香港特別行政區直接有關的外交談判」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》附件三的法律是：__________
questions.questionEn: The laws under Annex III of the Basic Law are:

options.labelEn: Constitution of the People's Republic of China
Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China
National Law of the People's Republic of China

options.labelZh: 在香港特別行政區實施的全國性法律
options.labelEn: National laws implemented in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 D。《基本法》附件三明確訂明：「在香港特別行政區實施的全國性法律包括：《關於中華人民共和國國都、紀年、國歌、國旗的決議》、《關於中華人民共和國國慶日的決議》、《中華…」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第四條，香港特別行政區依法保障__________的權利和自由。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 4 of the Basic Law, the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region shall safeguard the rights and freedoms of __________ in accordance with law.

options.labelZh: 香港特別行政區市民和其他人
options.labelEn: Citizens of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region and other persons

options.labelZh: 香港特別行政區居民和遊客
options.labelEn: Residents of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region and visitors

options.labelZh: 香港特別行政區居民和其他人
options.labelEn: Residents of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region and other persons

options.labelZh: 香港特別行政區永久性居民和其他人
options.labelEn: Permanent residents of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region and other persons

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 C。《基本法》第 4 條明確訂明：「香港特別行政區依法保障香港特別行政區居民和其他人的權利和自由」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第十七條，香港特別行政區享有立法權。 香港特別行政區的立法機關制定的法律須報全國人民代表大會常務委員會備案。備案不影響該法律的生效。 全國人民代表大會常務委員會在徵詢其所屬的香港特別行政區基本法委員會後，如認為香港特別行政區立法機關制定的任何法律不符合本法關於中央管理的事務及中央和香港特別行政區的關係的條款，可將__________。經全國人民代表大會常務委員會發回的法律立即失效。該法律的失效，除香港特別行政區的法律另有規定外，無溯及力。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 17 of the Basic Law, the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region enjoys legislative power. Laws enacted by the legislative body of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region must be reported to the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress for record. Filing does not affect the effectiveness of the law. If the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress, after consulting the Basic Law Committee of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region to which it belongs, considers that any law enacted by the legislative body of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region is inconsistent with the provisions of this law regarding matters managed by the central government and the relationship between the central government and the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, it may. Laws returned by the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress shall immediately become invalid. The invalidation of this law will have no retroactive effect unless otherwise provided by the laws of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

options.labelZh: 有關法律發回，再作修改
options.labelEn: The relevant laws are sent back with further modifications

options.labelZh: 有關法律發回，但不作修改
options.labelEn: The relevant laws are sent back without modification

options.labelZh: 有關法律發回，然後存檔
options.labelEn: The relevant laws are sent back and then archived

options.labelZh: 有關法律發回，稍為修改
options.labelEn: The relevant laws are sent back with minor modifications

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 B。《基本法》第 17 條明確訂明：「全國人民代表大會常務委員會在徵詢其所屬的香港特別行政區基本法委員會後，如認為香港特別行政區立法機關制定的任何法律不符合本法關於中央管理的事務及中央和香港特別行政區的關係的條款，可將有關法律發回，但不作修改」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第十八條，如香港決定宣布戰爭狀態或因香港特別行政區內發生不能控制的危及國家統一或安全的動亂而決定香港特別行政區進入緊急狀態，下列哪個機構可發布命令將有關全國性法律在香港特別行政區實施？
questions.questionEn: According to Article 18 of the Basic Law, if Hong Kong decides to declare a state of war or enter a state of emergency due to uncontrollable unrest that threatens national unity or security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, which of the following agencies can issue an order to implement relevant national laws in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region?

options.labelZh: 外交部駐港特派員公署
options.labelEn: Office of the Commissioner of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs in Hong Kong

options.labelZh: 全國人民代表大會常務委員會
options.labelEn: Standing Committee of the National People's Congress

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 B。《基本法》第 18 條明確訂明：「全國人民代表大會常務委員會決定宣布戰爭狀態或因香港特別行政區內發生香港特別行政區政府不能控制的危及國家統一或安全的動亂而決定香港特別行政區進入緊急狀態，中央人民政府可發布命令將有關全國性法律在香港特別行政區實施」。
questions.trapZh: 唔好交換權力主體；條文指定嘅係「中央人民政府」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第二十三條，香港特別行政區應自行立法禁止任何叛國、分裂國家、煽動叛亂、顛覆中央人民政府及竊取國家機密的行為，禁止__________在香港特別行政區進行政治活動，禁止香港特別行政區的政治性組織或團體與外國的政治性組織或團體建立聯繫。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 23 of the Basic Law, the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region shall legislate on its own to prohibit any act of treason, secession, sedition, subversion of the Central People's Government and theft of state secrets, prohibit political activities in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, and prohibit political organizations or groups in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region from establishing ties with foreign political organizations or groups.

options.labelZh: 外國的政治性組織或團體

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 C。《基本法》第 23 條明確訂明：「香港特別行政區應自行立法禁止任何叛國、分裂國家、煽動叛亂、顛覆中央人民政府及竊取國家機密的行為，禁止外國的政治性組織或團體在香港特別行政區進行政治活動，禁止香港特別行政區的政治性組織或團體與外國的政治性組織或團體建立聯繫」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第二十四條，香港特別行政區居民（簡稱香港居民）是包括__________：
questions.questionEn: According to Article 24 of the Basic Law, residents of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region (referred to as Hong Kong residents) include:

options.labelZh: 永久性居民和非永久性居民
按指定計劃安排獲準來港居住的人士
options.labelEn: Persons who are permitted to come to live in Hong Kong under designated arrangements

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 C。《基本法》第 24 條明確訂明：「香港特別行政區居民，簡稱香港居民，包括永久性居民和非永久性居民」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第三十條，香港居民的通訊自由和通訊秘密受法律的保護。除因公共安全和查刑事犯罪的需要， 由有關機關依照法律程序對通訊進行檢查外，任何部門或個人不得以任何理由侵犯居民下列哪項的基本權利和自由__________？
questions.questionEn: According to Article 30 of the Basic Law, Hong Kong residents’ freedom of communication and communication confidentiality are protected by law. Except for the inspection of communications by relevant agencies in accordance with legal procedures due to the needs of public security and criminal investigation, no department or individual may infringe on which of the following basic rights and freedoms of residents for any reason?

options.labelEn: Freedom of communication and confidentiality of communication

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 B。《基本法》第 30 條明確訂明：「除因公共安全和追查刑事犯罪的需要，由有關機關依照法律程序對通訊進行檢查外，任何部門或個人不得以任何理由侵犯居民的通訊自由和通訊秘密」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第四十五條，香港特別行政區行政長官在當地通過選舉或協商產生，由中央人民政府任命。行政長官的產生辦法根據香港特別行政區的實際情況和循序漸進的原則而規定，最終達至由一個有廣泛代表性的提名委員會按__________程序提名後普選產生的目標。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 45 of the Basic Law, the Chief Executive of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region is elected locally through election or consultation and appointed by the Central People's Government. The method for selecting the Chief Executive is stipulated based on the actual situation of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region and the principle of gradualism, and ultimately achieves the goal of being elected by universal suffrage after nomination by a broadly representative nomination committee in accordance with procedures.
questions.explanationZh: 答案係 C。《基本法》第 45 條明確訂明：「行政長官的產生辦法根據香港特別行政區的實際情況和循序漸進的原則而規定，最終達至由一個有廣泛代表性的提名委員會按民主程序提名後普選產生的目標」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第五十六條，香港特別行政區行政會議由行政長官主持。行政長官在作出下列決策時，須徵詢行政會議的意見。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 56 of the Basic Law, the Executive Council of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region is chaired by the Chief Executive. The Chief Executive must consult the Executive Council when making the following decisions.

options.labelZh: 緊急情況下採取的措施
options.labelEn: Measures to be taken in emergency situations

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 D。《基本法》第 56 條明確訂明：「行政長官在作出重要決策、向立法會提交法案、制定附屬法規和解散立法會前，須徵詢行政會議的意見，但人事任免、紀律制裁和緊急情況下採取的措施除外」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第九十七條，香港特別行政區可設立__________組織，接受香港特別行政區政府就有關地區管理和其他事務的諮詢，或負責提供文化、康樂、環境衛生等服務。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 97 of the Basic Law, the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region may establish organizations to receive consultation from the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region government on relevant regional management and other matters, or to provide cultural, recreational, environmental sanitation and other services.

options.labelZh: 非地區代表性的區域組織
options.labelEn: Regional organizations that are not regionally representative

options.labelZh: 具地區代表性的區域組織
options.labelEn: Regional organizations that are regionally representative

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 C。《基本法》第 97 條明確訂明：「香港特別行政區可設立非政權性的區域組織，接受香港特別行政區政府就有關地區管理和其他事務的諮詢，或負責提供文化、康樂、環境衞生等服務」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第一百零一條，香港特別行政區政府可任用原香港公務人員中的或持有香港特別行政區永久性居民身份證的英籍和其他外籍人士擔任政府部門的各級公務人員，但下列哪個官員並不須由在外國無居留權的香港特別行政區永久性居民中的中國公民擔任？
questions.questionEn: According to Article 101 of the Basic Law, the Government of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region may appoint British and other foreign nationals who are former Hong Kong civil servants or hold Hong Kong Special Administrative Region permanent resident identity cards to serve as civil servants at all levels in government departments. However, which of the following officials does not need to be held by Chinese citizens who are permanent residents of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region without the right of abode in foreign countries?
questions.explanationZh: 答案係 D。依據《基本法》第 101 條，「申訴專員」唔屬於必須符合有關國籍及居留資格限制嘅職位；其餘選項先係條文涵蓋嘅內容。
questions.trapZh: 題目問排除項；要揀出唔屬於必須符合有關國籍及居留資格限制嘅職位嘅「申訴專員」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第一百一十三條，香港特別行政區的外匯基金，由香港特別行政區政府管理和支配，主要用於__________
questions.questionEn: According to Article 113 of the Basic Law, the Exchange Fund of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region is managed and controlled by the Government of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region. It is mainly used to

options.labelZh: 操控境外資產的規範運作
options.labelEn: Control the standardized operation of overseas assets
Strategic investment in the futures market
Purchase treasury bonds of other countries
Adjust the exchange rate of the Hong Kong dollar

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 D。《基本法》第 113 條明確訂明：「香港特別行政區的外匯基金，由香港特別行政區政府管理和支配，主要用於調節港元匯價」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第一百二十六條，除__________進入香港特別行政區須經中央人民政府特別許可外，其他船舶可根據香港特別行政區法律進出其港口。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 126 of the Basic Law, except that entry into the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region requires special permission from the Central People's Government, other ships may enter or leave its ports in accordance with the laws of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.
questions.explanationZh: 答案係 D。《基本法》第 126 條明確訂明：「除外國軍用船隻進入香港特別行政區須經中央人民政府特別許可外，其他船舶可根據香港特別行政區法律進出其港口」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第一百四十五條，香港特別行政區政府在原有社會福利制度的基礎上，根據__________ •自行制定其發展、改進的政策。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 145 of the Basic Law, the Government of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region shall formulate its own policies for its development and improvement on the basis of the original social welfare system.
questions.explanationZh: 答案係 D。《基本法》第 145 條訂明，香港特區政府根據經濟條件同社會需要，自行制定社會福利制度嘅發展及改進政策；D 係四個選項中唯一符合呢兩項條件。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第一百五十八條，香港特別行政區法院在審理案件時對基本法關於香港特別行政區自治範圍內的條款可以自行解釋，原因是？
questions.questionEn: According to Article 158 of the Basic Law, the courts of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region can interpret the provisions of the Basic Law within the scope of autonomy of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region on their own when hearing cases. Why?

options.labelZh: 香港特別行政區法院享有獨立的司法管轄權
options.labelEn: The courts of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region enjoy independent jurisdiction

options.labelZh: 實現一個國家，兩種制度的方針
options.labelEn: Realizing the policy of one country, two systems
Demonstrating a high degree of autonomy

options.labelZh: 獲得全國人民代表大會常務委員會之授
options.labelEn: Obtaining authorization from the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 D。《基本法》第 158 條明確寫明，全國人大常委會授權香港法院喺審理案件時自行解釋自治範圍內嘅條款；權力來源係全國人大常委會嘅授權。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》附件一，香港特別行政區行政長官的產生辦法行政長官由一個具有廣泛代表性、符合香港特別行政區實際情況、體現社會整體利益的選舉委員會根據本法選出， 由中央人民政府任命。 選舉委員會根據提名的名單，經__________投票選出行政長官候任人。
questions.questionEn: According to Annex 1 of the Basic Law, the method for selecting the Chief Executive of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region. The Chief Executive shall be elected in accordance with this Law by an election committee that is broadly representative, consistent with the actual situation of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, and reflects the overall interests of society, and shall be appointed by the Central People's Government. The Election Committee selects the Chief Executive-designate through voting based on the nominated list.
questions.explanationZh: 答案係 B。《基本法》附件一明確訂明：「選舉委員會根據提名名單，經一人一票無記名投票選出行政長官候任人」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》序言第一段，香港自古以來就是中國的領土，一八四〇年鴉片戰爭以後被英國佔領。一九八四年十二月十九日，中英兩國政府簽署了__________，確認中華人民共和國政府於一九九七年七月一日恢復對香港行使主權，從而實現了長期以來中國人民收回香港的共同願望。
questions.questionEn: According to the first paragraph of the preamble to the Basic Law, Hong Kong has been a territory of China since ancient times and was occupied by Britain after the Opium War in 1840. On December 19, 1984, the Chinese and British governments signed an agreement confirming that the government of the People's Republic of China would resume the exercise of sovereignty over Hong Kong on July 1, 1997, thereby realizing the long-standing common aspiration of the Chinese people to take back Hong Kong.

options.labelZh: 關於香港問題的的諒解備忘錄
options.labelEn: Memorandum of Understanding on the Hong Kong Issue

options.labelZh: 關於香港問題的聯合聲明
options.labelEn: Joint Statement on the Hong Kong Issue

options.labelZh: 關於香港問題的雙邊互換協議
options.labelEn: Bilateral Swap Agreement on the Hong Kong Issue

options.labelZh: 關於香港問題的互換協定備忘錄
options.labelEn: Memorandum of Understanding on the Swap Agreement on the Hong Kong Issue

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 B。《基本法》序言明確訂明：「香港自古以來就是中國的領土，一九八四年十二月十九日，中英兩國政府簽署了關於香港問題的聯合聲明」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第三條，香港特別行政區的行政機關和立法機關是由__________照本法有關規定組成。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 3 of the Basic Law, the administrative and legislative organs of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region are composed of __________ in accordance with the relevant provisions of this Law.

options.labelZh: 香港永久性居民和非永久性居民
options.labelEn: Hong Kong permanent residents and non-permanent residents

options.labelZh: 香港永久性居民和非永久性公民
options.labelEn: Hong Kong permanent residents and non-permanent citizens

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 C。《基本法》第 3 條明確訂明：「香港特別行政區的行政機關和立法機關由香港永久性居民依照本法有關規定組成」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第十七條，全國人民代表大會常務委員會在徵詢其所屬的香港特別行政區基本法委員會後，如認為香港特別行政區立法機關制定的任何法律不符合本法關於中央管理的事務及中央和香港特別行政區的關係的條款，可將有關法律發回，但不作修改。經全國人民代表大會常務委員會發回的法律立即失效。該法律的失效__________，。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 17 of the Basic Law, if the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress, after consulting the Basic Law Committee of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region to which it belongs, considers that any law enacted by the Legislature of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region is inconsistent with the provisions of this Law on matters managed by the central government and the relationship between the central government and the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, the relevant law may be sent back without modification. Laws returned by the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress shall immediately become invalid. The law is invalid.

options.labelZh: 除香港特別行政區的法律另有規定外，有一般的溯及力。
options.labelEn: Unless otherwise provided by the laws of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, there is general retroactive effect.

options.labelZh: 除香港特別行政區的法律另有規定外，沒有溯及力。
options.labelEn: Unless otherwise provided by the laws of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, there is no retroactive effect.

options.labelZh: 除香港特別行政區的法律另有規定外，具有溯及力。
options.labelEn: Unless otherwise provided by the laws of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, it has retroactive effect.

options.labelZh: 除香港特別行政區的法律另有規定外，無溯及力。
options.labelEn: Unless otherwise provided by the laws of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, there is no retroactive effect.

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 D。《基本法》第 17 條明確訂明：「該法律的失效，除香港特別行政區的法律另有規定外，無溯及力」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第十八條，在香港特別行政區實行的法律為本法以及本法第八條規定的香港原有法律和香港特別行政區立法機關制定的法律。 全國性法律除列於本法附件三者外，不在香港特別行政區實施。凡列於本法附件三之法律，由香港特別行政區在當地公布或立法實施。 全國人民代表大會常務委員會在徵詢其所屬的香港特別行政區基本法委員會和香港特別行政區政府的意見後，可對列於本法附件三的法律作出增減，任何列入附件三的法律，限於有關__________。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 18 of the Basic Law, the laws implemented in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region are this Law and the original laws of Hong Kong specified in Article 8 of this Law and the laws enacted by the legislative body of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region. National laws, except those listed in Annex III of this Law, shall not be implemented in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region. All laws listed in Annex III of this Law shall be promulgated or implemented through legislation locally by the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region. The Standing Committee of the National People's Congress may, after consulting the Basic Law Committee of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region to which it belongs and the Government of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, make additions or deletions to the laws listed in Annex III of this Law. Any laws listed in Annex III shall be limited to the relevant o

options.labelZh: 不屬於香港特別行政區自治範圍的法律。
options.labelEn: Laws that do not fall within the scope of autonomy of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

options.labelZh: 香港特別行政區自治範圍的法律。
options.labelEn: The laws governing the scope of autonomy of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

options.labelZh: 國防、外交和其他按本法規定不屬於香港特別行政區自治範圍的法律。
options.labelEn: National defense, foreign affairs and other laws that are not within the scope of autonomy of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region according to this law.

options.labelZh: 國防、外交和維護國家的法律。
options.labelEn: Defence, foreign affairs and safeguarding the country's laws.

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 C。《基本法》第 18 條將附件三法律限於國防、外交，同其他按《基本法》規定不屬香港特區自治範圍嘅法律；C 完整保留三個範圍。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第三十一條，下列哪一項並不是香港居民，有在香港特別行政區境內所享有的自由？
questions.questionEn: According to Article 31 of the Basic Law, which of the following persons is not a Hong Kong resident and enjoys the freedoms within the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region?

options.labelZh: 移居其他國家和地區的自由
options.labelEn: Freedom to move to other countries and regions
Freedom to travel and enter and exit

options.labelZh: 在香港特別行政區境內遷徒的自由
options.labelEn: Freedom to move within the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

options.labelZh: 離開香港特別行政區，須獲得簽證
options.labelEn: A visa is required to leave the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 D。依據《基本法》第 31 條，「離開香港特別行政區，須獲得簽證」唔屬於條文保障嘅權利或自由；其餘選項先係條文涵蓋嘅內容。
questions.trapZh: 題目問排除項；要揀出唔屬於條文保障嘅權利或自由嘅「離開香港特別行政區，須獲得簽證」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第四十八條，香港特別行政區行政長官不可以行使下列哪項職權？
questions.questionEn: According to Article 48 of the Basic Law, the Chief Executive of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region may not exercise which of the following powers?

options.labelZh: 批准向立法會提出有關財政收入或支出的動議
options.labelEn: Approval of motions to the Legislative Council regarding fiscal revenue or expenditure

options.labelZh: 根據安全和重大公共利益的考慮，決定政府官員或其他負責政府公務的人員是否向立法會或其屬下的委員會作證和提供證據
options.labelEn: Decide whether government officials or other persons responsible for government duties shall testify and provide evidence to the Legislative Council or its committees based on considerations of security and major public interests

options.labelZh: 赦免或減輕刑事罪犯的刑罰
options.labelEn: Pardon or reduce the sentences of criminal offenders

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 D。依據《基本法》第 48 條，「聘任主要官員」唔屬於條文列明嘅職權；其餘選項先係條文涵蓋嘅內容。
questions.trapZh: 題目問排除項；要揀出唔屬於條文列明嘅職權嘅「聘任主要官員」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第七十三條，下列哪一項並不是香港特別行政區立法會必須遵守的職權？
questions.questionEn: According to Article 73 of the Basic Law, which of the following is not a duty that the Legislative Council of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region must abide by?

options.labelEn: Appointment and removal of judges of the Court of Final Appeal

options.labelZh: 接受香港居民申訴並作出處理
options.labelEn: Accept and handle complaints from Hong Kong residents

options.labelEn: Appointment and removal of the Chief Justice of the High Court
Appointment and removal of members of the Executive Council Basic Law test

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第六十七條，香港特別行政區立法會由在外國無居留權的香港特別行政區永久性居民中的中國公民組成。但非中國籍的香港特別行政區永久性居民和在外國有居留權的香港特別行政區永久性居民也可以當選為香港特別行政區立法會議員，其所估比例不得超過立法會全體議員的__________。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 67 of the Basic Law, the Legislative Council of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region is composed of Chinese citizens who are permanent residents of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region with no right of abode in foreign countries. However, permanent residents of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region who are not of Chinese nationality and permanent residents of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region who have the right of abode in foreign countries may also be elected as members of the Legislative Council of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, and their estimated proportion shall not exceed the proportion of all members of the Legislative Council.
questions.explanationZh: 答案係 B。《基本法》第 67 條明確訂明：「但非中國籍的香港特別行政區永久性居民和在外國有居留權的香港特別行政區永久性居民也可以當選為香港特別行政區立法會議員，其所佔比例不得超過立法會全體議員的百分之二十」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第七十二條，下列哪項並不是香港特別行政區立法會主席所行使之職權？
questions.questionEn: According to Article 72 of the Basic Law, which of the following is not a function and power exercised by the President of the Legislative Council of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region?

options.labelZh: 在休會期間可召開特別會議
options.labelEn: Special meetings may be convened during adjournments

options.labelZh: 應行政長官的要求召開緊急會議
options.labelEn: Convene emergency meetings at the request of the Chief Executive

options.labelZh: 修改及廢除<議事規則>的內容及指引
options.labelEn: Modify and abolish the contents and guidelines of the "Rules of Procedure"

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 D。依據《基本法》第 72 條，「修改及廢除<議事規則>的內容及指引」唔屬於條文列明嘅職權；其餘選項先係條文涵蓋嘅內容。
questions.trapZh: 題目問排除項；要揀出唔屬於條文列明嘅職權嘅「修改及廢除<議事規則>的內容及指引」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第八十九條，香港特別行政區法院的法官只有在下列哪種情況才可被免職？
questions.questionEn: According to Article 89 of the Basic Law, judges of the courts of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region can only be removed from office under which of the following circumstances?

options.labelEn: Giving up the right of abode

options.labelZh: 無力履行職責或行為不檢
options.labelEn: Inability to perform duties or misbehavior

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 D。《基本法》第 89 條明確訂明：「香港特別行政區法院的法官只有在無力履行職責或行為不檢的情況下，行政長官才可根據終審法院首席法官任命的不少於三名當地法官組成的審議庭的建議，予以免職」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第一百零三條，公務人員應根據其本人的__________以任用和提升，香港原有關於公務人員的招聘、 僱用、考核、紀律、培訓和管理的制度，包括負責公務人員的任用、薪金、服務條件的專門機構，除有關給予外籍人員特權待遇的規定外，予以保留。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 103 of the Basic Law, public servants shall be appointed and promoted on the basis of their own merits. Hong Kong’s original system for the recruitment, employment, assessment, discipline, training and management of public servants, including the specialized agencies responsible for the appointment, salaries and conditions of service of public servants, shall be retained except for the provisions regarding privileged treatment for foreign personnel.
questions.explanationZh: 答案係 B。《基本法》第 103 條明確訂明：「公務人員應根據其本人的資格、經驗和才能予以任用和提升，香港原有關於公務人員的招聘、僱用、考核、紀律、培訓和管理的制度，包括負責公務人員的任用、薪金、服務條件的專門機構，除有關給予外籍人員特權待遇的規定外，予以保留」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第一百零五條，香港特別行政區依法保護私人和法人財產的取得、使用、處置和繼承的權利，以及依法徵用私人和法人財產時被徵用財產的所有人得到補償的權利。 徵用財產的補償應相當於該財產當時的__________，可自由兌換，不得無故遲延支付。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 105 of the Basic Law, the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region shall protect in accordance with the law the rights of private persons and legal persons to acquire, use, dispose of and inherit property, as well as the right of owners of the expropriated property to receive compensation when private and legal persons’ property is expropriated in accordance with the law. Compensation for expropriated property shall be equivalent to the value of the property at the time, shall be freely convertible, and shall not be paid without unreasonable delay.
questions.explanationZh: 答案係 A。《基本法》第 105 條明確訂明：「徵用財產的補償應相當於該財產當時的實際價值，可自由兌換，不得無故遲延支付」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第一百五十八條，全國人民代表大會常務委員會授權香港特別行政區法院在審理案件時對本法關於香港特別行政區自治範圍內的條款自行解釋，但如香港特別行政區法院在審理案件時需要對本法關於中央人民政府管理的事務或中央和香港特別行政區關係的條款進行解釋，而該條款的解釋又影響到案件的判決，在對該案件作出不可上訴的終局判決前，應由香港特別行政區終審法院請全國人民代表大會常務委員會對有關條款作出解釋。如全國人民代表大會常務委員會作出解釋，香港特別行政區法院在引用該條款時，應以全國人民代表大會常務委員會的解釋為準。但在此以前作出的判決__________？
questions.questionEn: According to Article 158 of the Basic Law, the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress authorizes the courts of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region to interpret the provisions of this Law concerning the autonomy of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region on their own when hearing cases. However, if the courts of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region need to interpret the provisions of this Law concerning matters managed by the Central People's Government or the relationship between the Central People's Government and the Central People's Government or the relationship between the Central People's Government and the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region when hearing cases, and the interpretation of such provisions affects the judgment of the case, the court shall not make any judgment on the case. Before issuing a final and non-appealable judgment, the Court of Final Appeal of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region shall request the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress to interpret the relevant provisions. If the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress provides an interpretation, the courts of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region shall refer to the interpretation of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress when citing this provision. But the verdict passed before that?

options.labelZh: 應以全國人民代表大會常務委員會的解釋作出修改
options.labelEn: Should be modified in accordance with the interpretation of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress

options.labelZh: 須經香港特別行政區終審法院作出修改
options.labelEn: Subject to modification by the Court of Final Appeal of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

options.labelZh: 須經香港特別行政區終審法院理解全國人民代表大會常務委員會的解釋後再作決定
options.labelEn: The Court of Final Appeal of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region must understand the interpretation of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress before making a decision

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 A。《基本法》第 158 條明確訂明：「但在此以前作出的判決不受影響」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第八十五條，香港特別行政區法院獨立進行審判，不受任何干涉，司法人員 __________不受法律追究。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 85 of the Basic Law, the courts of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region conduct trials independently without any interference, and judicial officers are not subject to legal accountability.
questions.explanationZh: 答案係 C。《基本法》第 85 條明確訂明：「香港特別行政區法院獨立進行審判，不受任何干涉，司法人員履行審判職責的行為不受法律追究」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第一百零一條，下列的那一位官員不須在外國無居留權的香港特別行政區永久性居民中的中國公民擔任：
questions.questionEn: According to Article 101 of the Basic Law, the following officials are not required to serve as Chinese citizens who are permanent residents of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region without the right of abode in foreign countries:
questions.explanationZh: 答案係 C。依據《基本法》第 101 條，「消防處處長」唔屬於必須符合有關國籍及居留資格限制嘅職位；其餘選項先係條文涵蓋嘅內容。
questions.trapZh: 題目問排除項；要揀出唔屬於必須符合有關國籍及居留資格限制嘅職位嘅「消防處處長」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第八條，下列哪一項並不是香港原有法律，經香港特別行政區的立法機關作出修改者外，予以保留？

questions.trapZh: 題目問排除項；要揀出唔屬於題目所問嘅法定範圍嘅「英國國會法」。

options.labelZh: 五星花蕊、紫荊花、紅色旗
五星花蕊、洋金菊花、紅色旗
五星花蕊、紫荊花、橙色旗
五星花蕊、紫荊花、藍色旗

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第十三條，中央人民政府負責管理與香港特別行政區有關的外交事務。 __________在香港設立機構處理外交事務。中央人民政府授權香港特別行政區依照本法自行處理有關的對外事務。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 13 of the Basic Law, the Central People's Government is responsible for managing foreign affairs related to the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region. Establish an agency in Hong Kong to handle foreign affairs. The Central People's Government authorizes the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region to handle relevant external affairs on its own in accordance with this Law.

options.labelZh: 中華人民共和國外交部
options.labelEn: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the People's Republic of China

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 D。《基本法》第 13 條明確訂明：「中華人民共和國外交部在香港設立機構處理外交事務」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第十七條，全國人民代表大會常務委員會在徵詢其所屬的香港特別行政區基本法委員會後，如認為香港特別行政區立法機關制定的任何法律__________及中央和香港特別行政區的關係的條款，可將有關法律發回， 但不作修改。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 17 of the Basic Law, the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress, after consulting the Basic Law Committee of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region to which it is affiliated, may, if it considers that any law enacted by the Legislature of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region and the terms of the relationship between the Central Government and the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, refer back the relevant law without modification.

options.labelZh: 不符合本法關於國務院管理的事務
options.labelEn: Incompatible with this Law on matters managed by the State Council

options.labelZh: 不符合本法關於人民政府管理的事務
options.labelEn: Incompatible with this Law on matters managed by the People's Government

options.labelZh: 不符合本法關於中央管理的事務
options.labelEn: Incompatible with this Law on matters managed by the Central Government

options.labelZh: 不符合本法關於全國人民代表大會管理的事務
options.labelEn: Incompatible with this Law on matters managed by the National People's Congress

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 C。《基本法》第 17 條明確訂明：「全國人民代表大會常務委員會在徵詢其所屬的香港特別行政區基本法委員會後，如認為香港特別行政區立法機關制定的任何法律不符合本法關於中央管理的事務及中央和香港特別行政區的關係的條款，可將有關法律發回，但不作修改」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第二十六條，香港特別行政區永久性居民依法享有__________

options.labelZh: 選舉權、被選舉權、提名權和被提名權

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 A。《基本法》第 26 條明確訂明：「香港特別行政區永久性居民依法享有選舉權和被選舉權」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第四十八條，以下哪項並不屬於行政長官所行使的職權？

options.labelZh: 批准向立法會提出有關財政收入或支出的動議
options.labelEn: Approve motions to the Legislative Council regarding revenue or expenditure

options.labelZh: 委任三分之一的立法會議員
options.labelEn: Appoint one-third of the Legislative Council members

options.labelZh: 赦免或減輕刑事罪犯的刑罰
options.labelEn: Pardon or reduce the sentences of criminal offenders

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 C。依據《基本法》第 48 條，「委任三分之一的立法會議員」唔屬於條文列明嘅職權；其餘選項先係條文涵蓋嘅內容。
questions.trapZh: 題目問排除項；要揀出唔屬於條文列明嘅職權嘅「委任三分之一的立法會議員」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第六十條，下列哪個職位並不是香港特別行政區政府設立之職位？
questions.questionEn: According to Article 60 of the Basic Law, which of the following positions is not a position established by the Government of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region?

questions.trapZh: 題目問排除項；要揀出唔屬於題目所問嘅法定範圍嘅「民政司」。

options.labelEn: Decide on the agenda. Bills proposed by the government must be prioritized on the agenda
Decide on the government's governance methods

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 C。依據《基本法》第 72 條，「決定政府的管治方法」唔屬於條文列明嘅職權；其餘選項先係條文涵蓋嘅內容。
questions.trapZh: 題目問排除項；要揀出唔屬於條文列明嘅職權嘅「決定政府的管治方法」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第八十九條，香港特別行政區法院的法官只有在__________或行為不檢的情況下，行政長官才可根據終審法院首席法官任命的不少於三名當地法官組成的審議庭的建議，予以免職。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 89 of the Basic Law, a judge of the courts of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region may be removed by the Chief Executive on the recommendation of a deliberative panel consisting of not less than three local judges appointed by the Chief Justice of the Court of Final Appeal only in the case of misconduct.

options.labelEn: Inappropriate remarks when judging the case

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 D。《基本法》第 89 條明確訂明：「香港特別行政區法院的法官只有在無力履行職責或行為不檢的情況下，行政長官才可根據終審法院首席法官任命的不少於三名當地法官組成的審議庭的建議，予以免職」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第一百零四條，香港特別行政區行政長官，就職時必須依法宣誓擁護：__________
questions.questionEn: According to Article 104 of the Basic Law, the Chief Executive of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region must take an oath in accordance with the law when taking office:

The Constitution of the People's Republic of China

options.labelZh: 《中華人民共和國香港特別行政區基本法》
options.labelEn: The Basic Law of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region of the People's Republic of China

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 D。《基本法》第 104 條明確訂明：「#香港特別行政區行政長官、主要官員、行政會議成員、立法會議員、各級法院法官和其他司法人員在就職時必須依法宣誓擁護中華人民共和國香港特別行政區基本法，效忠中華人民共和國香港特別行政區」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第一百一十三條，香港特別行政區的外匯基金，由__________管理和支配，主要用於調節港元匯價。

options.labelEn: Government of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 A。《基本法》第 113 條明確訂明：「香港特別行政區的外匯基金，由香港特別行政區政府管理和支配，主要用於調節港元匯價」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第一百一十六條香港特別行政區為單獨的關稅地區。香港特別行政區可以什麼名義參加《關稅和貿易總協定》，關於國際紡織品貿易安排等有關國際組織和國際貿易協定，包括優惠貿易安排？
questions.questionEn: According to Article 116 of the Basic Law, the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region is a separate customs territory. Under what name can the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region participate in the General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade, the International Textile Trade Arrangement and other relevant international organizations and international trade agreements, including preferential trade arrangements?

options.labelZh: 中華人民共和國暨香港特別行政區政府
options.labelEn: Government of the People's Republic of China and the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region
Government of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region E Solution

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 B。《基本法》第 116 條明確訂明：「香港特別行政區可以 "中國香港" 的名義參加《關稅和貿易總協定》、關於國際紡織品貿易安排等有關國際組織和國際貿易協定，包括優惠貿易安排」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第一百五十條，香港特別行政區政府的代表，可作為中華人民共和國政府代表團的成員，參加由中央人民政府進行的同香港特別行政區直接有關的__________。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 150 of the Basic Law, representatives of the Government of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region may, as members of the government delegation of the People's Republic of China, participate in meetings conducted by the Central People's Government directly related to the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.
questions.explanationZh: 答案係 D。《基本法》第 150 條明確訂明：「香港特別行政區政府的代表，可作為中華人民共和國政府代表團的成員，參加由中央人民政府進行的同香港特別行政區直接有關的外交談判」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第一百五十一條，香港特別行政區不可以在下列領域中，以「中國香港」的名義，單獨地同世界各國、各地區及有關國際組織保持和發展關係，簽訂和履行有關協議。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 151 of the Basic Law, the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region cannot independently maintain and develop relations, sign and perform relevant agreements with other countries, regions and relevant international organizations in the following areas in the name of "Hong Kong, China".
questions.explanationZh: 答案係 A。依據《基本法》第 151 條，「環保」唔屬於題目所問嘅法定範圍；其餘選項先係條文涵蓋嘅內容。
questions.trapZh: 題目問排除項；要揀出唔屬於題目所問嘅法定範圍嘅「環保」。

questions.questionZh: 下列哪條列於《基本法》附件三之全國性法律，並不會在香港特別行政區實施？
questions.questionEn: Which of the following national laws listed in Annex III of the Basic Law will not be implemented in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region?

options.labelEn: "Flag Law of the People's Republic of China"

options.labelZh: 《關於中華人民共和國國慶日的決議》
options.labelEn: "Resolution on the National Day of the People's Republic of China"
"National Constitution of the People's Republic of China"

options.labelZh: 《中華人民共和國專屬經濟區和大陸架法》
options.labelEn: "Law of the People's Republic of China on the Exclusive Economic Zone and Continental Shelf"

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 C。依據《基本法》附件三，「《中華人民共和國國家憲法》」唔屬於附件三現行全國性法律名單；其餘選項先係條文涵蓋嘅內容。
questions.trapZh: 題目問排除項；要揀出唔屬於附件三現行全國性法律名單嘅「《中華人民共和國國家憲法》」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第十三條，中央人民政府負責管理與香港特別行政區有關的外交事務。 __________在香港設立機構處理外交事務。中央人民政府授權香港特別行政區依照本法自行處理有關的對外事務。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 13 of the Basic Law, the Central People's Government is responsible for managing foreign affairs related to the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region. __________Establish an agency in Hong Kong to handle foreign affairs. The Central People's Government authorizes the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region to handle relevant external affairs on its own in accordance with this Law.

options.labelZh: 中華人民共和國外交部
options.labelEn: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the People's Republic of China

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 D。《基本法》第 13 條明確訂明：「中華人民共和國外交部在香港設立機構處理外交事務」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第七條，香港特別行政區的土地和自然資源收入？
questions.questionEn: According to Article 7 of the Basic Law, revenue from land and natural resources of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region?

options.labelEn: Need to be turned over to the central government
Part of the income needs to be turned over to the central government
Not required to be turned over to the central government

options.labelZh: 不需上繳中央，除非是售賣土地的收
options.labelEn: Not required to be turned over to the central government, unless it is from the sale of land

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 C。《基本法》第 7 條訂明，土地同自然資源所得收入全歸香港特區政府支配，即係唔需要上繳中央。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第二十二條，中國其他地區的人進入香港特別行政區須辦理批准手續，其中進入香港特別行政區定居的人數是由__________。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 22 of the Basic Law, people from other parts of China who enter the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region must go through approval procedures. The number of people who enter the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region to settle is determined by.

options.labelZh: 全國人民代表大會常務委員會
options.labelEn: Standing Committee of the National People's Congress

options.labelZh: 香港特別行政區政府決定
options.labelEn: Decision of the Government of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

options.labelZh: 中央人民政府主管部門徵求香港特別行政區政府的意見後確定
options.labelEn: Determined by the competent departments of the Central People's Government after soliciting the opinions of the Government of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 D。《基本法》第 22 條明確訂明：「中國其他地區的人進入香港特別行政區須辦理批准手續，其中進入香港特別行政區定居的人數由中央人民政府主管部門徵求香港特別行政區政府的意見後確定」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第四十一條，在香港特別行政區境內的香港居民以外的其他人，依法享有本章規定的香港居民的__________
questions.questionEn: According to Article 41 of the Basic Law, persons other than Hong Kong residents in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region shall enjoy the

options.labelEn: rights and freedoms of Hong Kong residents stipulated in this Chapter in accordance with the law.

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 D。《基本法》第 41 條明確訂明：「在香港特別行政區境內的香港居民以外的其他人，依法享有本章規定的香港居民的權利和自由」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第二十四條，香港特別行政區居民（簡稱香港居民）乃包括__________：
questions.questionEn: According to Article 24 of the Basic Law, residents of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region (referred to as Hong Kong residents) include:

options.labelZh: 永久性居民和非永久性居民
按指定計劃安排獲准來港居民
options.labelEn: Residents admitted to Hong Kong under designated arrangements

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 B。《基本法》第 24 條明確訂明：「香港特別行政區居民，簡稱香港居民，包括永久性居民和非永久性居民」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第二十六條，香港特別行政區永久性居民依法享有__________ 權。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 26 of the Basic Law, permanent residents of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region enjoy __________ rights in accordance with the law.

options.labelEn: The right to freedom of speech
The right to freedom of entry and exit
The right to vote and to be elected

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 D。《基本法》第 26 條明確訂明：「香港特別行政區永久性居民依法享有選舉權和被選舉權」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第四十三條，香港特別行政區行政長官是__________的首長，代表__________。香港特別行政區行政長官依照本法的規定對中央人民政府和香港特別行政區負責。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 43 of the Basic Law, the Chief Executive of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region is the head of the People's Republic of China and represents the People's Republic of China. The Chief Executive of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region shall be responsible to the Central People's Government and the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region in accordance with the provisions of this Law.

options.labelZh: 香港特別行政區政府、香港特別行政區
options.labelEn: The Government of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, the Government of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

options.labelZh: 香港特別行政區、香港特別行政區
options.labelEn: The Government of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, the Government of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

options.labelZh: 香港特別行政區政府、香港特別行政區政府
options.labelEn: The Government of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, the Government of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

options.labelZh: 香港特別行政區、香港特別行政區政府
options.labelEn: The Government of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, the Government of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 B。《基本法》第 43 條訂明，行政長官係香港特區嘅首長，亦代表香港特區；兩個空格都係「香港特別行政區」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第一百零三條，公務人員應根據其本人的__________予以任用和提升，香港原有關於公務人員的招聘、僱用、考核、紀律、培訓和管理的制度，包括負責公務人員的任用、薪金、服務條件的專門機構，除有關給予外籍人員特權待遇的規定外，予以保留。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 103 of the Basic Law, public servants shall be appointed and promoted on the basis of their merits. Hong Kong’s original system for the recruitment, employment, assessment, discipline, training and management of public servants, including the specialized agencies responsible for the appointment, salaries and conditions of service of public servants, shall be retained except for the provisions regarding privileged treatment for foreigners.
questions.explanationZh: 答案係 C。《基本法》第 103 條明確訂明：「公務人員應根據其本人的資格、經驗和才能予以任用和提升，香港原有關於公務人員的招聘、僱用、考核、紀律、培訓和管理的制度，包括負責公務人員的任用、薪金、服務條件的專門機構，除有關給予外籍人員特權待遇的規定外，予以保留」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第一百零五條，香港特別行政區依法保護__________財產的取得、使用、處置和繼承的權利，以及依法徵用私人和法人財產時被徵用財產的所有人得到補償的權利。徵用財產的補償應相當於該財產當時的實際價值，可自由兑換，不得無故遲延支付。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 105 of the Basic Law, the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region protects the rights to acquire, use, dispose of and inherit property in accordance with the law, as well as the right to compensation for the owners of the expropriated property when private and legal person property is expropriated in accordance with the law. Compensation for expropriated property shall be equivalent to the actual value of the property at that time, shall be freely convertible, and shall not be paid without unreasonable delay.

options.labelEn: Individuals, legal persons and groups Salt solution

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 C。《基本法》第 105 條明確訂明：「香港特別行政區依法保護私人和法人財產的取得、使用、處置和繼承的權利，以及依法徵用私人和法人財產時被徵用財產的所有人得到補償的權利」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第一百三十七條，各類院校均可保留其 __________，可繼續從香港特別行政區以外招聘教職員和選用教材。宗教組織所辦的學校可繼續提供宗教教育，包括開設宗教課程。

Schools run by religious organizations may continue to provide religious education, including offering religious courses.

options.labelZh: 學術自由並享有獨立性
自主性並享有學術自由
學術自由並享有自主性
獨立性並享有學術自由

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第十條，香港特別行政區區旗有甚麼特徵？
questions.questionEn: According to Article 10 of the Basic Law, what are the characteristics of the regional flag of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region?

options.labelZh: 五星花蕊、洋金菊花、紅色旗
options.labelEn: Five-star stamens, chamomile flowers, red flag

options.labelZh: 五星花蕊、紫荊花、紅色旗
options.labelEn: Five-star stamens, redbud flowers, red flag

options.labelEn: Five-star stamens, redbud flowers, blue flag

options.labelZh: 五星花蕊、紫荊花、橙色旗
options.labelEn: Five-star stamens, redbud flowers, orange flag

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第一百三十四條，中央人民政府授權香港特別行政區政府： 同其他當局商談並簽訂有關執行本法第一百三十三條所指民用航空運輸協定和臨時協議的各項安排； 對在香港特別行政區註冊並以香港為主要營業地的航空公司簽發執照； 依照本法第一百三十三條所指民用航空運輸協定和臨時協議指定航空公司； 對外國航空公司除 __________的航班以外的其他航班簽發許可證。
questions.questionEn: Pursuant to Article 134 of the Basic Law, the Central People's Government authorizes the Government of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region to: negotiate with other authorities and sign various arrangements for the implementation of civil air transport agreements and interim agreements referred to in Article 133 of this Law; issue licenses to airlines registered in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region and with Hong Kong as their principal place of business; designate airlines in accordance with the civil air transport agreements and interim agreements referred to in Article 133 of this Law; issue licenses to foreign airlines for flights other than __________'s flights Certificate.

options.labelZh: 往返中國內地主要城市
options.labelEn: To and from major cities in Mainland China

options.labelZh: 往返、經停中國內地主要城市
options.labelEn: To and from and via major cities in Mainland China
