questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第一百四十八條，香港特別行政區的教育，科學、技術、文化、藝術、體育，專業、醫療衛生、 勞工、社會福利、社會工作等方面的民間團體和宗教組織同內地相應的團體和組織的關係，應以__________的原則為基礎。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 148 of the Basic Law, the relationship between non-governmental organizations and religious organizations in education, science, technology, culture, arts, sports, professions, medical and health, labor, social welfare, social work, etc. in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region and corresponding groups and organizations in the Mainland should be based on the principle of __________.

options.labelZh: 互相尊重、互不干涉和互不隸屬
options.labelEn: Mutual respect, non-interference and mutual non-subordination

options.labelZh: 互相尊重、互不隸屬和互不干涉
options.labelEn: Mutual respect, mutual non-subordination and mutual non-interference

options.labelZh: 互不干涉、互不隸屬和互相尊重
options.labelEn: Mutual non-interference, mutual non-subordination and mutual respect

options.labelZh: 互不隸屬、互不干涉和互相尊重
options.labelEn: Mutual non-subordination, mutual non-interference and mutual respect

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 D。《基本法》第 148 條明確訂明：「香港特別行政區的教育、科學、技術、文化、藝術、體育、專業、醫療衞生、勞工、社會福利、社會工作等方面的民間團體和宗教組織同內地相應的團體和組織的關係，應以互不隸屬、互不干涉和互相尊重的原則為基礎」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第一百五十七條，下列哪項陳述並不正確？ 外國在香港特別行政區設立領事機構或其他官方、半官方機構，須經中央人民政府批准。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 157 of the Basic Law, which of the following statements is incorrect? The establishment of consular missions or other official or semi-official missions by foreign countries in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region must be approved by the Central People's Government.

options.labelZh: 已同中華人民共和國建立正式外交關係的國家在香港設立的領事機構和其他官方機構，可予保留
options.labelEn: Consular missions and other official agencies established in Hong Kong by countries that have established formal diplomatic relations with the People's Republic of China can be retained

options.labelZh: 尚未同中華人民共和國建立正式外交關係的國家在香港設立的領事機構和其他官方機構，可根據情況允許保留或改為半官方機構
options.labelEn: Consular missions and other official agencies established in Hong Kong by countries that have not yet established formal diplomatic relations with the People's Republic of China may be allowed to retain or be changed to semi-official agencies according to the circumstances

options.labelZh: 尚未為中華人民共和國承認的國家，將會逐步在香港特別行政區設立民間機構
options.labelEn: Countries that have not yet been recognized by the People's Republic of China will gradually establish private institutions in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

options.labelZh: 尚未為中華人民共和國承認的國家，只能在香港特別行政區設立民間機構
options.labelEn: Countries that have not yet been recognized by the People's Republic of China can only operate in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region Establish private organizations in different administrative regions

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 C。依據《基本法》第 157 條，「尚未為中華人民共和國承認的國家，將會逐步在香港特別行政區設立民間機構」唔屬於符合條文原意嘅陳述；其餘選項先係條文涵蓋嘅內容。
questions.trapZh: 題目問排除項；要揀出唔屬於符合條文原意嘅陳述嘅「尚未為中華人民共和國承認的國家，將會逐步在香港特別行政區設立民間機構」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第一百一十三條，香港特別行政區的外匯基金，由香港特別行政區政府管理和支配，主要用於__________
questions.questionEn: According to Article 113 of the Basic Law, the Exchange Fund of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region is managed and controlled by the Government of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region. It is mainly used to

options.labelZh: 操控境外資產的規範運作
options.labelEn: Control the standardized operation of overseas assets
Strategic investment in the futures market
Purchase treasury bonds of other countries
Adjust the exchange rate of the Hong Kong dollar

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 D。《基本法》第 113 條明確訂明：「香港特別行政區的外匯基金，由香港特別行政區政府管理和支配，主要用於調節港元匯價」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第六十七條，香港特別行政區立法會由在外國無居留權的香港特别行政區永久性居民中的中國公民組成。但非中國籍的香港特別行政區永久性居民和在外國有居留權的香港特別行政區永久性居民也可以當選為香港特別行政區立法會議員，其所佔比例不得超過立法會全體議員的__________ o
questions.questionEn: According to Article 67 of the Basic Law, the Legislative Council of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region is composed of Chinese citizens who are permanent residents of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region with no right of abode in foreign countries. However, non-Chinese permanent residents of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region and permanent residents of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region with the right of abode in foreign countries can also be elected as members of the Legislative Council of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, and their proportion shall not exceed __________ o

options.labelEn: 40% of all members of the Legislative Council

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 B。《基本法》第 67 條明確訂明：「但非中國籍的香港特別行政區永久性居民和在外國有居留權的香港特別行政區永久性居民也可以當選為香港特別行政區立法會議員，其所佔比例不得超過立法會全體議員的百分之二十」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第七條，香港特別行政區境內的土地和自然資源屬於國家所有，由香港特別行政區政府負責管理、使用、開發、出租或批給__________使用或開發，其收入全歸香港特別行政區政府支配。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 7 of the Basic Law, the land and natural resources within the territory of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region belong to the state and are managed, used, developed, leased or granted to the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region for use or development, and all income from them is at the disposal of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region government.

options.labelEn: Private person, legal person or group

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 C。《基本法》第 7 條明確訂明：「香港特別行政區境內的土地和自然資源屬於國家所有，由香港特別行政區政府負責管理、使用、開發、出租或批給個人、法人或團體使用或開發，其收入全歸香港特別行政區政府支配」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第二十二條，中國其他地區的人進入香港特別行政區須辦理批准手續，其中進入香港特別行政區定居的人數是由__________。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 22 of the Basic Law, people from other parts of China must go through approval procedures to enter the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region. The number of people who enter the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region to settle is __________.

options.labelZh: 香港特別行政區政府決定
options.labelEn: Decision of the Government of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

options.labelZh: 全國人民代表大會常務委員會確定
options.labelEn: Determination by the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress

options.labelZh: 中央人民政府主管部門徵求香港特別行政區政府的意見後確定
options.labelEn: Determination by the competent authorities of the Central People's Government after soliciting the opinions of the Government of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 D。《基本法》第 22 條明確訂明：「中國其他地區的人進入香港特別行政區須辦理批准手續，其中進入香港特別行政區定居的人數由中央人民政府主管部門徵求香港特別行政區政府的意見後確定」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第三十五條，下列哪項並不是香港居民可以享有的權利？
questions.questionEn: According to Article 35 of the Basic Law, which of the following is not a right enjoyed by Hong Kong residents?

options.labelZh: 選擇律師及時保護自己干犯的違法行為
options.labelEn: Choose a lawyer to promptly protect yourself against illegal acts

options.labelZh: 有權對政府行政部門和行政人員的行為向法院提起訴訟
options.labelEn: Have the right to file lawsuits in court against the actions of government administrative departments and administrative personnel

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 A。依據《基本法》第 35 條，「選擇律師及時保護自己干犯的違法行為」唔屬於條文保障嘅權利或自由；其餘選項先係條文涵蓋嘅內容。
questions.trapZh: 題目問排除項；要揀出唔屬於條文保障嘅權利或自由嘅「選擇律師及時保護自己干犯的違法行為」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第四十五條，香港特別行政區行政長官在當地通過選舉或協商產生，由中央人民政府任命。行政長官的產生辦法根據香港特別行政區的實際情況和循序漸進的原則而規定，最終達至由一個有廣泛代表性的提名委員會按 __________程序提名後普選產生的目標。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 45 of the Basic Law, the Chief Executive of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region is elected locally through election or consultation and appointed by the Central People's Government. The method for selecting the Chief Executive is stipulated based on the actual situation of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region and the principle of gradualism, and ultimately achieves the goal of being elected by universal suffrage after nomination by a broadly representative nomination committee in accordance with the procedures.
questions.explanationZh: 答案係 D。《基本法》第 45 條明確訂明：「行政長官的產生辦法根據香港特別行政區的實際情況和循序漸進的原則而規定，最終達至由一個有廣泛代表性的提名委員會按民主程序提名後普選產生的目標」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第五十六條，香港特別行政區行政會議由行政長官主持。 行政長官在作下列哪項決策時，須徵詢行政會議的意見？
questions.questionEn: According to Article 56 of the Basic Law, the Executive Council of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region is chaired by the Chief Executive. When making which of the following decisions, the Chief Executive must consult the Executive Council?

options.labelZh: 緊急情況下採取的措施 7. 根據《基本法》第六十一條，香港特別行政區的主要官員由在香港通常居住連續滿十五年並在外國無居留權的香港特別行政區永久性居民中的中國公民擔任。
options.labelEn: Measures taken in emergency situations 7. According to Article 61 of the Basic Law, the principal officials of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region shall be Chinese citizens who are permanent residents of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region who have ordinarily resided in Hong Kong for fifteen consecutive years and have no right of abode in any foreign country.

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 B。《基本法》第 56 條明確訂明：「行政長官在作出重要決策、向立法會提交法案、制定附屬法規和解散立法會前，須徵詢行政會議的意見，但人事任免、紀律制裁和緊急情況下採取的措施除外」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第一百零一條，下列哪位官員並不需要在外國無居留權的永久性居民中的中國公民擔任？
questions.questionEn: According to Article 101 of the Basic Law, which of the following officials is not required to be a Chinese citizen who is a permanent resident without the right of abode in a foreign country?
questions.explanationZh: 答案係 B。依據《基本法》第 101 條，「申訴專員」唔屬於必須符合有關國籍及居留資格限制嘅職位；其餘選項先係條文涵蓋嘅內容。
questions.trapZh: 題目問排除項；要揀出唔屬於必須符合有關國籍及居留資格限制嘅職位嘅「申訴專員」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第一百零三條，公務人員應根據其本人的 __________以任用和提升，香港原有關於公務人員的招聘、 僱用、考核、紀律、培訓和管理的制度，包括負責公務人員的任用、薪金、服務條件的專門機構，除有關給予外籍人員特權待遇的規定外，予以保留。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 103 of the Basic Law, public servants shall be appointed and promoted on the basis of their own merits. Hong Kong’s original system for the recruitment, employment, assessment, discipline, training and management of public servants, including the specialized agencies responsible for the appointment, salary and service conditions of public servants, shall be retained except for the provisions regarding privileged treatment for foreign personnel.
questions.explanationZh: 答案係 B。《基本法》第 103 條明確訂明：「公務人員應根據其本人的資格、經驗和才能予以任用和提升，香港原有關於公務人員的招聘、僱用、考核、紀律、培訓和管理的制度，包括負責公務人員的任用、薪金、服務條件的專門機構，除有關給予外籍人員特權待遇的規定外，予以保留」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第一百二十條，香港特別行政區成立前已批出、決定、或續期的超越一九九七年六月三十日年期的所有土地契約和與土地契約有關的一切權利，均按香港特別行政區的法律繼續 __________。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 120 of the Basic Law, all land contracts and all rights related to the land contracts that have been granted, decided or renewed before the establishment of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region for a term beyond June 30, 1997 shall continue in accordance with the laws of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.
questions.explanationZh: 答案係 B。《基本法》第 120 條明確訂明：「香港特別行政區成立以前已批出、決定、或續期的超越一九九七年六月三十日年期的所有土地契約和與土地契約有關的一切權利，均按香港特別行政區的法律繼續予以承認和保護」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第一百三十七條，各類院校均可保留 __________，可繼續從香港特別行政區以外招聘教職員和選用教材。宗教組織所辦的學校可繼續提供宗教教育，包括開， 設宗教課程。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 137 of the Basic Law, all types of institutions can retain __________ and continue to recruit teaching staff and select teaching materials from outside the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region. Schools run by religious organizations can continue to provide religious education, including offering religious courses.

options.labelZh: 學術自由並享有獨立性
學術自由並享有自主性
獨立性並享有學術自由
自主性並享有學術自由

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 D。《基本法》第 137 條明確訂明：「各類院校均可保留其自主性並享有學術自由，可繼續從香港特別行政區以外招聘教職員和選用教材」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第四十一條，在香港特別行政區境內的香港居民以外的其他人，依法享有本章規定的香港居民的__________。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 41 of the Basic Law, persons other than Hong Kong residents in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region shall enjoy the rights of Hong Kong residents stipulated in this Chapter in accordance with the law.
questions.explanationZh: 答案係 C。《基本法》第 41 條明確訂明：「在香港特別行政區境內的香港居民以外的其他人，依法享有本章規定的香港居民的權利和自由」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第四十九條，香港特別行政區「行政長官」如認為立法會通過的法案不符合香港特別行政區的整體利益，可在幾多個月內將法案發回立法會重議？ 立法會如以不少於全體議員三分之二多數再次通過原案，行政長官必須在一個月內簽署公佈或按本法第五十條的規定處理。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 49 of the Basic Law, if the Chief Executive of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region considers that a bill passed by the Legislative Council is not in the overall interest of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, within how many months can he send the bill back to the Legislative Council for reconsideration? If the Legislative Council re-passes the original bill by no less than a two-thirds majority of all members, the Chief Executive must sign and publish it within one month or handle it in accordance with the provisions of Article 50 of this Law.
questions.explanationZh: 答案係 C。《基本法》第 49 條明確訂明：「香港特別行政區行政長官如認為立法會通過的法案不符合香港特別行政區的整體利益，可在三個月內將法案發回立法會重議，立法會如以不少於全體議員三分之二多數再次通過原案，行政長官必須在一個月內簽署公布或按本法第五十條的規定處理」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第四十五條，香港特別行政區行政長官由誰任命？
questions.questionEn: According to Article 45 of the Basic Law, who appoints the Chief Executive of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region?
questions.explanationZh: 答案係 D。《基本法》第 45 條明確訂明：「香港特別行政區行政長官在當地通過選舉或協商產生，由中央人民政府任命」。
questions.trapZh: 唔好交換權力主體；條文指定嘅係「中央人民政府」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》第二十三條，香港特別行政區應自行立法禁止__________行為，禁止外國的政治性組織或團體在香港特別行政區進行政治活動，禁止香港特別行政區的政治性組織或團體與外國的政治性組織或團體建立聯繫。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 23 of the Basic Law, the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region shall enact legislation on its own to prohibit foreign political organizations or groups from conducting political activities in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, and prohibit political organizations or groups in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region from establishing ties with foreign political organizations or groups.

options.labelZh: 任何叛國、分裂國家、煽動叛亂、顛覆中央人民政府及竊取國家機密的行為，
options.labelEn: Any act of treason, secession, sedition, subversion of the Central People's Government and theft of state secrets,

options.labelZh: 任何叛國、煽動叛亂、顛覆中央人民政府及竊取國家機密的行為，
options.labelEn: Any act of treason, sedition, subversion of the Central People's Government and theft of state secrets,

options.labelZh: 分裂國家、煽動叛亂、顛覆中央人民政府及竊取國家機密的行為，
options.labelEn: Any act of secession, sedition, subversion of the Central People's Government and theft of state secrets,

options.labelZh: 顛覆中央人民政府及竊取國家機密的行為。
options.labelEn: Acts of subverting the Central People's Government and stealing state secrets.

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 A。《基本法》第 23 條明確訂明：「香港特別行政區應自行立法禁止任何叛國、分裂國家、煽動叛亂、顛覆中央人民政府及竊取國家機密的行為，禁止外國的政治性組織或團體在香港特別行政區進行政治活動，禁止香港特別行政區的政治性組織或團體與外國的政治性組織或團體建立聯繫」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《基本法》附件三，在香港特別行政區實施的全國性法律，下列有哪些全國性法律，是自一九九七年七月一日起由香港特別行政區在當地公佈或立法實施？
questions.questionEn: According to Annex III of the Basic Law, the national laws implemented in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region. Which of the following national laws have been promulgated or implemented by legislation locally by the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region since July 1, 1997?

options.labelZh: 關於中華人民共和國國慶日的決議、中華人民共和國國徽法、中華人民共和國海洋法、中華人民共和國領海和毗連區法
options.labelEn: Resolution on the National Emblem of the People's Republic of China, National Emblem Law of the People's Republic of China, Maritime Law of the People's Republic of China, Law of the Territorial Sea and Contiguous Zone of the People's Republic of China

options.labelZh: 關於中華人民共和國國徽的決議、關於中華人民共和國國慶日的決議、中華人民共和國國籍法、中華人民共和國國旗法
options.labelEn: Resolution on the National Emblem of the People's Republic of China, Resolution on the National Day of the People's Republic of China, Nationality Law of the People's Republic of China, National Flag Law of the People's Republic of China

options.labelZh: 中華人民共和國國徽法、中華人民共和國政府關於領海的聲明、中華人民共和國外交特權與豁免條例、中華人民共和國領事特權與豁免條例
options.labelEn: Declaration on the Territorial Sea, Regulations of the People’s Republic of China on Diplomatic Privileges and Immunities, Regulations of the People’s Republic of China on Consular Privileges and Immunities

options.labelZh: 中華人民共和國領海和毗連區法、中華人民共和國海洋法、中華人民共和國香港特別行政區駐軍法、 中華人民共和國專屬經濟區和大陸架法
options.labelEn: Law of the People's Republic of China on the Territorial Sea and Contiguous Zone, Law of the Sea of ​​the People's Republic of China, Garrison Law of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region of the People's Republic of China, Law of the People's Republic of China on the Exclusive Economic Zone and Continental Shelf

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 C。題目列出嘅四項——國徽法、領海聲明、外交特權與豁免條例同領事特權與豁免條例——都載於《基本法》附件三嘅全國性法律名單；其他組合混入名單以外法律。

questions.questionZh: 根據《中華人民共和國香港特別行政區維護國家安全法》第三條，香港特別行政區負有__________的憲制責任，應當履行維護國家安全的職責。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 3 of the Law of the People's Republic of China on Safeguarding National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region shall fulfill its constitutional responsibilities in safeguarding national security.
questions.explanationZh: 答案係 B。《香港國安法》第 3 條明確訂明：「香港特別行政區負有維護國家安全的憲制責任，應當履行維護國家安全的職責」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《中華人民共和國香港特別行政區維護國家安全法》第四條，香港特別行政區維護國家安全應當和 __________。
questions.questionEn: According to Hong Kong National Security Law Article 4, According to Article 4 of the Law of the People’s Republic of China on Safeguarding National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region shall safeguard national security and __________.

options.labelZh: 尊重他人的自由和保障市民生命財產
options.labelEn: Respect the freedom of others and protect citizens’ lives and property
Mutual respect, equality and mutual benefit

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 A。《香港國安法》第 4 條明確訂明：「香港特別行政區維護國家安全應當尊重和保障人權，依法保護香港特別行政區居民根據香港特別行政區基本法和《公民權利和政治權利國際公約》、《經濟、社會與…」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《中華人民共和國香港特別行政區維護國家安全法》第五條，在防範、制止和懲治危害國家安全犯罪，應當堅持__________原則。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 5 of the Law of the People's Republic of China on Safeguarding National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, principles must be adhered to in preventing, stopping and punishing crimes that endanger national security.
questions.explanationZh: 答案係 B。《香港國安法》第 5 條明確訂明：「防範，制止和懲治危害國家安全犯罪，應當堅持法治原則」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《中華人民共和國香港特別行政區維護國家安全法》第八條，執法、司法機關應當切實執行本法和香港特別行政區現行法律有關__________和__________危害國家安全行為和活動的規定，有效維護國家安全。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 8 of the Law of the People's Republic of China on Safeguarding National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, law enforcement and judicial agencies should effectively implement the provisions of this Law and the existing laws of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region regarding behaviors and activities that endanger national security, and effectively safeguard national security.
questions.explanationZh: 答案係 C。《香港國安法》第 8 條明確訂明：「香港特別行政區執法、司法機關應當切實執行本法和香港特別行政區現行法律有關防範、制止和懲治危害國家安全行為和活動的規定，有效維護國家安全」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《中華人民共和國香港特別行政區維護國家安全法》第九條，香港特別行政區應當加強維護國家安全和防範恐怖活動的工作。對學校、社會團體、媒體、網絡等涉及國家安全的事宜，香港特別行政區政府應當採取必要措施， 加強__________和__________
questions.questionEn: According to Article 9 of the Law of the People's Republic of China on Safeguarding National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region shall strengthen its work in safeguarding national security and preventing terrorist activities. For matters related to national security such as schools, social groups, media, and the Internet, the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region government should take necessary measures to strengthen and
questions.explanationZh: 答案係 A。《香港國安法》第 9 條明確訂明：「對學校、社會團體、媒體、網絡等涉及國家安全的事宜，香港特別行政區政府應當採取必要措施，加強宣傳、指導、監督和管理」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《中華人民共和國香港特別行政區維護國家安全法》第二十九條〈勾結外國或者境外勢力危害國家安全罪〉， 為外國或者境外機構、組織、人員竊取、刺探、收買、非法提供涉及國家安全的__________或者__________的均屬犯罪。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 29 of the Law of the People's Republic of China on Safeguarding National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, "The Crime of Colluding with Foreign Countries or Overseas Forces to Endanger National Security", it is a crime to steal, spy on, bribe, or illegally provide information related to national security to foreign or overseas institutions, organizations, or personnel.

options.labelZh: 重大秘密或者絕密情報
洩秘或者是危害國家安全
options.labelEn: Leaking secrets or endangering national security

options.labelZh: 國家機密或者進行間諜活動

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 A。《香港國安法》第 29 條明確訂明：「為外國或者境外機構、組織、人員竊取、刺探、收買、非法提供涉及國家安全的國家秘密或者情報的」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《中華人民共和國香港特別行政區維護國家安全法》第三十一條，公司、團體等__________或者__________因犯本法規定的罪行受到刑事處罰的，應責令其暫停運作或者吊銷其執照或者營業許可證。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 31 of the Law of the People's Republic of China on Safeguarding National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, companies, groups, etc. that are subject to criminal penalties for committing crimes stipulated in this law shall be ordered to suspend operations or have their licenses or business permits revoked.

options.labelEn: Member or member of the board of directors

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 D。《香港國安法》第 31 條明確訂明：「公司、團體等法人或者非法人組織因犯本法規定的罪行受到刑事處罰的，應責令其暫停運作或者吊銷其執照或者營業許可證」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《中華人民共和國香港特別行政區維護國家安全法》第四十一條，香港特別行政區管轄危害國家安全犯罪案件的立案__________和__________的執行等訴訟程序事宜，適用本法和香港特別行政區本地法律。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 41 of the Law of the People's Republic of China on Safeguarding National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region has jurisdiction over the filing and execution of criminal cases endangering national security and other procedural matters. This Law and the local laws of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region shall apply.
questions.explanationZh: 答案係 A。《香港國安法》第 41 條明確訂明：「香港特別行政區管轄危害國家安全犯罪案件的立案偵查、檢控、審判和刑罰的執行等訴訟程序事宜，適用本法和香港特別行政區本地法律」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《中華人民共和國香港特別行政區維護國家安全法》第六十條持有駐香港特別行政區維護國家安全公署制發的證件或者證明文件的人員和車輛等在執行職務時不受香港特別行政區執法人員__________和__________。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 60 of the Law of the People's Republic of China on Safeguarding National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, persons and vehicles holding certificates or certification documents issued by the Office for Safeguarding National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region are not subject to the supervision of law enforcement officers of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region when performing their duties.
questions.explanationZh: 答案係 B。《香港國安法》第 60 條明確訂明：「持有駐香港特別行政區維護國家安全公署制發的證件或者證明文件的人員和車輛等在執行職務時不受香港特別行政區執法人員檢查、搜查和扣押」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《中華人民共和國香港特別行政區維護國家安全法》第四十四條，在裁判法院、區域法院、高等法院和終審法院就危害國家安全犯罪案件提起的刑事檢控程序應當分別由各該法院的__________處理。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 44 of the Law of the People's Republic of China on Safeguarding National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, criminal prosecution procedures for cases of crimes endangering national security initiated in the magistrates' courts, regional courts, high courts and courts of final appeal shall be handled by the respective courts respectively.
questions.explanationZh: 答案係 B。《香港國安法》第 44 條明確訂明：「在裁判法院、區域法院、高等法院和終審法院就危害國家安全犯罪案件提起的刑事檢控程序應當分別由各該法院的指定法官處理」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《中華人民共和國香港特別行政區維護國家安全法》第四十六條，凡律政司長發出證書，高等法院原訟法庭應當在沒有陪審團的情況下進行審理，並由__________法官組成審判庭。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 46 of the "Law of the People's Republic of China on Safeguarding National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region", whenever the Secretary for Justice issues a certificate, the Court of First Instance of the High Court shall conduct a trial without a jury and shall consist of a trial panel composed of judges.
questions.explanationZh: 答案係 B。《香港國安法》第 46 條明確訂明：「凡律政司長發出上述證書，高等法院原訟法庭應當在沒有陪審團的情況下進行審理，並由三名法官組成審判庭」。
questions.trapZh: 呢題考法定數字：準確答案係「三名」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《中華人民共和國香港特別行政區維護國家安全法》第四十九條，以下哪一項並不是駐香港特別行政區維護國家安全公署的職責：
questions.questionEn: According to Article 49 of the Law of the People's Republic of China on Safeguarding National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, which of the following is not the responsibility of the National Security Office in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region:

options.labelZh: 分析研判香港特別行政區維護國家安全形勢，就維護國家安全重大戰略和重要政策提出意見和建議
options.labelEn: Analyze and judge the situation of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region in safeguarding national security, and provide opinions and suggestions on major strategies and policies for safeguarding national security

options.labelZh: 監督、指導、協調、支持香港特別行政區履行維護國家安全的職責
options.labelEn: Supervise, guide, coordinate, and support the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region in fulfilling its duties of safeguarding national security

options.labelZh: 打擊危害國家安全犯罪分子清洗黑錢及資金籌集
options.labelEn: Combat money laundering and fund-raising by criminals that endanger national security

options.labelZh: 收集分析國家安全情報信息
options.labelEn: Collect and analyze national security intelligence information

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 C。依據《香港國安法》第 49 條，「打擊危害國家安全犯罪分子清洗黑錢及資金籌集」唔屬於條文列明嘅職責；其餘選項先係條文涵蓋嘅內容。
questions.trapZh: 題目問排除項；要揀出唔屬於條文列明嘅職責嘅「打擊危害國家安全犯罪分子清洗黑錢及資金籌集」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《中華人民共和國香港特別行政區維護國家安全法》第五十一條，中央人民政府駐香港特別行政區維護國家安全公署的經費是由那機構負責？
questions.questionEn: According to Article 51 of the Law of the People's Republic of China on Safeguarding National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, which agency is responsible for the funding of the Office of the Central People's Government in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region for Safeguarding National Security?
questions.explanationZh: 答案係 D。《香港國安法》第 51 條明確訂明：「駐香港特別行政區維護國家安全公署的經費由中央財政保障」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《中華人民共和國香港特別行政區維護國家安全法》第六十條，駐香港特別行政區維護國家安全公署及其人員依據本法執行職務的行為，不受__________管轄。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 60 of the "Law of the People's Republic of China on Safeguarding National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region", the Office for Safeguarding National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region and its personnel are not subject to jurisdiction when performing their duties in accordance with this law.
questions.explanationZh: 答案係 D。《香港國安法》第 60 條明確訂明：「駐香港特別行政區維護國家安全公署及其人員依據本法執行職務的行為，不受香港特別行政區管轄」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《中華人民共和國香港特別行政區維護國家安全法》第六十五條，本法的解釋權屬於__________.
questions.questionEn: According to Article 65 of the "Law of the People's Republic of China on Safeguarding National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region", the right to interpret this law belongs to.

options.labelEn: Department of Justice and Security Bureau

options.labelZh: 全國人民代表大會常務委員會
options.labelEn: Standing Committee of the National People's Congress

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 D。《香港國安法》第 65 條明確訂明：「本法的解釋權屬於全國人民代表大會常務委員會」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《2020年全國性法律公布》，按《基本法》第十八條，把《中華人民共和國香港特別行政區維護國家安全法》列入《基本法》的那一條條文之中？
questions.questionEn: According to the "2020 National Law Promulgation" and Article 18 of the "Basic Law", the "Law of the People's Republic of China on Safeguarding National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region" is included in which article of the "Basic Law"?
questions.explanationZh: 答案係 D。《香港國安法》公布安排明確訂明：「《香港國安法》由全國人大常委會通過並列入《基本法》附件三，在香港特別行政區公布實施」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《中華人民共和國香港特別行政區維護國家安全法》第一條，為堅定不移並全面準確貫徹「一國兩制」、「港人治港」、高度自治的方針，維護國家安全，防範、制止和懲治與香港特別行政區有關的犯罪。以下那一項並不是相關之罪行？
questions.questionEn: According to Article 1 of the Law of the People's Republic of China on Safeguarding National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, in order to unswervingly and comprehensively and accurately implement the principles of "one country, two systems", "Hong Kong people governing Hong Kong" and a high degree of autonomy, safeguard national security, and prevent, suppress and punish crimes related to the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region. Which of the following is not a related crime?

options.labelEn: Organization and implementation of terrorist activities

options.labelZh: 串謀煽動他人破壞國家罪
options.labelEn: Conspiracy to incite others to undermine the state

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 D。依據《香港國安法》第 1 條，「串謀煽動他人破壞國家罪」唔屬於條文列明嘅犯罪或禁止行為；其餘選項先係條文涵蓋嘅內容。
questions.trapZh: 題目問排除項；要揀出唔屬於條文列明嘅犯罪或禁止行為嘅「串謀煽動他人破壞國家罪」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《中華人民共和國香港特別行政區維護國家安全法》第三條，香港特別行政區的哪些機關，應當依據本法和其他有關法律規定，有效防範、制止和懲治危害國家安全的行為和活動？
questions.questionEn: According to Article 3 of the Law of the People's Republic of China on Safeguarding National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, which organs of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region should effectively prevent, stop and punish behaviors and activities that endanger national security in accordance with this law and other relevant legal provisions?
questions.explanationZh: 答案係 D。《香港國安法》第 3 條列出嘅對象或情況包括題目 A、B、C 三項，所以「以上皆是」先完整涵蓋條文要求。只揀其中一項會漏咗其餘同樣受規管嘅內容。

questions.questionZh: 根據《中華人民共和國香港特別行政區維護國家安全法》第十三條，香港特別行政區維護國家安全委員會下設秘書處，由秘書長領導。秘書長由行政長官提名， 報__________任命。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 13 of the Law of the People's Republic of China on Safeguarding National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, the Committee for Safeguarding National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region has a secretariat, headed by the Secretary-General. The Secretary-General is nominated by the Chief Executive and appointed upon submission.

options.labelEn: Liaison Office of the Central People’s Government

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 C。《香港國安法》第 13 條明確訂明：「秘書長由行政長官提名，報中央人民政府任命」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《中華人民共和國香港特別行政區維護國家安全法》第五條，任何人未經__________ 之前均假定無罪。保障犯罪嫌疑人、被告人和其他訴訟參與人依法享有的辯護權和其他訴訟權利。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 5 of the "Law of the People's Republic of China on Safeguarding National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region", anyone who has not been arrested before is presumed innocent. The defense rights and other litigation rights enjoyed by criminal suspects, defendants and other litigation participants in accordance with the law are guaranteed.

options.labelZh: 警務處國家安全處落案控告
options.labelEn: Prosecution by the National Security Division of the Police

options.labelZh: 律政司國家安全犯罪案件部門檢控
options.labelEn: Prosecution by the National Security Crime Division of the Department of Justice

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 B。《香港國安法》第 5 條明確訂明：「任何人未經司法機關判罪之前均假定無罪」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《中華人民共和國香港特別行政區維護國家安全法》第六條， __________和是包括香港同胞在內的全中國人民的共同義務。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 6 of the "Law of the People's Republic of China on Safeguarding National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region", __________ and __________ are the common obligations of all Chinese people, including Hong Kong compatriots.

options.labelZh: 維護國家安全、核心和領士權益
options.labelEn: Safeguard national security, core and community rights and interests

options.labelZh: 維護國家主權、統一和領土完整
options.labelEn: Maintain national sovereignty, unity and territorial integrity

options.labelZh: 維護國家領士、主權和政權完整
options.labelEn: Maintain national security, sovereignty and political integrity

options.labelZh: 維護國家尊嚴、民族和人民的尊嚴
options.labelEn: Maintain the dignity of the country, the nation and the people

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 B。《香港國安法》第 6 條明確訂明：「維護國家主權、統一和領土完整是包括香港同胞在內的全中國人民的共同義務」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《中華人民共和國香港特別行政區維護國家安全法》第九條，香港特別行政區應當加強維護國家安全和防範__________的工作。對學校、社會團體、媒體、網絡等涉及國家安全的事宜，香港特別行政區政府應當採取必要措施，加強宣傳、指導、監督和管理。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 9 of the Law of the People's Republic of China on Safeguarding National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region shall strengthen its work in safeguarding national security and prevention. For matters related to national security in schools, social groups, media, the Internet, etc., the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region government should take necessary measures to strengthen publicity, guidance, supervision and management.
questions.explanationZh: 答案係 C。《香港國安法》第 9 條明確訂明：「香港特別行政區應當加強維護國家安全和防範恐怖活動的工作」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《中華人民共和國香港特別行政區維護國家安全法》第十條，香港特別行政區應當通過學校、社會團體、媒體、網絡等開展國家安全教育，提高香港特別行政區居民的__________和__________
questions.questionEn: According to Article 10 of the Law of the People's Republic of China on Safeguarding National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region shall carry out national security education through schools, social groups, media, the Internet, etc., to improve the awareness and awareness of residents of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

options.labelEn: Safety awareness and legal compliance awareness

options.labelZh: 國家安全意識和守法意識
options.labelEn: National security awareness and law-abiding awareness

options.labelZh: 維護香港特別行政區穩定和守法意識
options.labelEn: Maintain the stability and law-abiding awareness of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

options.labelZh: 維護國家安全法律的意識和守法意識
options.labelEn: Awareness of safeguarding national security laws and awareness of law-abiding

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 B。《香港國安法》第 10 條明確訂明：「香港特別行政區應當通過學校、社會團體、媒體、 網絡等開展國家安全教育，提高香港特別行政區居民的國家安全意識和守法意識」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《中華人民共和國香港特別行政區維護國家安全法》第十一條，如 __________提出要求，行政長官應當就維護國家安全特定事項及時提交報告。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 11 of the Law of the People's Republic of China on Safeguarding National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, if requested, the Chief Executive shall submit a timely report on specific matters for safeguarding national security.

options.labelZh: 中央人民政府駐香港特別行政區聯絡辦公室（中聯辦）
options.labelEn: Liaison Office of the Central People's Government in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region (Liaison Office of the Central People's Government)

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 A。《香港國安法》第 11 條明確訂明：「如中央人民政府提出要求，行政長官應當就維護國家安全特定事項及時提交報告」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《中華人民共和國香港特別行政區維護國家安全法》第十二條，香港特別行政區設立維護國家安全委員會，負責香港特別行政區維護國家安全事務，承擔維護國家安全的主要責任，並接受__________ 的監督和問責。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 12 of the Law of the People's Republic of China on Safeguarding National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region has established a National Security Committee to be responsible for safeguarding national security affairs in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, assume the main responsibility for safeguarding national security, and accept the supervision and accountability of the __________.

options.labelZh: 外交部駐港特派員公署
options.labelEn: Office of the Commissioner of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs in Hong Kong

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 B。《香港國安法》第 12 條明確訂明：「香港特別行政區設立維護國家安全委員會，負責香港特別行政區維護國家安全事務，承擔維護國家安全的主要責任，並接受中央人民政府的監督和問責」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《中華人民共和國香港特別行政區維護國家安全法》第十三條，香港特別行政區維護國家安全委員會由行政長官擔任主席，成員並不包括以下那一位？
questions.questionEn: According to Article 13 of the Law of the People's Republic of China on Safeguarding National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, the Committee for Safeguarding National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region is chaired by the Chief Executive, and its members do not include who among the following?
questions.explanationZh: 答案係 D。依據《香港國安法》第 13 條，「立法會主席」唔屬於條文列明嘅成員名單；其餘選項先係條文涵蓋嘅內容。
questions.trapZh: 題目問排除項；要揀出唔屬於條文列明嘅成員名單嘅「立法會主席」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《中華人民共和國香港特別行政區維護國家安全法》第十四條，香港特別行政區維護國家安全委員會作出的決定不受__________。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 14 of the Law of the People's Republic of China on Safeguarding National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, decisions made by the Committee for Safeguarding National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region shall not be subject to any decision.

options.labelZh: 終審法院的常規及程序規管
options.labelEn: Regulation of practice and procedure of the Court of Final Appeal

options.labelZh: 香港特別行政區的法律規管
options.labelEn: Legal regulation of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 A。《香港國安法》第 14 條明確訂明：「香港特別行政區維護國家安全委員會作出的決定不受司法覆核」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《中華人民共和國香港特別行政區維護國家安全法》第十五條，香港特別行政區維護國家安全委員會設立__________，由中央人民政府指派，就香港特別行政區維護國家安全委員會履行職責相關事務提供意見。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 15 of the Law of the People's Republic of China on Safeguarding National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, the Committee for Safeguarding National Security of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region was established and was designated by the Central People's Government to provide advice on matters related to the performance of the duties of the Committee for Safeguarding National Security of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

options.labelZh: 警務處副處長（國家安全）
維護國家安全檢控專員
options.labelEn: Prosecutorial Commissioner for the Maintenance of National Security

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 B。《香港國安法》第 15 條明確訂明：「香港特別行政區維護國家安全委員會設立國家安全事務顧問，由中央人民政府指派，就香港特別行政區維護國家安全委員會履行職責相關事務提供意見」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《中華人民共和國香港特別行政區維護國家安全法》第十六條，警務處維護國家安全部門負責人由行政長官任命，行政長官任命前須書面徵求__________的意見。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 16 of the Law of the People's Republic of China on Safeguarding National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, the person in charge of the National Security Department of the Police Force is appointed by the Chief Executive, and the Chief Executive must seek written advice before appointment.

options.labelZh: 中華人民共和國全國人民代表大會常務委員會
options.labelEn: Standing Committee of the National People's Congress of the People's Republic of China

options.labelZh: 中央人民政府駐香港特別行政區維護國家安全公署
options.labelEn: Office of the Central People's Government in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region for Safeguarding National Security

options.labelZh: 中華人民共和國外交部駐香港特別行政區特派員公署
options.labelEn: Office of the Commissioner of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the People's Republic of China in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

options.labelZh: 中央人民政府駐香港特別行政區聯絡辦公室（中聯辦）
options.labelEn: Liaison Office of the Central People's Government in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region (Liaison Office of the Central People's Government in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region)

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 B。《香港國安法》第 16 條要求行政長官任命警務處國安部門負責人前，書面徵求第 48 條所指機構嘅意見；第 48 條所指係中央人民政府駐香港特區維護國家安全公署。

questions.questionZh: 根據《中華人民共和國香港特別行政區維護國家安全法》第十九條，財政司長須多久就維護國家安全的開支的控制和管理向立法會提交報告。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 19 of the Law of the People's Republic of China on Safeguarding National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, how often the Financial Secretary must submit a report to the Legislative Council on the control and management of expenditures for safeguarding national security.
questions.explanationZh: 答案係 B。《香港國安法》第 19 條明確訂明：「財政司長須每年就該款項的控制和管理向立法會提交報告」。
questions.trapZh: 呢題考法定數字：準確答案係「每年」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《中華人民共和國香港特別行政區維護國家安全法》第二十條〈分裂國家罪〉，任何人組織、策劃、實施或者參與實施以下旨在分裂國家、破壞國家統一行為之一的， 不論是否使用武力或者以武力相威脅，即屬犯罪： 對首要分子或者果行重大的，處或者 __________有期徒刑。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 20 of the "Law of the People's Republic of China on Safeguarding National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region" ("The Crime of Secession"), any person who organizes, plans, implements or participates in the implementation of any of the following acts aimed at splitting the country or undermining national unity shall be guilty of a crime, regardless of whether he or she uses force or threatens force: The ringleader or those who commit serious acts shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment or fixed-term imprisonment.

options.labelZh: 無期徒刑或者五年以上
options.labelEn: Life imprisonment or more than five years

options.labelZh: 無期徒刑或者十年以上
options.labelEn: Life imprisonment or more than ten years

options.labelZh: 無期徒刑或者十五年以上
options.labelEn: Life imprisonment or more than fifteen years

options.labelZh: 無期徒刑或者二十年以上
options.labelEn: Life imprisonment or more than twenty years

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 B。《香港國安法》第 20 條明確訂明：「犯前款罪，對首要分子或者罪行重大的，處無期徒刑或者十年以上有期徒刑：對積極參加的，處三年以上十年以下有期徒刑」。
questions.trapZh: 呢題考法定數字：準確答案係「無期徒刑或者十年以上」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《中華人民共和國香港特別行政區維護國家安全法》第一條，旨在切實防範、制止和懲治那些嚴重危害國家安全的罪行？
questions.questionEn: According to Article 1 of the Law of the People's Republic of China on Safeguarding National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, it aims to effectively prevent, stop and punish those crimes that seriously endanger national security?

options.labelEn: The crime of subversion of state power

options.labelZh: 勾結外國或者境外勢力危害國家安全罪
options.labelEn: The crime of colluding with foreign countries or external forces to endanger national security

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 D。《香港國安法》第 1 條列出嘅對象或情況包括題目 A、B、C 三項，所以「以上皆是」先完整涵蓋條文要求。只揀其中一項會漏咗其餘同樣受規管嘅內容。

questions.questionZh: 根據《中華人民共和國香港特別行政區維護國家安全法》第六條，香港特別行政區居民在參選或者就任公職時，應當依法簽署文件確認或者宣誓擁護《中華人民共和國香港特別行政區基本法》以及效忠__________？
questions.questionEn: According to Article 6 of the "Law of the People's Republic of China on Safeguarding National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region", when residents of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region run for election or hold public office, they shall sign documents in accordance with the law to confirm or swear to support the "Basic Law of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region of the People's Republic of China" and allegiance?

options.labelZh: 香港特別行政區行政長官
options.labelEn: Chief Executive of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

options.labelZh: 中華人民共和國香港特別行政區
options.labelEn: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region of the People’s Republic of China

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 D。《香港國安法》第 6 條明確訂明：「香港特別行政區居民在參選或者就任公職時應當依法簽署文件確認或者宣誓擁護中華人民共和國香港特別行政區基本法，效忠中華人民共和國香港特別行政區」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《中華人民共和國香港特別行政區維護國家安全法》第三十六條在香港特別行政區註冊的船舶或者__________內實施本法規定的犯罪的，也適用本法。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 36 of the Law of the People's Republic of China on Safeguarding National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, this Law shall also apply to crimes stipulated in this Law on ships registered in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region or on board.
questions.explanationZh: 答案係 C。《香港國安法》第 36 條明確將喺香港註冊船舶或航空器內實施嘅本法罪行納入適用範圍；條文用字係「航空器」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《中華人民共和國香港特別行政區維護國家安全法》第四十一條，未經__________書面同意，任何人不得就危害國家安全犯罪案件提出檢控。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 41 of the Law of the People's Republic of China on Safeguarding National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, no one may prosecute cases of crimes endangering national security without written consent.

options.labelZh: 警務處副處長（國家安全）

options.labelEn: Office for the Maintenance of National Security

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 A。《香港國安法》第 41 條明確訂明：「未經律政司長書面同意，任何人不得就危害國家安全犯罪案件提出檢控」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《中華人民共和國香港特別行政區維護國家安全法》第四十一條，因為涉及__________等情形不宜公開審理的，禁止新聞界和公眾旁聽全部或者一部分審理程序，但判決結果應當一律公開宣佈。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 41 of the "Law of the People's Republic of China on Safeguarding National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region", if a public trial is inappropriate due to circumstances such as involvement, the press and the public are prohibited from observing all or part of the trial proceedings, but the judgment results must be announced publicly.

options.labelZh: 國家利益、官方機密條例
危害國家安全、顛覆國家政權
options.labelEn: Endangering national security, subverting state power

options.labelZh: 中華人民共和國國家機密、香港特別行政區秘密
options.labelEn: State secrets of the People’s Republic of China, secrets of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 A。《香港國安法》第 41 條明確訂明：「因為涉及國家秘密、公共秩序等情形不宜公開審理的，禁止新聞界和公眾旁聽全部或者一部分審理程序，但判決結果應當一律公開宣佈」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《中華人民共和國香港特別行政區維護國家安全法》第四十二條，香港特別行政區執法、司法機關在適用香港特別行政區現行法律有關羈押、審理期限等方面的規定時，應當確保危害國家安全犯罪案件公正、及時辦理，有效和 __________危害國家安全犯罪。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 42 of the Law of the People's Republic of China on Safeguarding National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, the law enforcement and judicial organs of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, when applying the current laws of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region regarding detention and trial periods, shall ensure that cases of crimes endangering national security are handled fairly, timely, effectively and __________ crimes endangering national security.
questions.explanationZh: 答案係 A。《香港國安法》第 42 條明確訂明：「香港特別行政區執法、司法機關在適用香港特別行政區現行法律有關羈押、審理期限等方面的規定時，應當確保危害國家安全犯罪案件公正、及時辦理，有效防範、制止和懲治危害國家安全犯罪」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《中華人民共和國香港特別行政區維護國家安全法》第四十三條，香港特別行政區政府警務處維護國家安全部門辦理危害國家安全犯罪案件時，可以採取香港特別行政區現行法律准予警方等執法部門在調查嚴重犯罪案件時採取的各種措施，並可以採取以下措施：
questions.questionEn: According to Hong Kong National Security Law Article 43, According to Article 43 of the "Law of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region of the People's Republic of China on Safeguarding National Security", when handling cases of crimes endangering national security, the National Security Department of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region Government Police Force may adopt various measures that the current laws of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region allow the police and other law enforcement agencies to take when investigating serious criminal cases, and may take the following measures:

options.labelZh: 對有合理理由懷疑擁有與偵查有關的資料或者管有有關物料的人員，要求其回答問題和提交資料或者物料
options.labelEn: For those who have reasonable grounds to suspect that they possess information related to the investigation or are in possession of relevant materials, require them to answer questions and submit information or materials

options.labelZh: 3 據本條被要求提供或提交任何與享有法律特權的品目有關的資料或物料，律師（包括大律師）則可被要求提供其客戶的姓名、名稱及地址
options.labelEn: 3 A solicitor (including a barrister) may be required to provide the name, title and address of his client when required under this section to give or submit any information or material relating to a legally privileged item

options.labelZh: 凡獲授權人執行根據本條例簽發的手令進入處所後，可扣押及扣留任何相當可能與該手令所關的偵查有關的物料，包括享有法律特權的物品目
options.labelEn: Where an authorized person enters premises in execution of a warrant issued under this Ordinance, he may seize and detain any material, including a legally privileged item, which is likely to be relevant to the investigation to which the warrant relates

options.labelZh: 為遵從根據本條所提要求而提交的任何物料，獲授權人可將該物料攝影或複印
options.labelEn: An authorized person may photograph or copy any material submitted in compliance with a request under this section.

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 A。《香港國安法》第 43 條明確訂明：「對有合理理由懷疑擁有與偵查有關的資料或者管有有關物料的人員，要求其回答問題和提交資料或者物料」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《中華人民共和國香港特別行政區維護國家安全法》第四十四條，在獲任指定法官期間，如有__________的，終止其指定法官資格。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 44 of the "Law of the People's Republic of China on Safeguarding National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region", during the period of appointment as a designated judge, if any, his or her qualifications as a designated judge will be terminated.

options.labelEn: Words and deeds that endanger national security

options.labelZh: 批評香港特別行政區政府
options.labelEn: Criticize the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region Government

options.labelZh: 批評香港特別行政區政府行政長官
options.labelEn: Criticize the Chief Executive of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region Government

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 A。《香港國安法》第 44 條明確訂明：「在獲任指定法官期間，如有危害國家安全言行的，終止其指定法官資格」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《中華人民共和國香港特別行政區維護國家安全法》第四十八條，中央人民政府在香港特別行政區設立__________，依法履行維護國家安全職責，行使相關權力。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 48 of the "Law of the People's Republic of China on Safeguarding National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region", the Central People's Government is established in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region to perform its duties of safeguarding national security and exercise relevant powers in accordance with the law.

options.labelEn: Director of the National Security Division of the Police

options.labelZh: 外交部駐港特派員公署
options.labelEn: Office of the Commissioner of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs in Hong Kong

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 B。《香港國安法》第 48 條明確訂明：「中央人民政府駐香港特別行政區維護國家安全公署依法履行維護國家安全職責，行使相關權力」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《中華人民共和國香港特別行政區維護國家安全法》第五十條，駐香港特別行政區__________人員除須遵守全國性法律外，還應當遵守香港特別行政區法律。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 50 of the Law of the People's Republic of China on Safeguarding National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, personnel stationed in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region must abide by the laws of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region in addition to national laws.

options.labelZh: 中華人民共和國國家安全部
options.labelEn: Ministry of National Security of the People's Republic of China

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 B。《香港國安法》第 50 條明確訂明：「駐香港特別行政區維護國家安全公署人員除須遵守全國性法」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《中華人民共和國香港特別行政區維護國家安全法》第五十六條，根據本法第五十五條規定管轄有關危害國家安全犯罪案件時，由駐香港特別行政區__________負責立案偵查，最高人民檢察院指定有關檢察機關行使檢察權，最高人民法院指定有關法院行使審判權。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 56 of the "Law of the People's Republic of China on Safeguarding National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region", when cases involving crimes endangering national security are under jurisdiction in accordance with Article 55 of this Law, the People's Republic of China in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region shall be responsible for filing and investigating the case, the Supreme People's Procuratorate shall designate the relevant procuratorial organs to exercise procuratorial power, and the Supreme People's Court shall designate the relevant courts to exercise judicial power.

options.labelEn: National Security Division of the Police
Office for the Maintenance of National Security

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 D。《香港國安法》第 56 條明確訂明：「根據本法第五十五條規定管轄有關危害國家安全犯罪案件時，由駐香港特別行政區維護國家安全公署負責立案偵查，最高人民檢察院指定有關檢察機關行使檢察權，最高人民法院指定有關法院行使審判權」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《中華人民共和國香港特別行政區維護國家安全法》第五十七條，根據本法第五十五條規定管轄案件的立案偵查、審查起訴、審判和刑罰的執行等訴訟程序事宜，適用__________等相關法律的規定。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 57 of the "Law of the People's Republic of China on Safeguarding National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region", Article 55 of this Law governs the filing and investigation of cases, review and prosecution, trial and execution of penalties, and other relevant legal provisions shall apply.

options.labelEn: "Constitution of the People's Republic of China"
"Legislative Law of the People's Republic of China"

options.labelZh: 《中華人民共和國刑事訴訟法》
options.labelEn: "Criminal Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China"

options.labelZh: 《中華人民共和國香港特別行政區維護國家安全法》
options.labelEn: "Law of the People's Republic of China on Safeguarding National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region"

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 C。《香港國安法》第 57 條明確訂明：「根據本法第五十五條規定管轄案件的立案偵查、審查起訴、審判和刑罰的執行等訴訟程序事宜，適用《中華人民共和國刑事訴訟法》等相關法律的規定」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《中華人民共和國香港特別行政區維護國家安全法》第五十八條，犯罪嫌疑人、被告人被合法拘捕後，享有儘早接受__________公正審判的權利。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 58 of the Law of the People's Republic of China on Safeguarding National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, criminal suspects and defendants have the right to receive a fair trial as soon as possible after being lawfully arrested.
questions.explanationZh: 答案係 D。《香港國安法》第 58 條明確訂明：「犯罪嫌疑人、被告人被合法拘捕後，享有儘早接受司法機關公正審判的權利」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《中華人民共和國香港特別行政區維護國家安全法》第六十條，駐香港特別行政區__________及其人員依據本法執行職務的行為，不受香港特別行政區管轄。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 60 of the Law of the People's Republic of China on Safeguarding National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, the acts of personnel stationed in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region and their personnel performing duties in accordance with this law are not subject to the jurisdiction of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

options.labelEn: Liaison Office of the CPC Central Committee
Office of the Commissioner of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs
National Security Division of the Police Force
Office for the Maintenance of National Security

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 D。《香港國安法》第 60 條明確訂明：「駐香港特別行政區維護國家安全公署及其人員依據本法執行職務的行為，不受香港特別行政區管轄」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《中華人民共和國香港特別行政區維護國家安全法》第六十二條，香港特別行政區本地法律規定與本法不一致的，適用__________規定。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 62 of the Law of the People's Republic of China on Safeguarding National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, if the local legal provisions of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region are inconsistent with this law, the provisions shall apply.

options.labelEn: Constitution of the People's Republic of China

options.labelZh: 中華人民共和國香港特別行政區基本法
options.labelEn: Basic Law of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region of the People's Republic of China

options.labelZh: 中華人民共和國香港特別行政區維護國家安全法
options.labelEn: Law of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region of the People's Republic of China on Safeguarding National Security

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 A。《香港國安法》第 62 條明確訂明：「香港特別行政區本地法律規定與本法不一致的，適用本法規定」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《中華人民共和國香港特別行政區維護國家安全法》第二條，香港特別行政區任何機構、組織和個人在行使權利和自由時， __________？
questions.questionEn: According to Article 2 of the Law of the People's Republic of China on Safeguarding National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, when any institution, organization or individual in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region exercises their rights and freedoms __________?

options.labelEn: Not subject to any restrictions or restrictions

options.labelZh: 不可基於客觀事實批評香港特區政府的政策
options.labelEn: Do not criticize the policies of the Hong Kong SAR government based on objective facts

options.labelZh: 不得違背有關香港特別行政區是中華人民共和國不可分離的部分的規定
options.labelEn: Do not violate the provisions that the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region is an inseparable part of the People's Republic of China

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 D。《香港國安法》第 2 條訂明，任何機構、組織同個人行使權利自由時，都不得違背《基本法》第 1 條同第 12 條；D 所述香港係中國不可分離部分正正係第 1 條規定。

questions.questionZh: 根據《中華人民共和國香港特別行政區維護國家安全法》第六條，以下那些是需要遵守本法？
questions.questionEn: According to Article 6 of the "Law of the People's Republic of China on Safeguarding National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region", which of the following are required to comply with this law?

options.labelZh: 香港特別行政區的任何機構
options.labelEn: Any organization in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

options.labelZh: 香港特別行政區的任何組織
options.labelEn: Any organization in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

options.labelZh: 香港特別行政區的任何個人
options.labelEn: Any individual from the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 D。《香港國安法》第 6 條列出嘅對象或情況包括題目 A、B、C 三項，所以「以上皆是」先完整涵蓋條文要求。只揀其中一項會漏咗其餘同樣受規管嘅內容。

questions.questionZh: 根據《中華人民共和國香港特別行政區維護國家安全法》第十五條，誰人列席香港特別行政區維護國家安全委員會會議？
questions.questionEn: According to Article 15 of the Law of the People's Republic of China on Safeguarding National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, who will attend the meeting of the Committee for Safeguarding National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region?

options.labelEn: Director of the Liaison Office of the Central People's Government

options.labelZh: 警務處副處長（國家安全）
外交部駐港特派員公署特派員
options.labelEn: Commissioner, Office of the Commissioner of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs in Hong Kong

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 B。《香港國安法》第 15 條明確訂明：「國家安全事務顧問列席香港特別行政區維護國家安全委員會會議」。
questions.trapZh: 唔好交換權力主體；條文指定嘅係「國家安全事務顧問」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《中華人民共和國香港特別行政區維護國家安全法》第四十三條，香港特別行政區政府警務處維護國家安全部門辦理危害國家安全犯罪案件時，可以採取香港特別行政區現行法律准予警方等執法部門在調查嚴重犯罪案件時採取各種措施。 以下哪一項並不是警務處維護國家安全部門辦理危害國家安全犯罪案件時可以採取的各種措施：
questions.questionEn: According to Article 43 of the Law of the People's Republic of China on Safeguarding National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, when the national security department of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region Government Police Force handles cases of crimes endangering national security, the current laws of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region allow the police and other law enforcement agencies to take various measures when investigating serious criminal cases. Which of the following is not a measure that the police force's maintenance of national security department can take when handling cases of crimes endangering national security:

options.labelZh: 搜查可能存有犯罪證據的處所、車輛、船隻、航空器以及其他有關地方和電子設備
options.labelEn: Search premises, vehicles, ships, aircraft and other relevant places and electronic equipment that may contain evidence of crimes

options.labelZh: 羈押該人一段合理期間，在該期間內由該警務人員查究該人是否涉嫌在任何時候犯了任何危害國家安全罪行
options.labelEn: Detain the person for a reasonable period, during which the police officer will investigate whether the person is suspected of committing any crime endangering national security at any time

options.labelZh: 要求涉嫌實施危害國家安全犯罪行為的人員交出旅行證件或者限制其離境
options.labelEn: Request persons suspected of committing crimes endangering national security to hand over their travel documents or restrict their departure from the country

options.labelZh: 對用於或者意圖用於犯罪的財產、因犯罪所得的收益等與犯罪相關的財產，予以凍結，申請限制令、 押記令、沒收令以及充公
options.labelEn: Freeze property used or intended to be used in crime, proceeds from crime and other crime-related property, and apply for restraint orders, charging orders, confiscation orders and confiscation orders

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 B。依據《香港國安法》第 43 條，「羈押該人一段合理期間，在該期間內由該警務人員查究該人是否涉嫌在任何時候犯了任何危害國家安全罪行」唔屬於條文列明嘅犯罪或禁止行為；其餘選項先係條文涵蓋嘅內容。
questions.trapZh: 題目問排除項；要揀出唔屬於條文列明嘅犯罪或禁止行為嘅「羈押該人一段合理期間，在該期間內由該警務人員查究該人是否涉嫌在任何時候犯了任何危害國家安全罪行」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《中華人民共和國香港特別行政區維護國家安全法》第一條，為堅定不移並全面準確貫徹「一國兩制」，「港人治港」、高度自治的方針，維護國家安全，防範、制止和懲治與香港特別行政區有關的犯罪。以下那一項並不是相關之罪行？
questions.questionEn: According to Article 1 of the Law of the People's Republic of China on Safeguarding National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, in order to unswervingly and comprehensively and accurately implement the principles of "one country, two systems", "Hong Kong people governing Hong Kong" and a high degree of autonomy, safeguard national security and prevent, suppress and punish crimes related to the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region. Which of the following is not a related crime?

options.labelEn: The crime of subversion of state power
The crime of organizing and carrying out terrorist activities

options.labelZh: 勾結外國或者境外勢力危害國家安全罪
options.labelEn: The crime of colluding with foreign countries or foreign forces to endanger national security

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 A。依據《香港國安法》第 1 條，「間諜罪」唔屬於條文列明嘅犯罪或禁止行為；其餘選項先係條文涵蓋嘅內容。
questions.trapZh: 題目問排除項；要揀出唔屬於條文列明嘅犯罪或禁止行為嘅「間諜罪」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《中華人民共和國香港特別行政區維護國家安全法》第八條，香港特別行政區執法、司法機關應當切實執行本法和香港特別行政區現行法律有關防範、制止和懲治危害國家安全行為和活動的規定，有效__________。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 8 of the Law of the People's Republic of China on Safeguarding National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, the law enforcement and judicial organs of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region shall effectively implement the provisions of this Law and the existing laws of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region on preventing, stopping and punishing behaviors and activities that endanger national security.
questions.explanationZh: 答案係 D。《香港國安法》第 8 條明確訂明：「香港特別行政區執法、司法機關應當切實執行本法和香港特別行政區現行法律有關防範、制止和懲治危害國家安全行為和活動的規定，有效維護國家安全」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《中華人民共和國香港特別行政區維護國家安全法》第九條，香港特別行政區應當加強__________和__________的工作。對學校，社會團體、媒體、網絡等涉及國家安全的事宜，香港特別行政區政府應當採取必要措施，加強宣傳、指導、監督和管理。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 9 of the Law of the People's Republic of China on Safeguarding National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region shall strengthen and For matters related to national security in schools, social groups, media, and the Internet, the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region government should take necessary measures to strengthen publicity, guidance, supervision, and management.

options.labelEn: Maintain law and order and uphold law and order

options.labelZh: 維護國家安全和防範恐怖活動
options.labelEn: Maintain national security and prevent terrorist activities

options.labelZh: 維護國家繁榮和香港特別行政區穩定
options.labelEn: Maintain national prosperity and the stability of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

options.labelZh: 維護中央人民政府安全和防範分裂國家活動
options.labelEn: Maintain the security of the Central People's Government and prevent separatist activities

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 B。《香港國安法》第 9 條明確訂明：「香港特別行政區應當加強維護國家安全和防範恐怖活動的工作」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《中華人民共和國香港特別行政區維護國家安全法》第十一條，如中央人民政府提出要求，行政長官應當就維護國家安全特定事項及時提交__________
questions.questionEn: According to Article 11 of the Law of the People's Republic of China on Safeguarding National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, if requested by the Central People's Government, the Chief Executive shall promptly submit

options.labelEn: annual reports on specific matters for safeguarding national security

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 D。《香港國安法》第 11 條明確訂明：「香港特別行政區行政長官應當就香港特別行政區維護國家安全事務向中央人民政府負責，並就香港特別行政區履行維護國家安全職責的情況提交年度報告」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《中華人民共和國香港特別行政區維護國家安全法》第二十一條〈分裂國家罪〉，任何人__________或者其他財物資助他人實施本法第二十條規定的犯罪〈分裂國家罪》的，即屬犯罪。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 21 of the "Law of the People's Republic of China on Safeguarding National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region of the People's Republic of China", "the crime of secession", any person or other property that finances others to commit the crime "the crime of secession" stipulated in Article 20 of this law shall be guilty of a crime.
questions.explanationZh: 答案係 A。《香港國安法》第 21 條明確訂明：「任何人煽動、協助、教唆、以金錢或者其他財物資助他人實施本法第二十條規定的犯罪的，即屬犯罪」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《中華人民共和國香港特別行政區維護國家安全法》第二十二條顛覆國家政權罪，任何人組織、策劃、實施或者參與實施以下以武力、威脅使用武力或者其他非法手段旨在顛覆國家政權行為之一的，即屬犯罪： （一）推翻、破壞 __________所確立的中華人民共和國根本制度。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 22 of the "Law of the People's Republic of China on Safeguarding National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region", the crime of subversion is committed by any person who organizes, plans, implements or participates in the implementation of any of the following acts aimed at subverting state power by using force, threatening the use of force or other illegal means: (1) Overthrowing or destroying the fundamental system of the People's Republic of China established by the People's Republic of China.

options.labelEn: Constitution of the People's Republic of China

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 D。《香港國安法》第 22 條明確訂明：「任何人組織、策劃、實施或者參與實施以下以武力、威脅使用武力或者其他非法手段旨在顛覆國家政權行為之一的，即屬犯罪： （一）推翻、破壞中華人民共和國憲法所確立的中華人民共和國根本制度」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《中華人民共和國香港特別行政區維護國家安全法》第二十四條〈恐怖活動罪〉，為脅迫中央人民政府、香港特別行政區政府或者國際組織或者威嚇公眾以圖實現政治主張，組織、策劃、實施，參與實施或者威脅實施以下造成或者意圖造成嚴重社會危害的恐怖活動之一的，即屬犯罪： 以下哪一項並不是〈恐怖活動罪》的活動：
questions.questionEn: According to Article 24 of the "Law of the People's Republic of China on Safeguarding National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region", "Crime of Terrorist Activities", it is a crime to organize, plan, implement, participate in the execution or threaten to carry out one of the following terrorist activities that cause or intend to cause serious social harm in order to coerce the Central People's Government, the Government of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region or international organizations or intimidate the public in order to realize political opinions: Which of the following is not an activity under the "Crime of Terrorist Activities":

options.labelZh: 煽惑他人意圖造成身體嚴重傷害
options.labelEn: Incite others with intent to cause grievous bodily harm

options.labelZh: 爆炸、縱火或者投放毒害性、放射性、傳染病病原體等物質
options.labelEn: Exploding, setting fire, or releasing toxic, radioactive, infectious disease pathogens and other substances

options.labelZh: 破壞交通工具、交通設施、電力設備、燃氣設備或者其他易燃易爆設備
options.labelEn: Damaging vehicles, transportation facilities, electrical equipment, gas equipment or other flammable and explosive equipment

options.labelZh: 嚴重干擾、破壞水、電、燃氣、交通、通訊、網絡等公共服務和管理的電子控制系統
options.labelEn: Seriously interfere with and destroy electronic control systems of public services and management such as water, electricity, gas, transportation, communications, and networks.

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 A。依據《香港國安法》第 24 條，「煽惑他人意圖造成身體嚴重傷害」唔屬於條文列明嘅犯罪或禁止行為；其餘選項先係條文涵蓋嘅內容。
questions.trapZh: 題目問排除項；要揀出唔屬於條文列明嘅犯罪或禁止行為嘅「煽惑他人意圖造成身體嚴重傷害」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《中華人民共和國香港特別行政區維護國家安全法》第四十一條，未經律政司長書面同意，任何人不得就危害國家安全犯罪案件提出檢控。但該規定不影響就有關犯罪依法逮捕犯罪嫌疑人並將其羈押，也不影響該等犯罪嫌疑人__________
questions.questionEn: According to Article 41 of the Law of the People's Republic of China on Safeguarding National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, no person may prosecute cases of crimes endangering national security without the written consent of the Secretary for Justice. However, this provision does not affect the arrest and custody of criminal suspects in accordance with the law for relevant crimes, nor does it affect the criminal suspects
questions.explanationZh: 答案係 D。《香港國安法》第 41 條明確訂明：「但該規定不影響就有關犯罪依法逮捕犯罪嫌疑人並將其羈押，也不影響該等犯罪嫌疑人申請保釋」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《中華人民共和國香港特別行政區維護國家安全法》第四十三條，香港特別行政區政府警務處維護國家安全部門辦理危害國家安全犯罪案件時，可以採取香港特別行政區現行法律准予警方等執法部門在調查嚴重犯罪案件時採取各種措施。 以下哪一項並不是警務處維護國家安全部門辦理危害國家安全犯罪案件時可以採取的各種措施：
questions.questionEn: According to Article 43 of the Law of the People's Republic of China on Safeguarding National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, when the national security department of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region Government Police Force handles cases of crimes endangering national security, the current laws of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region allow the police and other law enforcement agencies to take various measures when investigating serious criminal cases. Which of the following is not a measure that the police department can take to safeguard national security when handling cases of crimes endangering national security:

options.labelZh: 要求信息發佈人或者有關服務商移除信息或者提供協助
options.labelEn: Request information publishers or relevant service providers to remove information or provide assistance

options.labelZh: 要求外國及境外政治性組織，外國及境外當局或者政治性組織的代理人提供資料
options.labelEn: Request foreign and overseas political organizations, foreign and overseas authorities or agents of political organizations to provide information

options.labelZh: 經行政長官批准，對有合理理由懷疑涉及實施危害國家安全犯罪的人員進行截取通訊和秘密監察
options.labelEn: With the approval of the Chief Executive, intercept communications and secretly monitor persons who have reasonable grounds to suspect that they are involved in committing crimes that endanger national security

options.labelZh: 經行政長官批准，在任何情況下批予進行截取通訊和秘密監察期間，時限則不受此限制。
options.labelEn: The period of interception of communications and covert surveillance authorized under any circumstances with the approval of the Chief Executive shall not be subject to this time limit.

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 D。依據《香港國安法》第 43 條，「經行政長官批准，在任何情況下批予進行截取通訊和秘密監察期間，時限則不受此限制。」唔屬於條文列明嘅犯罪或禁止行為；其餘選項先係條文涵蓋嘅內容。
questions.trapZh: 題目問排除項；要揀出唔屬於條文列明嘅犯罪或禁止行為嘅「經行政長官批准，在任何情況下批予進行截取通訊和秘密監察期間，時限則不受此限制。」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《中華人民共和國香港特別行政區維護國家安全法》第四十四條，香港特別行政區行政長官應當從裁判官、區域法院法官、高等法院原訟法庭法官，上訴法庭法官以及終審法院法官中指定若干名法官，也可從暫委或者特委法官中指定若干名法官，負責處理危害國家安全犯罪案件。 行政長官在指定法官前可徵詢香港特別行政區維護國家安全委員會和__________的意見。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 44 of the Law of the People's Republic of China on Safeguarding National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, the Chief Executive of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region shall designate a number of judges from among magistrates, judges of the District Court, judges of the Court of First Instance of the High Court, judges of the Court of Appeal and judges of the Court of Final Appeal, and may also designate a number of judges from among temporary or special judges to handle cases of crimes endangering national security. The Chief Executive may seek the opinions of the Committee for the Maintenance of National Security of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region and the HKSAR Government before appointing a judge.

options.labelEn: Director of the Liaison Office of the Central People's Government
Chief Justice of the Court of Final Appeal
Director of the National Security Division of the Police Force

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 C。《香港國安法》第 44 條訂明，行政長官指定處理國安案件嘅法官前，可以徵詢香港國安委同終審法院首席法官嘅意見；題目所欠嘅職位係終審法院首席法官。

questions.trapZh: 呢題考法定數字：準確答案係「三年以上十年以下」。
