questions.questionEn: According to Article 22 of the "Law of the People's Republic of China on Safeguarding National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region", "The Crime of Subversion", any person who organizes, plans, implements or participates in one of the following acts to subvert state power by using force, threatening the use of force or other illegal means shall be guilty of a crime: (3) Seriously interfering with, obstructing or damaging the organs of central power of the People's Republic of China or the organs of power of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region in accordance with the law
questions.explanationZh: 答案係 D。《香港國安法》第 22 條明確訂明：「推翻中華人民共和國中央政權機關或者香港特別行政區政權機關： （三）嚴重干擾、阻撓、破壞中華人民共和國中央政權機關或者香港特別行政區政權機關依法履行職能」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《中華人民共和國香港特別行政區維護國家安全法》第二十九條〈勾結外國或者境外勢力危害國家安全罪〉， 為外國或者境外機構、組織、人員竊取、刺探、收買、非法提供涉及國家安全的國家秘密或者情報的；請求外國或者境外機構、組織、人員實施，與外國或者境外機構、組織、人員串謀實施，或者直接或者間接接受外國或者境外機構、組織、人員的指使、控制、資助或者其他形式的支援實施以下行為之一的，均屬犯罪： （二）對香港特別行政區政府或者中央人民政府制定和執行法律，政策進行__________並可能造成嚴重後果。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 29 of the "Law of the People's Republic of China on Safeguarding National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region" ("The crime of colluding with foreign countries or foreign forces to endanger national security"), stealing, spying, bribing, or illegally providing state secrets or intelligence related to national security for foreign or overseas institutions, organizations, or personnel; requesting foreign or overseas institutions, organizations, or personnel to implement, colluding with foreign or overseas institutions, organizations, or personnel to implement, or directly or indirectly accepting foreign or overseas institutions, organizations, or personnel to implement; Any institution, organization or person who instigates, controls, finances or provides other forms of support to carry out any of the following acts shall be guilty of a crime: (2) The formulation and implementation of laws and policies for the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region Government or the Central People's Government and may cause serious consequences.
questions.explanationZh: 答案係 A。《香港國安法》第 29 條明確訂明：「…： （二）對香港特別行政區政府或者中央人民政府制定和執行法律、政策進行嚴重阻撓並可能造成嚴重後果」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《中華人民共和國香港特別行政區維護國家安全法》第二十九條〈勾結外國或者境外勢力危害國家安全罪〉， 為外國或者境外機構、組織、人員竊取、刺探、收買、非法提供涉及國家安全的國家秘密或者情報的；請求外國或者境外機構、組織、人員實施，與外國或者境外機構、組織、人員串謀實施，或者直接或者間接接受外國或者境外機構、組織、人員的指使、控制、資助或者其他形式的支援實施以下行為之一的，均屬犯罪： （五）通過各種非法方式引發香港特別行政區居民對中央人民政府或者香港特別行政區政府的__________並可能造成嚴重後果。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 29 of the "Law of the People's Republic of China on Safeguarding National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region" ("The crime of colluding with foreign countries or foreign forces to endanger national security"), stealing, spying, bribing, or illegally providing state secrets or intelligence related to national security for foreign or overseas institutions, organizations, or personnel; requesting foreign or overseas institutions, organizations, or personnel to implement, colluding with foreign or overseas institutions, organizations, or personnel to implement, or directly or indirectly accepting foreign or overseas institutions, organizations, or personnel to implement; Any person who instigates, controls, finances or provides other forms of support to institutions, organizations or personnel to carry out any of the following acts shall be guilty of a crime: (5) Using various illegal means to cause Hong Kong Special Administrative Region residents to have negative feelings towards the Central People's Government or the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region Government and may cause serious consequences.
questions.explanationZh: 答案係 D。《香港國安法》第 29 條採用嘅原文係「憎恨」，並要求有關非法方式可能造成嚴重後果。原答案「仇恨」唔係條文用字，所以改正為 D。

questions.questionZh: 根據《中華人民共和國香港特別行政區維護國家安全法》第十六條，警務處維護國家安全部門可以從香港特別行政區以外聘請合格的__________和__________，協助執行維護國家安全相關任務。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 16 of the "Law of the People's Republic of China on Safeguarding National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region", the National Security Department of the Police Force may hire qualified personnel and police officers from outside the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region to assist in the performance of tasks related to safeguarding national security.
questions.explanationZh: 答案係 C。《香港國安法》第 16 條明確訂明：「警務處維護國家安全部門可以從香港特別行政區以外聘請合格的專門人員和技術人員，協助執行維護國家安全相關任務」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《中華人民共和國香港特別行政區維護國家安全法》第十九條，經行政長官批准，香港特別行政區政府財政司長應當從政府__________撥出專門款項支付關於維護國家安全的開支。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 19 of the Law of the People's Republic of China on Safeguarding National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, with the approval of the Chief Executive, the Financial Secretary of the Government of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region shall allocate special funds from the government to pay for expenditures related to safeguarding national security.
questions.explanationZh: 答案係 B。《香港國安法》第 19 條明確訂明：「經行政長官批准，香港特別行政區政府財政司長應當從政府一般收入中撥出專門款項支付關於維護國家安全的開支並核准所涉及的人員編制，不受香港特別行政區現行有關法律規定的限制」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《中華人民共和國香港特別行政區維護國家安全法》第二十條〈分裂國家罪》，任何人組織、策劃、實施或者參與實施以下旨在分裂國家、破壞國家統一行為之一的，不論是否使用武力或者以武力相威脅，即屬犯罪： 對其他參加的，處 __________有期徒刑、拘役或者管制。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 20 of the "Law of the People's Republic of China on Safeguarding National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region", "The Crime of Secession", any person who organizes, plans, implements or participates in the implementation of one of the following acts aimed at splitting the country and undermining national unity shall be guilty of a crime, regardless of whether he uses force or threatens force: Other participants shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment, criminal detention or surveillance.
questions.explanationZh: 答案係 C。《香港國安法》第 20 條明確訂明：「對其他參加的，處三年以下有期徒刑、拘役或者管制」。
questions.trapZh: 呢題考法定數字：準確答案係「三年以下」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《中華人民共和國香港特別行政區維護國家安全法》第二十二條〈顛覆國家政權罪》，任何人組織、策劃、 實施或者參與實施以下以武力、威脅使用武力或者其他非法手段旨在顛覆國家政權行為之一的，即屬犯罪： （三）嚴重干擾、阻撓、破壞中華人民共和國中央政權機關或者香港特別行政區政權機關依法__________。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 22 of the "Law of the People's Republic of China on Safeguarding National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region" ("The Crime of Subversion of State Power"), any person who organizes, plans, implements or participates in the implementation of any of the following acts aimed at subverting state power by using force, threatening the use of force or other illegal means shall be guilty of a crime: (3) Seriously interfering with, obstructing or destroying the central power organs of the People's Republic of China or the power organs of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region in accordance with the law.
questions.explanationZh: 答案係 D。《香港國安法》第 22 條明確訂明：「推翻中華人民共和國中央政權機關或者香港特別行政區政權機關： （三）嚴重干擾、阻撓、破壞中華人民共和國中央政權機關或者香港特別行政區政權機關依法履行職能」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《中華人民共和國香港特別行政區維護國家安全法》第二十六條〈恐怖活動罪〉，為__________提供培訓、武器、信息、資金、物資、勞務、 運輸、技術或者場所等支持、協助、便利，或者製造、非法管有爆炸性、毒害性、放射性、傳染病病原體等物質以及以其他形式準備實施恐怖活動的，即屬犯罪。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 26 of the "Law of the People's Republic of China on Safeguarding National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region" (Crimes of Terrorist Activities), it is a crime to provide support, assistance, and convenience for the purpose of providing training, weapons, information, funds, materials, labor services, transportation, technology, or venues, or to manufacture or illegally possess explosive, poisonous, radioactive, infectious pathogens and other substances, or to prepare to carry out terrorist activities in other forms.

options.labelZh: 破壞國家組織、破壞國家人員、破壞國家實施
options.labelEn: Undermining state organizations, undermining state personnel, and undermining state implementation

options.labelZh: 分裂國家組織、分裂國家人員、分裂國家實施
options.labelEn: Separatist organizations, separatists, and separatist implementation

options.labelZh: 顛覆國家組織、顛覆國家人員、顛覆國家實施
options.labelEn: Subverting state organizations, subverting state personnel, subverting state implementation

options.labelZh: 恐怖活動組織、恐怖活動人員、恐怖活動實施
options.labelEn: Terrorist organization, terrorist personnel, and terrorist implementation

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 D。《香港國安法》第 26 條明確訂明：「為恐怖活動組織、恐怖活動人員、恐怖活動實施提供培訓、武器、信息、資金、物資、勞務、運輸、技術或者場所等支持、協助、便利，或者製造、非法管有爆炸性、毒害性、放射性、傳染病病原體等物質以及以其他形式準備實施恐怖活動的，即屬犯罪」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《中華人民共和國香港特別行政區維護國家安全法》第二十九條〈勾結外國或者境外勢力危害國家安全罪〉， 為外國或者境外機構、組織、人員竊取、刺探、收買、非法提供涉及國家安全的國家秘密或者情報的；請求外國或者境外機構、組織、人員實施，與外國或者境外機構、組織、人員串謀實施，或者直接或者間接接受外國或者境外機構、組織、人員的指使、控制、資助或者其他形式的支援實施以下行為之一的，均屬犯罪： （一）對中華人民共和國發動戰爭，或者以武力或者武力相威脅，對中華人民共和國__________造成嚴重危害
questions.questionEn: According to Article 29 of the "Law of the People's Republic of China on Safeguarding National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region" ("The crime of colluding with foreign countries or foreign forces to endanger national security"), stealing, spying, bribing, or illegally providing state secrets or intelligence related to national security for foreign or overseas institutions, organizations, or personnel; requesting foreign or overseas institutions, organizations, or personnel to implement, colluding with foreign or overseas institutions, organizations, or personnel to implement, or directly or indirectly accepting foreign or overseas institutions, organizations, or personnel to implement; It shall be a crime for any institution, organization or person to instigate, control, finance or provide other forms of support to carry out any of the following acts: (1) Launching a war against the People's Republic of China, or using force or the threat of force, causing serious harm to the People's Republic of China

options.labelEn: Integrity of politics, governance and rule of law
Integrity of political power, governance and sovereignty

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 C。《香港國安法》第 29 條明確訂明：「…）對中華人民共和國發動戰爭，或者以武力或者武力相威脅，對中華人民共和國主權、統一和領土完整造成嚴重危害： （二）對香港特別行政區政府或者中央人民政府制定和執行法律、政策進行嚴重阻撓並可能造成…」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《中華人民共和國香港特別行政區維護國家安全法》第三十一條，公司、團體等法人或者非法人組織因犯本法規定的罪行受到刑事處罰的，應責令其__________或者__________或者__________
questions.questionEn: According to Article 31 of the Law of the People's Republic of China on Safeguarding National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, if a company, group or other legal person or unincorporated organization is subject to criminal punishment for committing a crime stipulated in this law, it shall be ordered to either or

options.labelZh: 停止運作或者終止其執照或者商業登記證
options.labelEn: Cease operations or terminate its license or business registration certificate

options.labelZh: 停止營業或者取消其執照或者商業登記冊
options.labelEn: cease trading or cancel its license or business register

options.labelZh: 暫停營業或者撤銷其執照或者營業許可證
options.labelEn: Suspend business or revoke its license or business permit

options.labelZh: 暫停運作或者吊銷其執照或者營業許可證
options.labelEn: Suspend operations or revoke its license or business permit

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 D。《香港國安法》第 31 條明確訂明：「公司、團體等法人或者非法人組織因犯本法規定的罪行受到刑事處罰的，應責令其暫停運作或者吊銷其執照或者營業許可證」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《中華人民共和國香港特別行政區維護國家安全法》第三十三條： （一）在犯罪過程中， 或者的，對有關犯罪行為人、犯罪嫌疑人、被告人可以從輕、減輕處罰； 犯罪較輕的，可以免除處罰__________：
questions.questionEn: According to Hong Kong National Security Law Article 33, According to Article 33 of the "Law of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region of the People's Republic of China on Safeguarding National Security": (1) In the course of committing a crime, or , relevant criminal perpetrators, criminal suspects, and defendants may be given lighter or mitigated punishments; For minor crimes, punishment may be exempted:

options.labelZh: 認罪或者自首及有悔意
options.labelEn: Plea guilty or surrender and have remorse

options.labelZh: 犯罪未被發覺前或者自首並接受裁判
options.labelEn: Before the crime is discovered or surrender and accept the judgment

options.labelZh: 自動放棄犯罪或者自動有效地防止犯罪結果發生
options.labelEn: Automatically give up the crime or automatically and effectively prevent the consequences of the crime.

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 D。《香港國安法》第 33 條明確訂明：「犯罪較輕的，可以免除處罰： （一）在犯罪過程中，自動放棄犯罪或者自動有效地防止犯罪結果發生的」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《中華人民共和國香港特別行政區維護國家安全法》第三十五條，曾經宣誓或者聲明擁護中華人民共和國香港特別行政區基本法、效忠中華人民共和國香港特別行政區的立法會議員、政府官員及公務人員、行政會議成員，法官及其他司法人員、區議員，即時__________，並喪失參選或者出任上述職務的資格。
questions.questionEn: According to Hong Kong National Security Law Article 35, According to Article 35 of the Law on Safeguarding National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region of the People's Republic of China, members of the Legislative Council, government officials and civil servants, members of the Executive Council, judges and other judicial personnel, and district councilors who have sworn or declared to support the Basic Law of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region of the People's Republic of China and to be loyal to the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region of the People's Republic of China will immediately be disqualified from running for election or holding the above-mentioned positions.
questions.explanationZh: 答案係 C。《香港國安法》第 35 條明確訂明：「曾經宣誓或者聲明擁護中華人民共和國香港特別行政區基本法，效忠中華人民共和國香港特別行政區的立法會議員、政府官員及公務人員、行政會議成員，法官及其他司法人員、區議員，即時喪失該等職務，並喪失參選或者出任上述職務的資格」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《中華人民共和國香港特別行政區維護國家安全法》第四十一條，未經律政司長書面同意，任何人不得就危害國家安全犯罪案件__________。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 41 of the Law of the People's Republic of China on Safeguarding National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, no one may engage in criminal cases endangering national security without the written consent of the Secretary for Justice.
questions.explanationZh: 答案係 C。《香港國安法》第 41 條明確訂明：「未經律政司長書面同意，任何人不得就危害國家安全犯罪案件提出檢控」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《中華人民共和國香港特別行政區維護國家安全法》第十三條，香港特別行政區維護國家安全委員會下設__________ •由秘書長領導。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 13 of the Law of the People's Republic of China on Safeguarding National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region's National Security Committee is headed by the Secretary-General.
questions.explanationZh: 答案係 B。《香港國安法》第 13 條明確訂明：「香港特別行政區維護國家安全委員會下設秘書處，由秘書長領導」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《中華人民共和國香港特別行政區維護國家安全法》第十八條，國家安全犯罪案件檢控部門檢控官由律政司長徵得__________同意後任命。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 18 of the Law of the People's Republic of China on Safeguarding National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, prosecutors of the prosecution department for national security crimes are appointed with the consent of the Secretary for Justice.

options.labelZh: 香港特別行政區行政長官
options.labelEn: Chief Executive of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

options.labelZh: 香港警務處國家安全處處長
options.labelEn: Director of the National Security Division of the Hong Kong Police Force

options.labelZh: 香港特別行政區維護國家安全委員會
options.labelEn: Committee for the Maintenance of National Security of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 D。《香港國安法》第 18 條明確訂明：「該部門檢控官由律政司長徵得香港特別行政區維護國家安全委員會同意後任命」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《中華人民共和國香港特別行政區維護國家安全法》第二十條〈分裂國家罪》，任何人組織、策劃、實施或者參與實施以下旨在分裂國家、破壞國家統一行為之一的， 不論是否使用武力或者以武力相威脅，即臘犯罪： （一）將香港特別行政區或者中華人民共和國其他任何部分從中華人民共和國__________出去。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 20 of the "Law of the People's Republic of China on Safeguarding National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region", "The Crime of Secession", any person who organizes, plans, implements or participates in the implementation of one of the following acts aimed at splitting the country and undermining national unity, regardless of whether he uses force or the threat of force, commits a crime: (1) Separating the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region or any other part of the People's Republic of China from the People's Republic of China.
questions.explanationZh: 答案係 A。《香港國安法》第 20 條明確訂明：「任何人組織、策劃、實施或者參與實施以下旨在分裂國家、破壞國家統一行為之一的，不論是否使用武力或者以武力相威脅，即屬犯罪： （一）將香港特別行政區或者中華人民共和國其他任何部分從中華人民共和國分離出去」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《中華人民共和國香港特別行政區維護國家安全法》第二十二條〈顛覆國家政權罪〉，任何人組織、策劃、 實施或者參與實施以下以武力、威脅使用武力或者其他非法手段旨在顛覆國家政權行為之一的，即屬犯罪： （四）攻擊、破壞香港特別行政區__________履職場所及其設施，致使其無法正常履行職能。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 22 of the "Law of the People's Republic of China on Safeguarding National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region" ("The Crime of Subversion of State Power"), any person who organizes, plans, implements or participates in the implementation of any of the following acts aimed at subverting state power by using force, threatening the use of force or other illegal means shall be guilty of a crime: (4) Attacking or destroying the places where the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region performs its duties and its facilities, causing it to be unable to perform its functions normally.
questions.explanationZh: 答案係 D。《香港國安法》第 22 條明確訂明：「攻擊、破壞香港特別行政區政權機關履職場所及其設施，致使其無法正常履行職能」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《中華人民共和國香港特別行政區維護國家安全法》第二十七條〈恐怖活動罪〉，宣揚恐怖主義、 __________實施恐怖活動的，即屬犯罪。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 27 "Crime of Terrorist Activities" of the "Law of the People's Republic of China on Safeguarding National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region", it is a crime to promote terrorism and carry out terrorist activities.
questions.explanationZh: 答案係 C。《香港國安法》第 27 條明確訂明：「宣揚恐怖主義、煽動實施恐怖活動的，即屬犯罪」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《中華人民共和國香港特別行政區維護國家安全法》第二十九條〈勾結外國或者境外勢力危害國家安全罪〉， 為外國或者境外機構、組織、人員竊取、刺探、收買、非法提供涉及國家安全的國家秘密或者情報的；請求外國或者境外機構、組織、人員實施，與外國或者境外機構、組織、人員串謀實施，或者直接或者間接接受外國或者境外機構、組織、人員的指使、控制、資助或者其他形式的支援實施以下行為之一的，均屬犯罪： （三）對香港特別行政區選舉進行__________並可能造成嚴重後果。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 29 of the "Law of the People's Republic of China on Safeguarding National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region" ("The crime of colluding with foreign countries or foreign forces to endanger national security"), stealing, spying, bribing, or illegally providing state secrets or intelligence related to national security for foreign or overseas institutions, organizations, or personnel; requesting foreign or overseas institutions, organizations, or personnel to implement, colluding with foreign or overseas institutions, organizations, or personnel to implement, or directly or indirectly accepting foreign or overseas institutions, organizations, or personnel to implement; Any institution, organization or person who instigates, controls, finances or provides other forms of support to carry out any of the following acts is a crime: (3) Conducting elections in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region and may cause serious consequences.
questions.explanationZh: 答案係 B。《香港國安法》第 29 條明確訂明：「對香港特別行政區選舉進行操控、破壞並可能造成嚴重後果： （四）對香港特別行政區或者中華人民共和國進行制裁、封鎖或者採取其他敵對行動」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《中華人民共和國香港特別行政區維護國家安全法》第三十二條，因實施本法規定的犯罪而獲得的資助、收益、報酬等違法所得以及用於或者意圖用於犯罪的資金和工具，應當予以 __________，
questions.questionEn: According to Article 32 of the "Law of the People's Republic of China on Safeguarding National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region", illegal gains such as funding, income, remuneration, etc. obtained from the commission of crimes stipulated in this law, as well as funds and tools used or intended to be used in crimes, shall be __________,
questions.explanationZh: 答案係 B。《香港國安法》第 32 條明確訂明：「因實施本法規定的犯罪而獲得的資助、收益、 報酬等違法所得以及用於或者意圖用於犯罪的資金和工具，應當予以追繳、沒收」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《中華人民共和國香港特別行政區維護國家安全法》第三十三條： （三）揭發他人犯罪行為，查證屬實，或者提供重要線索得以偵破其他案件的可以從輕、減輕處罰；犯罪較輕的，可以免除處罰。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 33 of the "Law of the People's Republic of China on Safeguarding National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region": (3) Those who expose other people's criminal behavior and verify it to be true, or provide important clues to detect other cases, may be given a lighter or reduced punishment; those who commit relatively minor crimes may be exempted from punishment.

options.labelZh: 犯罪人士、羈留人士、通緝人士
犯罪行為人、犯罪嫌疑人、被告人

questions.explanationZh: 答案係 D。《香港國安法》第 33 條明確訂明：「有以下情形的，對有關犯罪行為人、犯罪嫌疑人、被告人可以從輕、減輕處罰」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《中華人民共和國香港特別行政區維護國家安全法》第四十一條，香港特別行政區管轄的危害國家安全犯罪案件的審判循 __________進行。
questions.questionEn: According to Article 41 of the Law of the People's Republic of China on Safeguarding National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, the trial process for cases of crimes endangering national security under the jurisdiction of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region is conducted.
questions.explanationZh: 答案係 A。《香港國安法》第 41 條明確訂明：「香港特別行政區管轄的危害國家安全犯罪案件的審判循公訴程序進行」。

questions.questionZh: 根據《中華人民共和國香港特別行政區維護國家安全法》第四十六條，對高等法院原訟法庭進行的就危害國家安全犯罪案件提起的刑事檢控程序，律政司長可基於保護國家秘密、案件具有涉外因素或者保障陪審員及其家人的人身安全等理由，發出證書指示相關訴訟毋須在有__________的情況下進行審理。
questions.questionEn: According to Hong Kong National Security Law Article 46, According to Article 46 of the "Law of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region of the People's Republic of China on Safeguarding National Security", for criminal prosecution proceedings initiated by the Court of First Instance of the High Court for cases of crimes endangering national security, the Secretary for Justice may issue a certificate instructing that the relevant proceedings do not need to be heard on the grounds of protecting state secrets, having foreign-related elements in the case, or protecting the personal safety of jurors and their families.
questions.explanationZh: 答案係 A。《香港國安法》第 46 條明確訂明：「對高等法院原訟法庭進行的就危害國家安全犯罪案件提起的刑事檢控程序，律政司長可基於保護國家秘密、案件具有涉外因素或者保障陪審員及其家人的人身安全等理由，發出證書指示相關訴訟毋須在有陪審團的情況下進行審理」。
